def bank(r, t, add, spr, fx):
    """A continuous embankment and authored warehouse silhouettes, not random blocks."""
    add(r, box(95,1.3,3,(32,36,40), center=(0,-.1,34), seg=4))
    add(r, box(95,.16,3.2,(54,58,59), center=(0,.64,34), seg=4))
    buildings = [(-32,10,8,(39,35,37)), (-6,12,12,(34,38,44)),
                 (9,12,7,(45,37,35)), (24,14,10,(33,37,42))]
    for bx,w,h,col in buildings:
        add(r, box(w,h,8,col, center=(bx,h/2+.65,45), seg=2))
        add(r, box(w+.25,.3,8.2,(52,52,51), center=(bx,h+.7,45), seg=2))
        for j in range(int(w/2)):
            x=bx-w/2+1+j*2
            add(r, box(.15,h,.08,(49,45,42), center=(x-1,h/2+.65,40.96)))
            for floor in range(1,int(h/2.2)):
                y=1.2+floor*2.15
                lit=(j+floor+int(bx))%5==0
                c=(112,94,65) if lit else (18,25,32)
                add(r, box(.8,1.1,.05,c, center=(x,y,40.94), emissive=lit))
                add(r, box(.95,.1,.16,(59,55,49), center=(x,y-.6,40.9)))
        add(r, box(.65,2,.65,(36,35,38), center=(bx+w*.27,h+1.55,46.2)))
        spr(r, (bx,-.56,37), fx.wet_reflection((96,82,62), t, int(bx)+50, 3.5, .65, .12))
    # Older residential blocks behind the sniper roof give it an urban horizon.
    for bx,w,h,z in ((-21,13,17,61),(-8,9,20,66)):
        add(r, box(w,h,7,(36,39,43),center=(bx,h/2,z),seg=2))
        add(r, box(w+.3,.35,7.3,(56,56,53),center=(bx,h,z)))
        for floor in range(2,int(h/2.4)):
            for j in range(int(w/2)):
                x=bx-w/2+1+j*2
                lit=(floor*3+j)%7==0
                add(r, box(.72,1.05,.04,(106,91,69) if lit else (18,25,32),
                            center=(x,floor*2.4,z-3.52),emissive=lit))
    # Side streets complete the horizon when coverage turns east/west.
    # Fixed world coordinates are shared by the river, roof and radio takes.
    for bx,z,w,h in ((-42,48,10,15),(38,44,12,16),(-35,68,9,23),(37,70,13,21)):
        add(r,box(w,h,9,(34,39,43),center=(bx,h/2,z),seg=2))
        add(r,box(w+.3,.3,9.3,(58,57,53),center=(bx,h+.1,z)))
        for floor in range(1,int(h/2.3)):
            for j in range(int(w/2)):
                x=bx-w/2+1+j*2
                lit=(floor+j)%6==0
                add(r,box(.85,1.15,.06,(126,104,70) if lit else (18,29,38),
                            center=(x,floor*2.3,z-4.55),emissive=lit))
    for i,h in enumerate((13,18,16,22,17,14,20,15,18)):
        x=-55+i*13
        add(r, box(11,h,7,(20,26,35), center=(x,h/2,77), seg=4))
        add(r, box(11.3,.28,7.3,(32,39,48), center=(x,h+.1,77)))


def roof_set(r, t, sniper, door, add, spr, fx):
    sx,sy,sz=sniper
    add(r, box(8,sy+.6,10,(31,31,36), center=(sx,sy/2-.3,sz+3.9), seg=2, skip=('top',)))
    hole_front = sz + ROOF_DOOR_Z + .5
    for x0,z0,x1,z1 in ((sx-4,sz-1.1,sx-.82,sz+8.9),
                          (sx+.82,sz-1.1,sx+4,sz+8.9),
                          (sx-.82,sz-1.1,sx+.82,hole_front),
                          (sx-.82,sz+7.6,sx+.82,sz+8.9)):
        add(r, quad_xz(x0,z0,x1,z1,sy+.012,(40,42,45),seg=.8,layer=2))
    for i in range(STAIR_COUNT):
        z = hole_front + i * STAIR_RUN
        y = sy - i * STAIR_DROP
        add(r, box(1.55,.12,STAIR_RUN,(52,53,49),center=(sx,y-.06,z)))
    for x in (-3.2,-1.6,1.6,3.2):
        add(r, box(.02,.014,9.8,(55,56,56), center=(sx+x,sy+.02,sz+3.9)))
    for x in (-4,4):
        add(r, box(.28,.65,10,(56,54,51), center=(sx+x,sy+.325,sz+3.9),seg=2))
    add(r, box(8,.45,.28,(57,54,50), center=(sx,sy+.225,sz-1.1),seg=2))
    front=sz+ROOF_DOOR_Z
    # Hollow stair-hut: jambs and lintel leave a 1.4 x 2.45 m clear aperture.
    for x in (-1.22,1.22):
        add(r, box(1.0,3.05,.32,(49,46,42), center=(sx+x,sy+1.525,front),seg=1))
        add(r, box(.24,3.05,3.1,(44,43,42), center=(sx+x*1.36,sy+1.525,front+1.45),seg=1))
    add(r, box(3.4,.6,.36,(64,60,52), center=(sx,sy+2.75,front)))
    add(r, box(3.65,.22,3.45,(67,64,56), center=(sx,sy+3.15,front+1.45)))
    add(r, box(3.4,3.05,.24,(18,22,26), center=(sx,sy+1.525,front+2.95)))
    for x in (-.73,.73):
        add(r, box(.09,2.48,.11,(89,86,75), center=(sx+x,sy+1.24,front-.18)))
    add(r, box(1.55,.1,.42,(73,71,63), center=(sx,sy+.035,front)))
    # Hinged panel rotates into the opening. No glowing card over a solid box.
    R=rot_y(90*door)
    hinge=(sx+.69,sy,front-.08)
    panel=box(1.38,2.44,.065,(41,51,54),center=(-.69,1.22,0))
    for w,h,d,c,p in [(1.22,.08,.025,(74,82,81),(-.69,2.27,-.045)),
                      (.14,.045,.055,(133,127,109),(-1.15,1.26,-.07))]:
        panel.add(box(w,h,d,c,center=p))
    verts=[tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(m_apply(R,v),hinge)) for v in panel.verts]
    r.add_dynamic(verts, [(f[0],f[1],f[2],f[3],None,f[4]) for f in panel.faces])
    add(r, box(.3,.14,.15,(226,187,120), center=(sx,sy+2.62,front-.22),emissive=True))
    spr(r, (sx,sy+2.62,front-.26),fx.glow((210,167,99),.9,intensity=.42))
    # Caged bulb inside the hut: motivates the doorway spill from outside and
    # keeps the interior take (camera looks out through the door) lit.
    add(r, box(.12,.09,.12,(255,226,170), center=(sx+.95,sy+2.25,front+1.15),emissive=True))
    spr(r, (sx+.95,sy+2.25,front+1.1),fx.glow((255,206,140),.8,intensity=.5))
    # The spill LIGHTS the set: a haze volume hanging under the bulb, a lit
    # deck patch inside the hut, and a warm pool on the roof outside the
    # aperture where the light actually lands (a floating halo alone reads as
    # an unmotivated sticker). Kept under the highlight so the actor stepping
    # through stays a readable silhouette, not a white-out.
    add(r, quad_xz(sx-1.05, front-0.05, sx+1.05, front+1.6, sy+.008,
                   (40, 28, 14), seg=.6, emissive=True))
    add(r, quad_xz(sx-1.15, front-1.75, sx+1.15, front-0.10, sy+.012,
                   (30, 21, 10), seg=.6, emissive=True))
    spr(r, (sx+.95, sy+2.05, front+1.15), fx.light_shaft((255, 206, 140), 2.05, .35, 1.1,
                                                         t, 7, intensity=.26))
    spr(r, (sx+.95, sy+1.55, front+1.15), fx.haze((255, 206, 140), 1.1, t, 7, intensity=.11))
    spr(r, (sx, sy+0.75, front-.45), fx.haze((226, 170, 90), 1.1, t, 8, intensity=.07))
    spr(r, (sx, sy+.03, front-.4), fx.wet_reflection((181,135,79),t,32,2.2,.65,.18))
    for x,z in ((-2.75,2.7),(2.7,6.8)):
        add(r, box(.9,.7,1.15,(45,48,50), center=(sx+x,sy+.35,sz+z)))
        add(r, box(1.1,.13,1.35,(64,65,63), center=(sx+x,sy+.76,sz+z)))
    for row in range(3):
        for col in range(3):
            add(r, box(.9,1.2,.04,(48,48,43) if (row+col)%4==0 else (17,24,29),
                        center=(sx-2.4+col*2.4,sy-2-row*2.2,sz-1.12)))
    add(r, box(.07,3.5,.07,(57,61,65),center=(sx+3.1,sy+1.75,sz+5.7)))
    add(r, box(.12,.12,.12,(162,40,35),center=(sx+3.1,sy+3.5,sz+5.7),emissive=True))


============================== FILE: cutscenes\m5fx3d.py ==============================
"""m5fx3d.py - FX kit for the Mission 5 3D cutscenes (m5martial3d / m5mid3d).

The production layers the M2 oil-rig cinematic has and M5 lacked:

    light sprites   glow / sodium_lamp / window_glow / crt_bloom / scope_glint /
                    wet_reflection / dust_motes / flash / sparks - all
                    ``draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z)`` callbacks for ``r.add_sprite``
                    (depth-scaled, depth-masked on GL, painter-sorted on software)
    volumetrics     light_shaft (a practical's cone through the haze) /
                    haze (low ground fog around a light) / glint (wet sheen)
    rain3d          world-space rain in two depth bands around the camera, tinted
                    near practical lights, plus ground splash crowns
    night_sky       horizon-locked gradient, stars + moon with camera parallax,
                    drifting cloud bands, sodium sky-glow, horizon mist
    cig_smoke       a lit cigarette's wisp: puffs that expand, drift and fade
    set_cam         smoothstep framing + handheld drift + roll + decaying shake;
                    every non-scripted motion is zeroed under reduced motion

Dependency-light on purpose: pygame + math only at import time (core.state is
read lazily), so any cutscenes part can import it without load-order cycles.
Additive glows are pre-baked RGB surfaces blitted with BLEND_ADD and cached by
(colour, radius bucket) - no per-frame Surface allocation in steady state.
Time is in MILLISECONDS (the M5 time base).
"""
import math
import random

import pygame

__all__ = ["reduced_motion", "glow", "sodium_lamp", "window_glow", "crt_bloom",
           "scope_glint", "wet_reflection", "dust_motes", "flash", "sparks",
           "rain3d", "night_sky", "handheld", "shake", "set_cam", "SODIUM", "FX_LAYER",
           "light_shaft", "haze", "glint", "cig_smoke"]

SODIUM = (255, 168, 84)      # low-pressure sodium: the colour of the city at night
FX_LAYER = 6                 # same layer M2 uses for its practicals
_TAU = math.pi * 2.0
_CACHE = {}


# ── settings ──
def reduced_motion():
    """True when the player turned on reduced motion (same flag M2 reads)."""
    try:
        from core.state import STATE  # lazy: keep this module free of game imports at load
        return bool(getattr(STATE, "reduced_motion", False))
    except Exception:
        return False


# ── baked additive shapes ──
def _q(c, steps=12):
    """Quantise a colour so per-frame flicker reuses cached surfaces."""
    return tuple(min(255, max(0, int(round(v / steps) * steps))) for v in c)


def _bucket(rad):
    rad = int(rad)
    if rad > 96:
        return rad - rad % 8
    if rad > 24:
        return rad - rad % 3
    return rad


def _halo(col, rad, power=2.2):
    """Round additive glow: black RGB surface, colour falling off to 0 at ``rad``."""
    rad = max(2, min(220, _bucket(rad)))
    col = _q(col)
    key = ("h", col, rad, power)
    s = _CACHE.get(key)
    if s is None:
        s = _halo_smooth(col, rad, power)
        _CACHE[key] = s
    return s


# 4x4 Bayer matrix, centred on 0 (-0.5..0.5 LSB): breaks the 8-bit steps of a
# dim, wide falloff into a fine grain instead of visible contour rings.
_BAYER = ((0, 8, 2, 10), (12, 4, 14, 6), (3, 11, 1, 9), (15, 7, 13, 5))


def _halo_smooth(col, rad, power):
    """Per-pixel radial falloff (the old version stacked <= 18 flat circles,
    which read as hard concentric bands on every lamp in M5)."""
    d = rad * 2 + 2
    try:
        import numpy as np
        import pygame.surfarray as sa
        ax = np.arange(d, dtype=np.float32) - (rad + 1)
        rr = np.sqrt(ax[:, None] ** 2 + ax[None, :] ** 2) / float(rad)
        f = np.clip(1.0 - rr, 0.0, 1.0)
        k = f ** power + 0.04 * f
        bay = (np.array(_BAYER, dtype=np.float32) + 0.5) / 16.0 - 0.5
        dith = np.tile(bay, (d // 4 + 1, d // 4 + 1))[:d, :d]
        arr = np.empty((d, d, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
        for ch in range(3):
            v = k * col[ch] + dith * (k > 0)
            arr[:, :, ch] = np.clip(np.round(v), 0, 255).astype(np.uint8)
        s = pygame.Surface((d, d))
        sa.blit_array(s, arr)
        return s
    except ImportError:                       # numpy-less fallback: many fine rings
        s = pygame.Surface((d, d))
        s.fill((0, 0, 0))
        steps = max(8, rad)
        for i in range(steps, 0, -1):
            f = i / steps
            k = (1.0 - f) ** power + 0.04 * (1.0 - f)
            pygame.draw.circle(s, (int(col[0] * k), int(col[1] * k), int(col[2] * k)),
                               (rad + 1, rad + 1), max(1, int(rad * f)))
        return s


def _ellipse(col, rx, ry, power=2.0):
    rx, ry = max(2, min(260, _bucket(rx))), max(2, min(260, _bucket(ry)))
    col = _q(col)
    key = ("e", col, rx, ry, power)
    s = _CACHE.get(key)
    if s is None:
        base = _halo(col, 48, power)
        s = pygame.transform.smoothscale(base, (rx * 2 + 2, ry * 2 + 2))
        _CACHE[key] = s
    return s


def _add_at(s, img, cx, cy):
    s.blit(img, (int(cx - img.get_width() / 2), int(cy - img.get_height() / 2)),
           special_flags=pygame.BLEND_ADD)


def _scale(c, k):
    return (min(255, int(c[0] * k)), min(255, int(c[1] * k)), min(255, int(c[2] * k)))


def _flick(t, seed, amount):
    """0..1 brightness multiplier: two incommensurate sines + a rare dip."""
    if amount <= 0:
        return 1.0
    w = 0.5 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.011 + seed * 3.1) + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.0047 + seed)
    dip = 0.55 if (int(t // 90 + seed * 7) % 37) == 0 else 1.0
    return (1.0 - amount * w) * dip


# ── light sprites (draw(s, sx, sy, scale_px_per_m, z)) ──
def glow(col, radius_m, t=0, pulse=0.0, flicker=0.0, seed=0, core=None, intensity=1.0,
         max_px=200):
    """Soft additive halo on a practical light. ``core`` = small hot centre."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        k = intensity * _flick(t, seed, flicker) * (1.0 + pulse * math.sin(t * 0.004 + seed))
        # A fixture halo is not a light source on foreground faces.
        k = min(.18, k * .35)
        rad = min(max_px, 28, radius_m * scale)
        if rad < 1.5 or k <= 0.02:
            return
        _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, k), rad), sx, sy)
        if core is not None and rad > 3:
            _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(core, k), max(2, rad * 0.22), 1.2), sx, sy)
    return draw


def sodium_lamp(t, seed=0, radius_m=2.2, intensity=0.85):
    """Street lamp: wide warm pool + hot near-white core, barely-there flicker."""
    return glow(SODIUM, radius_m, t, flicker=0.06, seed=seed, core=(255, 226, 170),
                intensity=intensity)


def window_glow(col, w_m, h_m, intensity=0.55, t=0, flicker=0.0, seed=0):
    """Soft rectangular-ish glow for a lit window / screen / door."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        k = intensity * _flick(t, seed, flicker)
        rx, ry = w_m * scale * 1.1, h_m * scale * 1.1
        if rx < 1.5 or ry < 1.5:
            return
        _add_at(s, _ellipse(_scale(col, k), min(260, rx), min(260, ry)), sx, sy)
    return draw


def crt_bloom(t, col=(120, 160, 220), w_m=0.6, h_m=0.45, intensity=0.6, seed=0):
    """Cathode-ray bloom: cool, breathing with the picture, slight 50 Hz roll."""
    k = intensity * (0.82 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.0063 + seed) + 0.06 * math.sin(t * 0.031))
    return window_glow(col, w_m * 1.6, h_m * 1.8, k)


def scope_glint(strength, col=(255, 236, 210)):
    """Lens glint off an optic: halo + thin cross flare. strength 0..1."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        if strength <= 0.02:
            return
        rad = max(4, min(60, 0.25 * scale)) * (0.6 + 0.6 * strength)
        _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, strength), rad * 2.2), sx, sy)
        ln = rad * (3.0 + 3.0 * strength)
        c = _scale(col, 0.75 * strength)
        pygame.draw.line(s, c, (sx - ln, sy), (sx + ln, sy), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(s, c, (sx, sy - ln * 0.45), (sx, sy + ln * 0.45), 1)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, _scale(col, strength), (int(sx), int(sy)), max(1, int(rad * 0.25)))
    return draw


def wet_reflection(col, t, seed=0, length_m=2.4, width_m=0.35, intensity=0.5):
    """Light smeared on wet ground/water: a vertical, wavering stack of dashes
    running DOWN-screen from the anchor (anchor = where the light meets the ground)."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        w = width_m * scale
        ln = length_m * scale
        if w < 1.0:
            return
        n = 9
        for i in range(n):
            f = i / (n - 1)
            k = intensity * (1.0 - f) ** 1.4 * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.009 + i * 1.9 + seed))
            if k <= 0.03:
                continue
            x = sx + math.sin(t * 0.0045 + i * 1.3 + seed) * w * 0.45
            y = sy + f * ln
            _add_at(s, _ellipse(_scale(col, k), max(2, w * (1.0 - 0.4 * f)), max(2, ln / n * 0.9)),
                    x, y)
    return draw


def dust_motes(t, seed=0, count=26, spread_m=(1.6, 1.4), col=(150, 140, 120)):
    """Slow particles hanging in a light beam (anchor = beam centre)."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    motes = [(rng.uniform(-1, 1), rng.uniform(-1, 1), rng.uniform(0.3, 1.0),
              rng.uniform(0, _TAU)) for _ in range(count)]

    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        ax, ay = spread_m[0] * scale, spread_m[1] * scale
        if ax < 4:
            return
        for ux, uy, b, ph in motes:
            x = sx + (ux + 0.08 * math.sin(t * 0.0005 + ph)) * ax
            y = sy + (((uy + 1.0 + t * 0.00004 * b) % 2.0) - 1.0) * ay
            tw = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 0.002 + ph * 3.0)
            _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, b * tw), max(2, scale * 0.012)), x, y)
    return draw


def flash(age_ms, col=(255, 236, 200), radius_m=3.0, dur_ms=420):
    """Blast / muzzle flash: big additive bloom that collapses fast."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        if age_ms < 0 or age_ms > dur_ms:
            return
        k = (1.0 - age_ms / dur_ms) ** 2
        _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, k), min(220, radius_m * scale * (0.6 + 0.6 * k))), sx, sy)
    return draw


def sparks(seed, age_ms, col=(255, 200, 120), n=18, speed_m=4.0, dur_ms=700):
    """Ballistic sparks thrown from the anchor (screen space, depth-scaled)."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    parts = [(rng.uniform(-math.pi, 0.15), rng.uniform(0.35, 1.0)) for _ in range(n)]

    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        if age_ms < 0 or age_ms > dur_ms:
            return
        a = age_ms / 1000.0
        fade = 1.0 - age_ms / dur_ms
        for ang, v in parts:
            vx, vy = math.cos(ang) * v * speed_m, math.sin(ang) * v * speed_m
            x = sx + vx * a * scale
            y = sy + (vy * a + 4.9 * a * a) * scale
            tx, ty = x - vx * 0.03 * scale, y - (vy + 9.8 * a) * 0.03 * scale
            pygame.draw.line(s, _scale(col, fade), (tx, ty), (x, y), 1)
    return draw


# ── volumetrics / sheen ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
def light_shaft(col, height_m=5.0, top_m=0.9, bot_m=2.1, t=0, seed=0,
                intensity=0.34, tilt=0.10):
    """A practical's cone through the haze: anchored at the lamp head, a soft
    stack of light falling and widening to the ground. Screen-space cheat
    anchored in 3D (same idiom as wet_reflection): the shaft hangs along
    screen-down from the light, sways with the wind and breathes with the
    flicker, so the halo reads as a VOLUME of lit haze, not a flat sticker."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        h = height_m * scale
        wtop, wbot = top_m * scale, bot_m * scale
        if h < 6 or wbot < 2:
            return
        k = intensity * _flick(t, seed, 0.10)
        sway = math.sin(t * 0.0011 + seed * 2.3) * tilt * wbot
        n = max(3, int(h // 22))
        for i in range(n):
            f = i / (n - 1.0)
            w = wtop + (wbot - wtop) * f
            kk = k * (1.0 - 0.45 * f) * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.003 + seed + i))
            if kk <= 0.015:
                continue
            _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, kk), w, 2.4), sx + sway * f, sy + f * h)
    return draw


def haze(col, radius_m=3.0, t=0, seed=0, intensity=0.16):
    """Low ground fog: a big, slow, very soft additive blob that breathes -
    the medium a light shaft needs to be visible in."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        rad = radius_m * scale
        if rad < 3:
            return
        k = intensity * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.0007 + seed * 1.9))
        rad = int(rad * (1.0 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 0.0009 + seed)))
        _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, k), rad, 2.8), sx, sy)
    return draw


def glint(col, radius_m=0.35, t=0, seed=0, intensity=0.8, rate=1.0):
    """Small shimmering highlight: a wet shoulder catching the key, an ember's
    breath, glass. Faster and tighter than glow()."""
    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        rad = radius_m * scale
        if rad < 1.2:
            return
        k = intensity * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 0.004 * rate + seed * 2.2))
        _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, k * 0.6), rad * 2.0), sx, sy)
        _add_at(s, _halo(_scale(col, k), max(1.5, rad * 0.5), 1.3), sx, sy)
    return draw


def cig_smoke(t, seed=0, drift=(0.12, -0.5), intensity=0.30, life_ms=2600):
    """A lit cigarette's wisp: puffs that expand, rise and fade. Alpha-blended
    (smoke DIMS, so it must not be additive). Anchor at the ember."""
    puffs = []
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    for i in range(5):
        puffs.append((rng.uniform(0.0, 1.0), rng.uniform(0.7, 1.3), rng.uniform(0, _TAU)))
    strip = None

    def draw(s, sx, sy, scale, z):
        nonlocal strip
        if scale < 2:
            return
        if strip is None:
            r = 26
            strip = pygame.Surface((r * 2, r * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            for i in range(r, 0, -1):
                f = (1 - i / r) ** 1.6
                pygame.draw.circle(strip, (176, 172, 168, int(120 * f)), (r, r), i)
        for ph, sp, off in puffs:
            age = ((t / float(life_ms) + ph) % 1.0)
            if age <= 0.02:
                continue
            rise = age * .45 * scale * sp
            px = sx + (drift[0] + math.sin(off + age * 5.0) * 0.35) * age * scale * sp
            py = sy - rise + drift[1] * age * scale * 0.3
            r = (0.8 + age * 2.0) * scale / 6.0
            a = int(150 * intensity / 0.30 * (1 - age) ** 1.4)
            if a > 4 and r > 0.6:
                img = pygame.transform.scale(strip, (int(r * 2), int(r * 2)))
                img.set_alpha(min(255, a))
                s.blit(img, (int(px - r), int(py - r)))
    return draw


# ── rain ──
def rain3d(r, t, seed=0, n_near=70, n_far=150, lights=(), col=(96,104,120),
           wind=(.35,.1), ground=0.0, splashes=10, layer=FX_LAYER,
           near_d0=1.2, near_ln=.5, surface=None):
    """World-lattice drops; contact ripples only on declared horizontal surfaces.

    No lens-space splash sprites. The falling drop and its impact share one
    stable world position and clock; walls/void/interiors cannot emit crowns.
    """
    from engine3d.core import quad_xz
    cx, cy, cz = r.cam
    total = n_near + n_far
    for i in range(total):
        u = ((math.sin((i+1)*12.9898+seed*78.233)*43758.5453) % 1.0)
        v = ((math.sin((i+1)*4.1414+seed*9.17)*24634.6345) % 1.0)
        x = math.floor(cx/8)*8 + (u*2-1)*22
        z = math.floor(cz/8)*8 + (v*2-1)*22
        hit = surface(x,z) if surface is not None else None
        floor = ground if hit is None else hit
        phase = (t*.009 + u*97 + v*31) % 12.0
        y = floor + 12.0 - phase
        distance = math.sqrt((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2+(z-cz)**2)
        if distance < max(2.5, near_d0):
            continue
        if phase < 11.72:
            ln = min(near_ln if distance < 7 else .42, y-floor)
            r.add_line3d((x,y,z),(x-wind[0]*ln*.2,y-ln,z-wind[1]*ln*.2),
                         _scale(col,.45),1,layer=layer)
        elif hit is not None and splashes:
            age = (phase-11.72)/.28
            w = .018+.065*age
            # Flat, dim contact ring at the collision plane; no airborne rays.
            for a,b in ((-w,w),(w,-w)):
                r.add_line3d((x+a,hit+.016,z-w*.4),(x+b,hit+.016,z+w*.4),
                             _scale(col,.35*(1-age)),1,layer=2)


# ── sky ──
def night_sky(r, buf, t, top, bot, *, stars=60, moon=False, clouds=4, sodium=None,
              mist=(26, 30, 40), seed=0, star_cut=0.0):
    """Fill ``buf`` with a night sky locked to the camera's horizon: gradient,
    stars + moon parked at fixed azimuths (so they parallax with yaw), drifting
    cloud bands, a warm city sky-glow (``sodium`` colour) and a mist band.
    ``star_cut``: 0 clear .. 1 fully overcast."""
    w, h = buf.get_size()
    hy = int(max(-h, min(h * 2, r.horizon_y())))
    key = ("sky", w, h, top, bot)
    grad = _CACHE.get(key)
    if grad is None:
        gh = h * 3
        grad = pygame.Surface((w, gh))
        for y in range(gh):
            f = min(1.0, max(0.0, (y - h * 0.2) / (h * 1.6)))
            f = f ** 0.8
            pygame.draw.line(grad, tuple(int(a + (b - a) * f) for a, b in zip(top, bot)),
                             (0, y), (w, y))
        _CACHE[key] = grad
    buf.blit(grad, (0, 0), area=pygame.Rect(0, max(0, min(2 * h, int(h * 1.8) - hy)), w, h))
    yaw = math.degrees(math.atan2(r.fwd[0], r.fwd[2]))
    px_deg = w / max(1.0, r.fov)
    if stars and star_cut < 1.0 and hy > 4:
        rng = random.Random(seed + 404)
        for i in range(stars):
            az, el, tw = rng.uniform(-180, 180), rng.uniform(0.04, 1.0), rng.random()
            if rng.random() < star_cut:
                continue
            x = int(w / 2 + ((az - yaw + 180) % 360 - 180) * px_deg)
            y = int(hy - el * min(hy, h) * 0.98)
            if 0 <= x < w and 0 <= y < hy - 3:
                b = int((60 + 120 * tw) * (0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 0.0017 + i)))
                buf.set_at((x, y), (b, b, min(255, int(b * 1.12))))
    if moon and hy > 10:
        mx = w / 2 + ((moon[0] - yaw + 180) % 360 - 180) * px_deg
        my = hy - moon[1] * px_deg
        if -60 < mx < w + 60:
            _add_at(buf, _halo((60, 66, 80), max(12, px_deg * 4.0)), mx, my)
            pygame.draw.circle(buf, (214, 220, 226), (int(mx), int(my)), max(2, int(px_deg * 0.55)))
    for i in range(clouds):
        cw = int(w * (0.45 + 0.12 * i))
        ch = max(6, int(h * (0.05 + 0.02 * i)))
        drift = t * 0.004 * (1 + 0.4 * i)
        x = int((i * w * 0.37 + drift - yaw * px_deg * (0.9 + 0.05 * i)) % (w + cw)) - cw
        y = int(hy - h * (0.12 + 0.11 * i))
        if y + ch < 0 or y > h:
            continue
        band = _CACHE.get(("cloud", cw, ch))
        if band is None:
            band = pygame.Surface((cw, ch), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            for inset, a in ((0, 30), (1, 26), (2, 20), (3, 14)):
                pygame.draw.ellipse(band, (6, 8, 12, a),
                                    (inset * cw // 10, inset * ch // 9,
                                     cw - inset * cw // 5, ch - inset * 2 * ch // 9))
            _CACHE[("cloud", cw, ch)] = band
        buf.blit(band, (x, y))
    if sodium is not None and -h < hy < h * 2:
        _add_at(buf, _ellipse(sodium, w * 0.7, max(8, h * 0.2)), w * 0.5, hy)
    if mist is not None and -20 < hy < h + 20:
        _add_at(buf, _ellipse(mist, w * 0.9, max(4, h * 0.05)), w * 0.5, hy)


# ── camera ──
def handheld(t, amp, seed=0):
    """Breathing-camera offset (m): low-frequency sines, never a shake."""
    if amp <= 0 or reduced_motion():
        return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    a = t * 0.001 * _TAU
    x = amp * (0.6 * math.sin(a * 0.37 + seed) + 0.4 * math.sin(a * 0.13 + seed * 2.1))
    y = amp * 0.7 * (0.6 * math.sin(a * 0.61 + seed * 1.3) + 0.4 * math.sin(a * 0.21 + seed * .7))
    z = amp * 0.4 * math.sin(a * 0.17 + seed * 3.3)
    return (x, y, z)


def shake(t, t_hit, dur_ms, amp):
    """Decaying impact shake -> (dx, dy, roll_deg, px). Zero under reduced motion."""
    if amp <= 0 or t < t_hit or t > t_hit + dur_ms or reduced_motion():
        return (0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0)
    k = (1.0 - (t - t_hit) / float(dur_ms)) ** 2
    a = t * 0.06
    return (amp * k * math.sin(a * 1.7), amp * k * 0.7 * math.cos(a * 2.3),
            min(1.4, amp * k * 30.0) * math.sin(a * 1.1), int(round(2 * k * math.sin(a * 3.1))))


def set_cam(r, t, eye, tgt, fov, hh=0.0, seed=0, roll=0.0, shk=None):
    """set_camera + handheld drift + roll (+ an optional ``shake`` tuple).
    Returns the 2D pixel offset to apply after presenting (0 if none)."""
    h = handheld(t, hh, seed)
    dx = dy = sroll = 0.0
    px = 0
    if shk is not None:
        dx, dy, sroll, px = shk
    rm = reduced_motion()
    eye = (eye[0] + h[0] + dx, eye[1] + h[1] + dy, eye[2] + h[2])
    tgt = (tgt[0] + h[0] * 0.35 + dx * 0.5, tgt[1] + h[1] * 0.35 + dy * 0.5, tgt[2])
    rl = 0.0 if rm else max(-1.4, min(1.4, roll + sroll))
    r.set_camera(eye, tgt, fov, roll=rl)
    return 0 if rm else px


============================== FILE: cutscenes\m5harbour_art.py ==============================
"""Authored blocky harbour art for M5; canonical people and motion stay intact.
All details are editable engine3d meshes, not pasted screenshots. Practical
spill/contact shadows are baked world-space colour; no claim of ray tracing.
"""
from functools import lru_cache
import math
import random
import pygame
from engine3d import Mesh,box,prism,quad_xz,v_add,v_mul,v_cross,v_norm
from core.config import resource_path

PALETTE={'brick':(87,58,46),'mortar':(39,43,43),'stone':(87,96,92),
         'steel':(43,62,66),'iron':(24,36,40),'roof':(46,58,64),
         'warm':(226,164,83),'glass':(23,48,58)}

def colour(c,amount):return tuple(max(0,min(255,int(v+amount))) for v in c)

def spill(pos,base):
    """Practical lamps tint nearby actual surfaces before directional baking."""
    x,y,z=pos
    lights=((-5.45,2.75,-2.7,2.4,1.0),(-8.8,2.65,-2.7,1.8,.70),
            (4.7,2.3,-6.85,2.5,.45),(-5.4,6.3,25.9,2.7,.55))
    strength=0
    for lx,ly,lz,r,gain in lights:
        d=((x-lx)**2+(z-lz)**2+((y-ly)*.62)**2)/r**2
        strength+=math.exp(-d*1.2)*gain
    return tuple(min(255,int(base[i]+(104,57,17)[i]*strength)) for i in range(3))


def plane(m,o,u,v,w,h,c,em=False):
    p1=v_add(o,v_mul(u,w));p2=v_add(p1,v_mul(v,h));p3=v_add(o,v_mul(v,h))
    # Double-sided for tiny signs/decals; always on the actual surface plane.
    m.face((o,p3,p2,p1),c,2,True,em)


def masonry(axis,at,a0,a1,y0,y1,seed=0,base=None,cell=.55,reverse=False):
    """Cell-centred mortar and brick faces replace (not overlap) large wall faces.
    This avoids the reference painter's coplanar-average-depth checkerboard.
    """
    rng=random.Random(seed);base=base or PALETTE['brick'];m=Mesh()
    rows=max(1,round((y1-y0)/.22));rh=(y1-y0)/rows
    for row in range(rows):
        y=y0+row*rh;offset=cell*.5*(row%2);a=a0-offset
        while a<a1:
            lo=max(a0,a);hi=min(a1,a+cell);w=hi-lo
            if w>.018:
                c=colour(base,rng.randrange(-7,8));hh=rh-.018
                if axis=='x':o=(at,y,lo);u=(0,0,1);n=(1,0,0)
                elif reverse:o=(hi,y,at);u=(-1,0,0);n=(0,0,1)
                else:o=(lo,y,at);u=(1,0,0);n=(0,0,-1)
                center=v_add(o,v_add(v_mul(u,w/2),(0,rh/2,0)))
                plane(m,o,u,(0,1,0),w,rh,spill(center,colour(c,-17)))
                face_o=v_add(o,v_add(v_mul(u,.009),v_add((0,.009,0),v_mul(n,.012))))
                plane(m,face_o,u,(0,1,0),w-.018,hh,spill(center,c))
            a+=cell
    return m


# Maru's exit: a steel service door in the south alley wall, warm room behind.
DOOR_X0,DOOR_X1,DOOR_H,DOOR_Z=-9.52,-8.54,2.18,-4.2
DOOR_HINGE=(DOOR_X0,0.0,-4.20)
_ROOM_WARM=(150,96,55)


def door_room():
    """Static frame + lit back room. Only readable through the open door."""
    m=Mesh();iron=PALETTE['iron'];mortar=PALETTE['mortar']
    for x in (DOOR_X0-.05,DOOR_X1+.05):
        m.add(box(.10,DOOR_H+.08,.30,(52,58,56),center=(x,(DOOR_H+.08)/2,-4.2)))
    m.add(box(DOOR_X1-DOOR_X0+.20,.10,.30,(52,58,56),center=((DOOR_X0+DOOR_X1)/2,DOOR_H+.05,-4.2)))
    m.add(box(DOOR_X1-DOOR_X0+.10,.05,.36,(78,82,72),center=((DOOR_X0+DOOR_X1)/2,.025,-4.2)))
    # Room shell (outer faces dark, inner warm planes slightly inset).
    x0,x1,z0,z1,h=-10.6,-7.5,-6.4,-4.33,2.75
    m.add(box(x1-x0,h,.2,mortar,center=((x0+x1)/2,h/2,z0-.1)))
    for x in (x0-.1,x1+.1):m.add(box(.2,h,z1-z0,mortar,center=(x,h/2,(z0+z1)/2)))
    m.add(box(x1-x0+.4,.2,z1-z0+.2,mortar,center=((x0+x1)/2,h+.1,(z0+z1)/2)))
    plane(m,(x0,0,z0+.01),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),x1-x0,h,colour(_ROOM_WARM,-8))
    plane(m,(x0+.01,0,z0),(0,0,1),(0,1,0),z1-z0,h,colour(_ROOM_WARM,-26))
    plane(m,(x1-.01,0,z0),(0,0,1),(0,1,0),z1-z0,h,colour(_ROOM_WARM,-26))
    m.add(quad_xz(x0,z0,x1,z1,.004,(84,60,41)))
    # Props inside: shelf with boxes, a hanging bulb (emissive), coat on a hook.
    m.add(box(1.6,.06,.35,(70,52,36),center=(-9.0,1.35,z0+.2)))
    for i,x in enumerate((-9.6,-9.2,-8.7)):
        m.add(box(.3,.26+.06*(i%2),.28,(112,88,58),center=(x,1.51+.03*(i%2),z0+.2)))
    m.add(box(.012,.55,.012,(30,30,30),center=(-9.03,h-.28,-5.35)))
    m.add(box(.10,.13,.10,(255,214,150),center=(-9.03,h-.62,-5.35),emissive=True))
    m.add(box(.34,.9,.12,(46,40,36),center=(-8.0,1.2,z0+.08)))

def door_leaf(open_k):
    """Door leaf swung into the room; open_k 0 = shut, 1 = ~105 deg."""
    a=math.radians(105*open_k);w=DOOR_X1-DOOR_X0;hx,_,hz=DOOR_HINGE
    ux,uz=math.cos(a),-math.sin(a)          # along the leaf, hinge -> latch
    nx,nz=math.sin(a),math.cos(a)           # leaf normal, alley side
    m=Mesh()
    def quad(s0,s1,y0,y1,off,c):
        m.face(tuple((hx+ux*s+nx*off,y,hz+uz*s+nz*off)
                     for s,y in ((s0,y0),(s1,y0),(s1,y1),(s0,y1))),c,2,True)
    quad(.01,w-.01,.02,DOOR_H-.02,.025,(58,70,68))      # alley face
    quad(.01,w-.01,.02,DOOR_H-.02,-.025,(96,74,52))     # room face, warm-lit
    quad(.15,w-.12,1.0,1.06,.032,(120,122,104))         # push bar
    quad(.05,w-.05,.05,.32,.030,(76,86,82))             # kick plate
    quad(w-.16,w-.10,1.02,1.16,.034,(150,146,118))      # handle
    return m


def door_spill(open_k):
    """Warm light wedge on the alley floor through the opening (no ray tracing)."""
    m=Mesh()
    if open_k<=.02:return m
    k=min(1.0,open_k*1.4)
    w0,w1=DOOR_X0+.04,DOOR_X1-.04;z0=-4.06;z1=-4.06+1.9*k
    for i,(a,b,amt) in enumerate(((0,.35,1.0),(.35,.7,.62),(.7,1.0,.30))):
        za,zb=z0+(z1-z0)*a,z0+(z1-z0)*b
        spread=lambda f:.35*f
        c=tuple(int(base+(warm-base)*amt*k) for base,warm in zip((52,60,58),(176,122,70)))
        m.face(((w0-spread(a),.016,za),(w1+spread(a),.016,za),(w1+spread(b),.016,zb),(w0-spread(b),.016,zb)),c,2,True)
    # Bright core of the doorway itself (the lit room's glow on the threshold).
    m.face(((w0,.02,-4.06),(w1,.02,-4.06),(w1,.02,-4.18),(w0,.02,-4.18)),(214,158,96),2,True,True)
    return m


@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
def lettering(text,width):
    """Merge horizontal glyph runs into shallow world-space geometry."""
    try:font=pygame.font.Font(resource_path('assets/fonts/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf'),28)
    except (OSError,pygame.error):font=pygame.font.SysFont('monospace',28)
    surf=font.render(text,False,(255,255,255),(0,0,0));scale=width/max(1,surf.get_width());runs=[]
    for y in range(surf.get_height()):
        x=0
        while x<surf.get_width():
            if surf.get_at((x,y))[0]<128:x+=1;continue
            start=x
            while x<surf.get_width() and surf.get_at((x,y))[0]>=128:x+=1
            runs.append((start*scale,(surf.get_height()-y-1)*scale,(x-start)*scale,scale))
    return runs,surf.get_height()*scale


def text_mesh(text,o,u,width,c=(192,192,162)):
    m=Mesh();runs,h=lettering(text,width)
    for x,y,w,dy in runs:plane(m,v_add(o,v_add(v_mul(u,x),(0,y,0))),u,(0,1,0),w,dy,c)
    return m


def window_z(x,y,z,w,h,warm=False,seed=0):
    m=Mesh();frame=PALETTE['steel'];iron=PALETTE['iron']
    m.add(box(w+.14,h+.13,.08,iron,center=(x,y,z),skip=('front','back',)))
    # Several panes, with one dim unlit pane to avoid a uniform checkerboard.
    for ix in (-1,1):
        for iy in (-1,1):
            c=(183,133,68) if warm and (ix+iy+seed)%4 else (23,45,51)
            if not warm:c=(31+seed%6,55+seed%8,65+seed%5)
            m.add(box(w*.45,h*.46,.015,c,center=(x+ix*w*.25,y+iy*h*.25,z-.050),emissive=warm and c[0]>100,skip=('back','top','bottom','left','right')))
    for xx in (-w/2,0,w/2):m.add(box(.035,h+.055,.07,frame,center=(x+xx,y,z-.062)))
    for yy in (-h/2,0,h/2):m.add(box(w+.06,.032,.07,frame,center=(x,y+yy,z-.062)))
    m.add(box(w+.23,.07,.21,(96,106,103),center=(x,y-h/2-.07,z-.07)))
    return m


def puddle(x,z,w,d,y,seed=0,base=(68,88,94)):
    rng=random.Random(seed);m=Mesh()
    pts=((x-w*.46,y,z-d*.30),(x-w*.23,y,z-d*.54),(x+w*.32,y,z-d*.47),
         (x+w*.52,y,z-d*.06),(x+w*.31,y,z+d*.44),(x-w*.35,y,z+d*.40))
    m.face(pts,base,0,True)
    # Broken reflections follow the wet patch, not screen coordinates.
    for i in range(4):
        zz=z-d*.20+i*d*.14;xx=x-w*.27+rng.random()*w*.12
        m.add(quad_xz(xx,zz,xx+w*(.3+rng.random()*.25),zz+.012,y+.003,colour(base,13+i%2*5)))
    return m


def floor(x0,z0,x1,z1,y,seed=0,roof=False):
    rng=random.Random(seed);m=Mesh();size=1.55 if roof else 1.65
    base=PALETTE['roof'] if roof else (61,72,72)
    z=z0
    while z<z1:
        x=x0
        while x<x1:
            xx=min(x1,x+size);zz=min(z1,z+size*.72)
            c=spill(((x+xx)/2,y,(z+zz)/2),colour(base,rng.randrange(-4,5)))
            # Paired quads share a centre, so averaging cannot alternate the layers.
            m.add(quad_xz(x,z,xx,zz,y,colour(c,-9)))
            m.add(quad_xz(x+.012,z+.012,xx-.012,zz-.012,y+.006,c))
            x+=size
        z+=size*.72
    return m


def roof_column():
    """Bevelled, coursed concrete pillar within the original occlusion volume.
    Surface cells ARE the shell, avoiding floating seams over a giant face.
    """
    m=Mesh();cx,cz=1.4,27.25
    ring=((- .295,-.4),(.295,-.4),(.35,-.345),(.35,.345),(.295,.4),(-.295,.4),(-.35,.345),(-.35,-.345))
    for side in range(8):
        ax,az=ring[side];bx,bz=ring[(side+1)%8]
        widths=3 if side in (0,4) else 1
        for row in range(6):
            ya=5+row*.5;yb=ya+.5
            for j in range(widths):
                aa=j/widths;bb=(j+1)/widths
                x0=cx+ax+(bx-ax)*aa;z0=cz+az+(bz-az)*aa
                x1=cx+ax+(bx-ax)*bb;z1=cz+az+(bz-az)*bb
                tone=(row*7+j*3)%5-2
                base=(72,82,79) if row>0 else (54,64,62)
                m.face(((x0,ya,z0),(x0,yb,z0),(x1,yb,z1),(x1,ya,z1)),colour(base,tone),2,True)
    # Solid end caps and shallow metal edge protection, not broken screen lines.
    m.face(tuple((cx+x,8,cz+z) for x,z in reversed(ring)),(113,120,109),2,True)
    for x in (1.115,1.685):
        m.add(box(.027,2.78,.024,(89,105,100),center=(x,6.42,26.850)))
        for y in (5.45,6.42,7.39):m.add(box(.034,.034,.025,(137,135,103),center=(x,y,26.839)))
    m.add(box(.69,.10,.79,(107,118,109),center=(1.4,7.93,27.25)))
    return m

    # Indexed vertices reduce CPU transform work without changing one polygon.
    result=[]
    for part in M:
        verts=[];index={};remap={}
        for i,v in enumerate(part.verts):
            if v not in index:index[v]=len(verts);verts.append(v)
            remap[i]=index[v]
        faces=[(tuple(remap[i] for i in inds),c,layer,ds,em) for inds,c,layer,ds,em in part.faces]
        result.append(Mesh(verts,faces))
    return tuple(result)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def water_base():

    return m


def water_mesh(t,motion=True):
    """Broken warm window reflections and cool current lines, in river space."""
    if not motion:t=0
    m=Mesh()
    for row in range(27):
        z=4.5+row*.72
        for i in range(8):
            phase=i*1.7+row*.9+t*.00055
            x=-18+i*5+math.sin(phase)*.16;w=.42+((row*11+i*7)%13)*.075
            c=(30+row%3*2,48+row%3*3,56+row%3*3)
            m.add(quad_xz(x,z,x+w,z+.018,-.805,c))
    # Reflections under the warehouse's warm bays. Not a perfect mirror strip.
    for cx in (-7.2,3.0):
        for row in range(22):
            z=12.2+row*.54;fade=(row+1)/22
            xx=cx+math.sin(row*1.5+t*.0007)*.12
            w=.10+.45*fade+.14*math.sin(row*.7+t*.0004)
            c=(int(43+74*fade),int(44+32*fade),int(33+6*fade))
            m.add(quad_xz(xx-w/2,z,xx+w/2,z+.024+fade*.025,-.800,c))
    return m


def _hull(points):
    pts=sorted(set(points))
    if len(pts)<3:return pts
    def cross(o,a,b):return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])
    lo=[];hi=[]
    for p in pts:
        while len(lo)>1 and cross(lo[-2],lo[-1],p)<=0:lo.pop()
        lo.append(p)
    for p in reversed(pts):
        while len(hi)>1 and cross(hi[-2],hi[-1],p)<=0:hi.pop()
        hi.append(p)
    return lo[:-1]+hi[:-1]


def actor_shadow(hum,pose,pos,yaw,rifle=True):
    """Projected posed-mesh silhouettes: real ground coordinates, not a sprite.
    A two-tone penumbra is deliberately stylized, not a shadow-map claim.
    """
    from engine3d import m_apply
    places,_,root=hum.pose_world(pose,pos,yaw,rifle)
    m=Mesh();floor_y=pos[1]
    for slot,key,M,org,ground,fb in places:
        if key in ('chest','chest2','chest3','face','face2','uarm_acc'):continue
        verts=hum._rifle.verts if key=='rifle' else hum._parts[key][0]
        projected=[]
        for v in verts:
            x,y,z=v_add(root,v_add(org,m_apply(M,v)));height=max(0,y-floor_y)
            projected.append((x+.44*height,z+.48*height))
        h=_hull(projected)
        if len(h)<3:continue
        cx=sum(x for x,z in h)/len(h);cz=sum(z for x,z in h)/len(h)
        for scale,col,layer,dy in ((1.045,(35,46,47),.21,.012),(1.0,(23,34,37),.22,.016)):
            poly=[(cx+(x-cx)*scale,floor_y+dy,cz+(z-cz)*scale) for x,z in h]
            m.face(poly,col,layer,True,True)
    return m


# Logical seal of the world shell: every rectangle a below-horizon ray must be able
# to land on. The first two document the authored set; the rest are world_shell().
# tools/m5_shadow_check.py ray-tests against this table, so art and test cannot drift.
SHELL_SEAL=(
    (-10,-13,10,4,0.0),          # quay deck (floor(...,503) in scene_meshes)
    (-32,4.2,36,26.2,-0.82),     # river slab (water_base)
    (-300,-300,300,-13,-0.06),   # south apron
    (-300,-13,-10,4.2,-0.06),    # west apron strip
    (10,-13,300,4.2,-0.06),      # east apron strip
    (-300,4.2,-32,26.2,-0.85),   # river extension west
    (36,4.2,300,26.2,-0.85),     # river extension east
    (-300,24.4,300,300,-0.02),   # far-bank ground
)

# Vertical seal faces, as (z, x0, x1, y0, y1): shallow rays thread between the far
# ground's south rim and the river's north edge, and only a wall face catches them.
SHELL_WALLS=(
    (24.28,-120,40,-1.6,0.12),   # far-bank embankment, front face
)


def _banded(xb,zb,y,base,rng,jit,practical=False):
    """Ground strip split into depth bands and x columns. The renderer fogs each
    face from its mean depth, so one giant quad would band; bands keep consecutive
    centroid depths ~10 m apart inside the fog zone and grow past it."""
    m=Mesh()
    for i in range(len(zb)-1):
        for j in range(len(xb)-1):
            c=colour(base,rng.randrange(-jit,jit+1))
            if practical:
                c=spill(((xb[j]+xb[j+1])/2,y,(zb[i]+zb[i+1])/2),c)
            m.add(quad_xz(xb[j],zb[i],xb[j+1],zb[i+1],y,c))
    return m


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def world_shell():
    """Sealing terrain around the authored set so no finale camera sees an edge.
    Layer-0 banded ground plus a layer-2 embankment and deck kerbs; every tone sits
    close to the renderer fog so the shell's own rim at +/-300 m (past fog_end)
    dissolves into haze. Nothing here is coplanar with the deck (y=0), the river
    (y=-0.82) or the warehouse roof (y=5): the painter sort and the projected actor
    shadows depend on that."""
    M=[];add=M.append
    asphalt=colour((61,72,72),-10)
    # Quad sizes stay modest on purpose: a face that straddles the camera plane
    # survives near-clipping as a frame-wide polygon and cannot be sphere-culled.
    add(_banded((-300,-40,-10,10,40,300),(-300,-125,-95,-65,-45,-30,-20,-13),
                -0.06,asphalt,random.Random(601),3,True))
    add(_banded((-300,-95,-65,-45,-30,-18,-10),(-13,-4.5,4.2),
                -0.06,asphalt,random.Random(602),3,True))
    add(_banded((10,22,45,300),(-13,-4.5,4.2),
                -0.06,asphalt,random.Random(602),3,True))
    river=random.Random(603)
    for zb in ((4.2,14,20),(20,26.2)):
        add(_banded((-300,-105,-70,-48,-32),zb,-0.85,(18,35,43),river,3))
        add(_banded((36,48,70,105,300),zb,-0.85,(18,35,43),river,3))
    add(_banded((-300,-70,-35,-14,14,35,70,300),
                (24.4,28.5,33,38,44,51,59,68,79,92,110,135,300),
                -0.02,(40,50,54),random.Random(605),4,True))
    # Far-bank embankment: the vertical face the water-to-ground step needs, or the
    # ground's south rim would show a sliver of river behind it. The wings seal the
    # same step far off axis, where one segment each is enough.
    add(box(160,1.72,.24,(39,50,53),center=(-40,-.74,24.40),seg=5,
            skip=('back','bottom','left','right'),cols={'top':(51,62,65)}))
    # Deck retaining kerbs over the deck/apron junction; the west gap is exactly the
    # service-passage opening, and the east run stops short of the quay coping.
    kerb=colour(PALETTE['stone'],-34)
    for w,d,cx,cz in ((20.0,.22,0,-13.11),(.22,9.0,-10.11,-8.5),
                      (.22,5.4,-10.11,1.0),(.22,16.7,10.11,-4.65)):
        add(box(w,.24,d,kerb,center=(cx,-.02,cz),seg=2.5,skip=('bottom',),
                cols={'top':(61,70,66)}))
    return tuple(M)

def _tag(surface, text, color=(120, 200, 220)):
    """Location tag pinned inside the safe band (m4aftermath._tag idiom).
    Empty text draws nothing (shots without a slate, e.g. character closes)."""
    if not text:
        return
    surf = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, color)
    pad_x, pad_y = 10, 3
    plate = pygame.Surface((surf.get_width() + pad_x * 2, surf.get_height() + pad_y * 2),
                           pygame.SRCALPHA)
    plate.fill((4, 6, 10, 190))
    pygame.draw.rect(plate, (*color, 90), plate.get_rect(), 1)
    px = WIDTH // 2 - plate.get_width() // 2
    surface.blit(plate, (px, SAFE_TOP + 6))
    surface.blit(surf, (px + pad_x, SAFE_TOP + 6 + pad_y))


def _beat(t, start, length):
    return _m3_smooth(_m3_clamp01((t - start) / float(length)))


def _scanlines(surface, rect, step=4, alpha=17):
    for y in range(rect[1], rect[1] + rect[3], step):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (0, 0, 0, alpha), (rect[0], y),
                         (rect[0] + rect[2], y))

def _studio_backdrop(panel, cx, cy, w, h):
    """IPA broadcast wall: dark navy gradient, crest centred above the desk."""
    _draw_vertical_gradient(panel, 0, 0, w, h, (30, 36, 52), (12, 15, 24))
    for x in (cx - w // 2 + 40, cx + w // 2 - 40):
        pygame.draw.rect(panel, (24, 29, 42), (x - 14, 0, 28, h))
        pygame.draw.line(panel, (52, 47, 44), (x - 14, 0), (x - 14, h), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(panel, (104, 83, 52), (cx, cy - int(h * 0.22)), 34, 3)
    pygame.draw.circle(panel, (46, 44, 48), (cx, cy - int(h * 0.22)), 28)
    for dx in (-14, 0, 14):
        pygame.draw.polygon(panel, (168, 136, 84),
                            [(cx + dx, cy - int(h * 0.22) - 20),
                             (cx + dx + 6, cy - int(h * 0.22) + 6),
                             (cx + dx, cy - int(h * 0.22) + 20),
                             (cx + dx - 6, cy - int(h * 0.22) + 6)])
    _ko_glow(panel, (104, 146, 191), (cx, cy - 20), int(w * 0.55), 26)


def _broadcast_panel(t, *, who, caption, cap_col, reveal_ms, wide=None):
    """A public monitor filling the safe band as it switches on. Returns the
    panel plus the surround fade (1 = frame closed, 0 = full screen)."""
    open_p = _beat(t, 0, reveal_ms) if t < reveal_ms * 4 else 1.0
    mw = round(WIDTH * (0.62 + 0.38 * open_p))
    mh = round(_FILM_H * (0.58 + 0.42 * open_p))
    mx, my = (WIDTH - mw) // 2, SAFE_TOP + round((_FILM_H - mh) * 0.5 * open_p)
    panel = pygame.Surface((mw, mh))
    _studio_backdrop(panel, mw // 2, mh // 2, mw, mh)
    foot = mh - 26
    scale = mh / 460.0
    draw_president(panel, mw // 2, foot, scale=scale, facing_right=True) \
        if who == "president" else \
        draw_balaceanu(panel, mw // 2, foot, scale=scale, facing_right=False)
    # Lower third rises with the anchor's first sentence.
    bar_h = max(20, round(mh * 0.10))
    bar_y = mh - bar_h - 6
    pygame.draw.rect(panel, (16, 21, 33, 236), (0, bar_y, mw, bar_h))
    txt = font_terminal_small.render(caption, True, cap_col)
    panel.blit(txt, (max(10, (mw - txt.get_width()) // 2),
                     bar_y + (bar_h - txt.get_height()) // 2))
    ui = pygame.Surface((mw, mh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.circle(ui, (220, 67, 57), (20, 18), 3)
    ui.blit(font_terminal_small.render("STATE / LIVE", True, (214, 213, 198)),
            (30, 11))
    for y in range(0, mh, 4):
        pygame.draw.line(ui, (0, 0, 0, 16), (0, y), (mw, y))
    panel.blit(ui, (0, 0))
    return panel, (mx, my, open_p)

def _figure_sil(surface, fn, cx, foot_y, scale, *, facing_right, t):
    """Cached cast figure flattened to a near-black interior-lit silhouette
    (m4aftermath._figure idiom, generalised to any cast painter)."""
    bob = (math.sin(t * 0.006) + 1) * 0.8
    fn(surface, cx, foot_y - int(bob), scale=scale, facing_right=facing_right,
       in_silhouette=True)

def _river_set(surface, t, *, lamp=(0, 0)):
    """Shared river-gate geometry: tunnel mouth left, iron gate + water right,
    one sodium lamp, rain. ``lamp`` offsets the light pool."""
    lx, ly = lamp
    # Night sky over the far bank.
    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, SCENE_TOP, WIDTH, SAFE_BOT - SCENE_TOP,
                            (16, 20, 30), (6, 8, 12))
    rng = random.Random(903)
    for bx in range(-20, WIDTH, 60):
        bh = rng.randint(30, 120)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (10, 12, 18), (bx, SAFE_BOT - 210 - bh, 52, bh + 40))
    # Water.
    water_y = SAFE_BOT - 170
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (14, 22, 32), (0, water_y, WIDTH, 170))
    for i in range(16):
        wy = water_y + 8 + i * 10
        off = math.sin(t * 0.002 + i) * 14
        seg = 40 + (i % 4) * 22
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (24, 38, 54), (off + i * 17, wy),
                         (off + i * 17 + seg, wy), 2)
    # Quay the gate sits on.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (18, 18, 22), (0, SAFE_BOT, WIDTH, HEIGHT - SAFE_BOT))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (30, 30, 36), (0, SAFE_BOT - 6, WIDTH, 8))
    # Tunnel mouth (left) spilling cold light.
    tx, ty = 150, SAFE_BOT - 150
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (9, 10, 14), (tx - 60, ty, 150, 150))
    pygame.draw.arc(surface, (40, 42, 50), (tx - 60, ty - 30, 150, 90),
                    math.pi, math.tau, 4)
    _ko_glow(surface, (90, 120, 150), (tx + 15, ty + 90), 130, 26)
    # Anchored, OPEN access gate: the leaf stays left of Maru's exit path.
    gx = WIDTH - 300 + lx
    for px in (gx, gx + 220):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (50, 48, 44), (px, SAFE_TOP + 100, 18, SAFE_BOT - SAFE_TOP - 100))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (82, 76, 64), (px - 4, SAFE_TOP + 94, 26, 8))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (42, 40, 38), (gx - 90, SAFE_TOP + 130, 90, SAFE_BOT - SAFE_TOP - 130))
    for b in range(6):
        bx = gx + 8 + b * 9
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (68, 72, 74), (bx, SAFE_TOP + 120 + b * 4),
                         (bx, SAFE_BOT - 5), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (68, 72, 74), (gx + 4, SAFE_TOP + 164),
                     (gx + 60, SAFE_TOP + 190), 3)
    # Sodium lamp above the gate.
    lamp_xy = (gx + 110 + lx // 2, SAFE_TOP + 60 + ly)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (36, 36, 42), (gx + 110, SAFE_TOP + 20),
                     lamp_xy, 3)
    _ko_glow(surface, _SODIUM, lamp_xy, 220, 34)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 214, 150), lamp_xy, 6)
    # Wet ground: the lamp and the water's own sheen, wavering (a matte deck
    # under a lit lamp reads as painted cardboard).
    _wet_smear(surface, gx + 110, SAFE_BOT - 6, 64, _SODIUM, t, seed=3, width=26)
    _wet_smear(surface, gx + 118, water_y + 6, 52, (66, 92, 118), t, seed=7, width=34)
    return gx, water_y, lamp_xy


def _rain_streaks(surface, t, seed, n=90, splash_y=None, n_splash=5):
    """Rain in two depth bands (far: short, dim, slow; near: long, bright,
    fast) on the scene's wind, plus crowns where it hits the deck: without
    the impact marks a screen-space overlay reads as a filter pasted ON the
    film instead of weather in the world. ``splash_y`` = screen y of the
    ground/water line the drops land on."""
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n_far = max(4, int(n * 0.6))
    n_near = max(4, n - n_far)
    # far band: short dim streaks, slow fall
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(n_far):
        x = rng.randint(0, WIDTH)
        y = (rng.randint(0, HEIGHT) + int(t * 0.45)) % HEIGHT
        ln = rng.randint(5, 11)
        pygame.draw.line(layer, (120, 136, 160, rng.randint(16, 34)),
                         (x, y), (x - 2, y + ln), 1)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    # near band: long, brighter, faster - the drops close to the lens
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(n_near):
        x = rng.randint(0, WIDTH)
        y = (rng.randint(0, HEIGHT) + int(t * 1.25)) % HEIGHT
        ln = rng.randint(12, 26)
        pygame.draw.line(layer, (168, 186, 212, rng.randint(30, 62)),
                         (x, y), (x - 4, y + ln), 1)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    if splash_y is not None:                       # crowns + ripples on the deck
        layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for i in range(n_splash):
            ph = (t * 0.001 + i * 0.37 + seed * 0.11) % 1.0
            x = rng.randint(20, WIDTH - 20)
            r = 1 + int(5 * ph)
            a = int(110 * (1 - ph))
            pygame.draw.ellipse(layer, (150, 168, 196, a),
                                (x - r, splash_y - r // 2 - int(2 * ph), r * 2, r), 1)
            if ph > 0.55:                          # rebound droplets
                d = int((ph - 0.55) * 10)
                pygame.draw.line(layer, (168, 186, 212, a),
                                 (x - 2, splash_y), (x - 3, splash_y - d), 1)
                pygame.draw.line(layer, (168, 186, 212, a),
                                 (x + 2, splash_y), (x + 3, splash_y - int(d * 0.7)), 1)
        surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))


def _wet_smear(surface, x, y, length, col, t, seed=0, width=16):
    """Light smeared on wet ground: a wavering stack of dashes running down
    from where the light meets the deck (the matte-cardboard fix)."""
    n = 9
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, int(length) + 8), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(n):
        f = i / (n - 1.0)
        k = 0.55 * (1.0 - f) ** 1.3 * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 0.009 + i * 1.9 + seed))
        if k <= 0.03:
            continue
        xx = x + math.sin(t * 0.0045 + i * 1.3 + seed) * width * 0.45
        yy = f * length
        w = max(2, int(width * (1.0 - 0.4 * f)))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(layer, (*[int(c * k) for c in col], 255),
                            (int(xx - w / 2), int(yy), w, max(2, int(length / n * 0.8))))
    surface.blit(layer, (int(x - width), int(y)))


def _draw_m5_river_gate(surface, t):
    """Maru through the gate; Biribel turns as a red dot finds his chest.

    The escort ends here and the standoff begins on the next shot, so this
    frame holds both: Maru half-gone through the bars, Biribel alone on the
    quay, and the scope's dot arriving on him mid-beat."""
    surface.fill((6, 8, 12))
    t = max(0, min(t, 7200))
    gx, water_y, lamp = _river_set(surface, t)
    _rain_streaks(surface, t, 77, splash_y=SAFE_BOT - 6, n_splash=6)
    # Maru slipping through the gate, hood up, favouring the wounded arm.
    walk = _beat(t, 600, 2600)
    mx = int(gx + 82 + walk * (WIDTH + 80 - gx - 82))
    from cutscenes.figure_kit import draw_character  # lazy: same module cast.py wraps
    draw_character(surface, "maru", mx, SAFE_BOT + 4, 0.74, True, silhouette=True,
                   t=t, moving=0.9)     # a real stride, not a sliding cutout
    # Biribel on the quay, turning toward the far bank.
    turn = _beat(t, 2600, 1400)
    _figure_sil(surface, draw_biribel, 360, SAFE_BOT + 4, 0.82,
                facing_right=turn > 0.5, t=t)
    # The red dot: appears on his chest after the turn lands.
    dot_on = _beat(t, 3600, 500)
    if dot_on > 0.02:
        dx, dy = 360 + 14, SAFE_BOT - 150
        pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 0.01)
        r = max(2, round(4 * dot_on * pulse))
        _ko_glow(surface, (255, 40, 30), (dx, dy), 26, int(40 * dot_on))
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 50, 36), (dx, dy), r)
    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    _m3_noise(surface, 2202, count=60, alpha=16)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _tag(surface, "RIVER GATE // EAST CHANNEL", _RIVER)


# ────────────────────────────────────────────
# ENDING 5 - inside the scope
# ────────────────────────────────────────────
def _draw_m5_ucilev_scope(surface, t):
    """Ucilev's optic: the world cropped to a circle, crosshair on Biribel,
    range and windage etched on the glass. A held breath moves the reticle.

    240 m of lane: the hold wanders and breathes, and because the image is
    MAGNIFIED through the glass the world drifts several times further than
    the reticle (which rides the tube) - that differential is what makes it
    read as a man looking through a scope instead of a screenshot under a
    circular mask."""
    surface.fill((2, 3, 5))
    t = max(0, min(t, 9200))
    # The scene through the lens: the quay, Biribel small and unaware. Built
    # oversized so the drifting image can shift without exposing an edge.
    M = 26
    inner = pygame.Surface((WIDTH + 2 * M, HEIGHT + 2 * M))
    _river_set(inner, t, lamp=(-40, 6))
    _rain_streaks(inner, t, 12, n=40, splash_y=SAFE_BOT + 22 + M, n_splash=4)
    _figure_sil(inner, draw_biribel, 360 + M, SAFE_BOT + 4 + M, 0.82,
                facing_right=True, t=t)
    cx, cy = WIDTH // 2, SAFE_TOP + (_FILM_H // 2) - 10
    radius = _FILM_H // 2 - 6
    # Soft-edged mask (the old hard cut-out read as a stencil): a clear glass
    # circle inside a graded falloff into black.
    mask = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    mask.fill((0, 0, 0))
    pygame.draw.circle(mask, (255, 255, 255), (cx, cy), radius - 12)
    for i in range(1, 13):
        v = int(255 * (1 - i / 13.0) ** 1.1)
        pygame.draw.circle(mask, (v, v, v), (cx, cy), radius - 12 + i, 1)
    masked = inner.subsurface((M, M, WIDTH, HEIGHT)).copy()
    masked.blit(mask, (0, 0), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MIN)
    # Hold: slow wander + breath + tremor. The WANDER is what the marksman
    # corrects; it decays as he commits to the shot.
    settle = _beat(t, 1200, 2400)
    wander = 1.0 - 0.6 * settle
    sway_x = (math.sin(t * 0.00042) * 11 * wander + math.sin(t * 0.00017 + 1.3) * 7 * wander
              + (1.0 - settle) * math.sin(t * 0.0021) * 4)
    sway_y = (math.cos(t * 0.00031 + 0.7) * 8 * wander + math.cos(t * 0.00053) * 4 * wander
              + (1.0 - settle) * math.cos(t * 0.0017) * 3)
    tremor = 0.6 * (math.sin(t * 0.0131) + math.sin(t * 0.0071 + 2.0) * 0.8)
    surface.blit(masked, (int(sway_x), int(sway_y)))
    # Reticle: rides the tube (tremor only) while the image drifts past it.
    rcx, rcy = cx + tremor, cy + tremor * 0.7
    ring = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.circle(ring, (10, 12, 14, 200), (rcx, rcy), radius, 6)
    pygame.draw.circle(ring, (120, 140, 150, 150), (rcx, rcy), radius, 1)
    for ang in range(0, 360, 30):
        a = math.radians(ang)
        pygame.draw.line(ring, (90, 110, 120, 130),
                         (rcx + int(math.cos(a) * radius * .92),
                          rcy + int(math.sin(a) * radius * .92)),
                         (rcx + int(math.cos(a) * radius * .80),
                          rcy + int(math.sin(a) * radius * .80)), 2)
    gap = 16
    pygame.draw.line(ring, (200, 60, 50, 200), (rcx - radius, rcy),
                     (rcx - gap, rcy), 1)
    pygame.draw.line(ring, (200, 60, 50, 200), (rcx + gap, rcy),
                     (rcx + radius, rcy), 1)
    pygame.draw.line(ring, (200, 60, 50, 200), (rcx, rcy - radius),
                     (rcx, rcy - gap), 1)
    pygame.draw.line(ring, (200, 60, 50, 200), (rcx, rcy + gap),
                     (rcx, rcy + radius), 1)
    for k in range(-4, 5):
        if k:
            pygame.draw.line(ring, (150, 60, 55, 150), (rcx - 5, rcy + k * 18),
                             (rcx + 5, rcy + k * 18), 1)
    pygame.draw.circle(ring, (255, 70, 50, 220), (rcx, rcy), 3)
    surface.blit(ring, (0, 0))
    # Etched data. The top tag lives below the optic's upper rim so it never
    # collides with the "OPTIC // FAR BANK" location tag at SAFE_TOP.
    hud = font_terminal_small.render("Y-3  INTAKE MATCH", True, (150, 165, 175))
    surface.blit(hud, (cx - hud.get_width() // 2, cy + radius - 30))
    rng_txt = font_terminal_small.render("RANGE 240m  ·  WIND L2", True,
                                         (120, 135, 145))
    surface.blit(rng_txt, (cx - rng_txt.get_width() // 2, cy + radius - 52))
    _m3_noise(surface, 8808, count=50, alpha=14)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _tag(surface, "OPTIC // FAR BANK", _GUARD_RED)


# ────────────────────────────────────────────
# ENDING 6/7 - the reveal, then he leaves
# ────────────────────────────────────────────
def _ucilev_pose(t):
    """Rifle carried low at the reveal, muzzle down as he decides, shouldered
    nowhere as he walks off. Returns (lift, lower)."""
    lift = _beat(t, 900, 2200)         # scope-eye to standing eye contact
    lower = _beat(t, 3400, 2600)       # "not tonight": the barrel drops
    return lift, lower


def _draw_m5_ucilev_reveal(surface, t):
    """The operator listed dead two years ago, out of the optic and into the
    lamp light. Ucilev Nadgob Ierdna lowers the rifle an inch.

    The rifle's drop settles with a touch of overshoot (a weight, not a
    servo) and his chest breathes under the Guard blacks - an idle actor
    holds the frame, a mannequin kills it."""
    surface.fill((6, 8, 12))
    t = max(0, min(t, 8400))
    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, SCENE_TOP, WIDTH, SAFE_BOT - SCENE_TOP,
                            (18, 22, 32), (6, 8, 12))
    # Far-bank ground and the rain curtain behind him.
    ground_y = SAFE_BOT - 40
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (12, 14, 18), (0, ground_y, WIDTH, HEIGHT - ground_y))
    _rain_streaks(surface, t, 33, n=70, splash_y=SAFE_BOT - 14, n_splash=4)
    # Key light: the sodium lamp behind-left rimming the Guard black.
    _ko_glow(surface, _SODIUM, (WIDTH - 260, SAFE_TOP + 90), 240, 30)
    cx = WIDTH // 2 - 40
    lift, lower = _ucilev_pose(t)
    foot = SAFE_BOT - 6
    breath = math.sin(t * 0.0021) * 1.4          # chest rise under the coat
    bob = int(breath * 0.5)
    draw_ucilev(surface, cx, foot + bob, scale=0.96, facing_right=lift < 0.5)
    # Rifle held across the body, muzzle dropping with `lower` (ease-out-back:
    # the weight carries past, then settles).
    lk = _beat(t, 3400, 2200)
    over = math.sin(math.pi * min(1.0, lk * 1.35)) * 0.06 * (1.0 - lk)
    ang = -0.9 + lower * 0.7 - over
    ex, ey = cx - 46, foot - 150 + bob
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (10, 11, 13), (ex, ey),
                     (ex + math.cos(ang) * 120, ey + math.sin(ang) * 120), 6)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (60, 62, 68), (ex + 8, ey - 2),
                     (ex + 8 + math.cos(ang) * 110, ey - 2 + math.sin(ang) * 110), 2)
    # Red armband catchlight on the gun-side shoulder.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, _GUARD_RED, (cx + 22, foot - 206),
                     (cx + 34, foot - 196), 6)
    # His eyes track off-frame to Biribel, not the camera.
    gaze = _beat(t, 0, 1200)
    hx, hy = cx + 2, foot - 252 + bob
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (150, 150, 158), (hx - 6, hy), (hx - 2, hy), 2)
    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    _m3_noise(surface, 4411, count=54, alpha=16)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _tag(surface, "UCILEV NADGOB IERDNA // LISTED DEAD", _GUARD_RED)


def _draw_m5_ucilev_leaves(surface, t):
    """He lowers the rifle and walks away into the rain. Back to camera, the
    river gate still glowing where Maru went through."""
    surface.fill((6, 8, 12))
    t = max(0, min(t, 6800))
    gx, water_y, lamp = _river_set(surface, t)
    _rain_streaks(surface, t, 55, n=100, splash_y=SAFE_BOT - 6, n_splash=5)
    # Walking away: smaller each beat, drifting up toward the gate.
    walk = _beat(t, 400, 5600)
    scale = 0.92 - walk * 0.22
    cx = int(WIDTH // 2 + walk * 150)
    foot = int(SAFE_BOT - walk * 60)
    from cutscenes.figure_kit import draw_character  # lazy: same module cast.py wraps
    draw_character(surface, "ucilev", cx, foot, scale, False, t=t, moving=0.85 * (1 - walk))
    # Rifle flat at the side, muzzle down, swinging with the stride.
    swing = math.sin(t * 0.012) * 6 * (1 - walk)
    ex, ey = cx - int(34 * scale), foot - int(120 * scale)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (10, 11, 13), (ex, ey),
                     (ex - swing, ey + int(96 * scale)), 5)
    # Gate lamp halo where Maru disappeared.
    _ko_glow(surface, _SODIUM, (gx + 110, SAFE_TOP + 70), 200, 26)
    _wet_smear(surface, gx + 110, SAFE_BOT - 6, 60, _SODIUM, t, seed=11, width=24)
    _m3_noise(surface, 4412, count=52, alpha=16)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _tag(surface, "EAST CHANNEL // HE DOESN'T TURN", _RIVER)


# ────────────────────────────────────────────
# ENDING 8 - the radio
# ────────────────────────────────────────────
def _cig_puff(surface, x, y, t, scale=1.0, drift=-1.0):
    """Ember pulse + rising wisp for the 2D cast: the cached cast figures can
    never animate their cigarette, so the life is drawn on top at the mouth."""
    layer = pygame.Surface((90, 110), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    # ember: breathes with the smoke's pull
    k = 0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * 0.004)
    pygame.draw.circle(layer, (255, 120, 40, int(220 * k)), (26, 78), 3)
    pygame.draw.circle(layer, (255, 190, 130, int(90 * k)), (26, 78), 6)
    # wisps: three puffs at staggered ages, expanding and fading as they rise
    for i in range(3):
        age = ((t * 0.00035 + i * 0.37) % 1.0)
        if age <= 0.02:
            continue
        r = (2.0 + age * 13.0) * scale
        a = int(70 * (1 - age) ** 1.4)
        px = 26 + (math.sin(i * 2.1 + age * 5.0) * 8 + drift * age * 6) * scale
        py = 76 - age * 62 * scale
        pygame.draw.circle(layer, (176, 172, 168, a), (int(px), int(py)), int(r))
    surface.blit(layer, (int(x - 26 * scale), int(y - 78 * scale)))


def _handset_2d(surface, cx, foot_y, k, f, hy, side=1, t=0):
    """The receiver held to the ear: earpiece at the ear, body down the cheek,
    mouthpiece at the lips, and a hand at the grip (the solve is handed back
    to draw_character's reach so the arm follows)."""
    ex = cx + side * 13 * k * f                     # ear
    ey = foot_y + (hy - 3) * k
    bob = math.sin(t * 0.0013 + side) * 1.2         # talk tilt
    pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (58, 56, 54), (ex - 7, ey - 9 + bob, 14, 20))   # earpiece
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (20, 20, 23), (ex - 4, ey + 6 + bob, 8, 16))       # body
    pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (48, 46, 44), (ex - 6, ey + 20 + bob, 12, 12))  # mouthpiece
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 116, 110), (ex - 6, ey - 5 + bob), (ex + 6, ey - 5 + bob), 1)
    return ex, ey + 26 + bob                         # the grip point (for the cord)


def _draw_m5_radio(surface, t):
    """Two men on a wire deciding what neither saw. Split frame: Biribel on
    the wet quay with the handset, Vasile in his new office with the flag on
    the desk. Neither admits anything.

    The figures are drawn LIVE (not from the pose cache) so they breathe and
    blink, the handsets are solved onto their ears with cords that droop to
    their sets, and the cigarette actually smokes - a magnet-glued prop and a
    frozen actor are what the old cached frame shipped."""
    surface.fill((6, 7, 11))
    t = max(0, min(t, 8800))
    split = _beat(t, 0, 1600)          # the seam opens between the two lines
    sx = int(WIDTH // 2)
    # LEFT - Biribel, quay, rain, the gate glow behind.
    left = pygame.Surface((sx, HEIGHT))
    _river_set(left, t, lamp=(-160, 0))
    _rain_streaks(left, t, 91, n=50, splash_y=SAFE_BOT - 6, n_splash=4)
    from cutscenes.figure_kit import draw_character  # lazy: same module cast.py wraps
    from core.outfits import OUTFIT_GUARD, biribel_2d
    bcx, bfoot, bs = sx - 130, SAFE_BOT + 4, 0.82
    bk = bs * 262 / 296.0
    breath = math.sin(t * 0.0023) * 1.4
    bhy = -258 + breath
    draw_character(left, "biribel", bcx, bfoot, bs, False, t=t,
                   blink=0.9 if (t % 4200) < 120 else 0,
                   reach=[(-13 * bk, (bhy - 3) * bk)],
                   wardrobe=biribel_2d(OUTFIT_GUARD))
    bx, by = _handset_2d(left, bcx, bfoot, bk, -1, bhy, side=1, t=t)
    pygame.draw.lines(left, (30, 30, 34), False,
                      [(bx, by), (bx - 10, by + 44), (bx + 6, by + 88),
                       (bx - 4, by + 150)], 2)      # cord off-frame
    surface.blit(left, (0, 0))
    # RIGHT - Vasile's office: a desk, a flag, one lamp, no rain.
    right = pygame.Surface((WIDTH - sx, HEIGHT))
    _draw_vertical_gradient(right, 0, SCENE_TOP, WIDTH - sx,
                            SAFE_BOT - SCENE_TOP, (26, 24, 22), (8, 8, 10))
    _ko_glow(right, (220, 170, 110), (WIDTH - sx - 150, SAFE_TOP + 70), 200, 26)
    # Desk with the presidential flag tucked behind it.
    pygame.draw.rect(right, (34, 28, 24), (40, SAFE_BOT - 110, WIDTH - sx - 80, 110))
    pygame.draw.line(right, (58, 48, 40), (40, SAFE_BOT - 110),
                     (WIDTH - sx - 40, SAFE_BOT - 110), 3)
    pole_x = WIDTH - sx - 120
    pygame.draw.line(right, (70, 62, 54), (pole_x, SAFE_TOP + 30),
                     (pole_x, SAFE_BOT - 110), 4)
    flag = pygame.Surface((70, 110), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    wave = math.sin(t * 0.002) * 4
    pygame.draw.polygon(flag, (25, 35, 59), [(0, 0), (70, 6 + wave),
                         (70, 104 + wave), (0, 110)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(flag, (94, 32, 35), [(22, 0), (48, 3 + wave * .5),
                         (48, 107 + wave * .5), (22, 110)])
    right.blit(flag, (pole_x - 35, SAFE_TOP + 34))
    vcx, vfoot, vs = 150, SAFE_BOT - 4, 0.86
    vk = vs * 262 / 296.0
    vhy = -258 + math.sin(t * 0.0021) * 1.4
    draw_character(right, "vasile", vcx, vfoot, vs, True, t=t,
                   blink=0.9 if (t % 3700) < 120 else 0,
                   reach=[(13 * vk, (vhy - 3) * vk)])
    vx, vy = _handset_2d(right, vcx, vfoot, vk, 1, vhy, side=1, t=t)
    pygame.draw.lines(right, (30, 30, 34), False,
                      [(vx, vy), (vx - 6, vy + 30), (vx + 26, vy + 52),
                       (vx + 44, vy + 78)], 2)       # cord to the desk set
    _cig_puff(right, vcx + 24.6 * vk, vfoot + (vhy + 27.1) * vk, t, scale=vk)
    surface.blit(right, (sx, 0))
    # The seam: a hard vertical join with a thin broadcast line between them.
    seam = int(sx - (WIDTH - sx) * (1 - split) * 0.0)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (70, 76, 86), (seam, SCENE_TOP), (seam, SCENE_BOT), 2)
    _ko_glow(surface, (120, 140, 170), (seam, SAFE_TOP + _FILM_H // 2), 120, 14)
    _m3_noise(surface, 6006, count=50, alpha=15)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _tag(surface, "WIRE // QUAY <-> GUARD HQ", _LIAISON)


============================== FILE: cutscenes\m5martial3d.py ==============================
"""m5martial3d.py - W7: true-3D (engine3d) takes of every Mission 5 cutscene.

    m5_tv_bulletin     studio dolly from the TV camera rig to the anchor desk
    m5_safehouse_tv    Biribel at the rain window, the CRT playing the bulletin
    m5_retardovici_tv  the address: hall, podium, crest, a silent audience
    m5_river_gate      Maru through the gate; reverse on Biribel as the dot lands
    m5_ucilev_scope    POV through Ucilev's optic - crosshair, mil dots, breath sway
    m5_ucilev_reveal   Ucilev on the far-bank roof, coming off the rifle
    m5_ucilev_leaves   he walks to the roof stair hut and doesn't turn
    m5_radio           split frame: Biribel on the quay / Vasile in his office

engine.py calls ``draw_m5_scene_3d(scene, surface, t)`` first; it returns
False when the 3D path can't run (engine3d error, or ACARISTAN_CUTSCENE3D=0)
and the 2D m5martial scene draws instead (2D stays as the fallback).
Renderers come from ``engine3d.Renderer`` (GL when moderngl + GL 3.3 exist,
silent SoftwareRenderer fallback; force with ACARISTAN_RENDERER) at 0.6x film
res with a smooth upscale. The production layers - practical-light sprites,
world-space rain, parallax night sky, handheld/shake camera - come from
cutscenes.m5fx3d; all non-scripted camera motion is zeroed under reduced motion.
The film lives inside SAFE_TOP..SAFE_BOT so the dialogue box never covers it.
"""
import math
import os
import random

import pygame

from cutscenes.m5martial import (SAFE_TOP, SAFE_BOT, _CREST, _GUARD_RED, _LIAISON,

# M5 Biribel rigs are keyed by outfit: ("biribel", outfit). Never use the bare
# "biribel" key in M5 - that is his KRAP kit and would leak into post-change shots.

__all__ = ["draw_m5_scene_3d", "draw_m5_tv_bulletin_3d", "draw_m5_river_gate_3d",
           "m5_3d_enabled", "M5_3D_SCENES"]

_FILM_H = SAFE_BOT - SAFE_TOP
_RES = 0.6
_RW, _RH = int(WIDTH * _RES), int(_FILM_H * _RES)
_LENS_RAD = _FILM_H // 2 - 2          # the optic fills the film height

          "qa_no_marks": False}   # qa_no_marks: tools only (hide dot/reticle)
