    # ── public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def skip(self):
        try:
            from audio import voice
            voice.stop()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.t = self.duration
        self.done = True

    def update(self):
        now = pygame.time.get_ticks()
        dt = clamp((now - self._last_ms) / 1000.0, 0.0, 0.1)
        self._last_ms = now
        if self.done:
            return
        try:
            keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()
            held = keys[pygame.K_SPACE] or keys[pygame.K_RETURN]
        except Exception:
            held = False
        self._skip_hold = self._skip_hold + dt if held else 0.0
        if self._skip_hold > 0.9:
            self.skip()
            return
        prev = self.t
        self.t += dt
        self._events(prev, self.t)
        self._update_particles(dt)
        if self.t >= self.duration:
            self.done = True

    # ── events / audio ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _once(self, name, prev, now, at):
        if prev < at <= now and name not in self._fired:
            self._fired.add(name)
            return True
        return False

    def _events(self, prev, now):
        T = self.T
        for l in self.lines:
            if not l.played and now >= l.start:
                l.played = True
                ms = 0
                try:
                    from audio import voice
                    ms = voice.play_line(l.speaker, l.text, radio=l.radio)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                if l.radio and not ms:          # recorded radio clips carry their own squelch
                    audio.play("squelch_head", volume=0.25)
        if self._once("static", prev, now, 0.6):
            audio.play("radio_static", volume=0.18)
        for who, k in (("gabi", "K1"), ("seby", "K2"), ("darius", "K3")):
            if self._once("scream_" + who, prev, now, T[k] + 0.06):
                try:
                    from audio import voice
                    voice.play_death(who)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        if self._once("k1", prev, now, T["K1"]):
            self._kill_fx("gabi", near=True)
            audio.play("bullet_snap", volume=0.9)
            audio.duck_for_radio(frames=240, factor=0.10)
        if self._once("k1_report", prev, now, T["K1"] + 0.2):
            audio.play("sniper_crack", volume=0.75)
        if self._once("k1_tinnitus", prev, now, T["K1"] + 0.3):
            audio.play("tinnitus", volume=0.45)
        if self._once("dive", prev, now, T["dive"] + 0.55):
            audio.play("melee_hit", volume=0.35)
        if self._once("k2", prev, now, T["K2"]):
            self._kill_fx("seby", near=False)
            audio.play("trailer_sniper_stack", volume=0.85)
        if self._once("k2_snap", prev, now, T["K2"] + 0.12):
            audio.play("bullet_snap", volume=0.5)
        if self._once("k3", prev, now, T["K3"]):
            self._kill_fx("darius", near=True)
            audio.play("bullet_snap", volume=0.85)
        if self._once("k3_report", prev, now, T["K3"] + 0.2):
            audio.play("sniper_crack", volume=0.7)
        if self._once("k3_hiss", prev, now, T["K3"] + 0.45):
            audio.play("radio_static", volume=0.32)
        if self._once("k4", prev, now, T["K4"]):
            audio.play("trailer_sniper_stack", volume=0.9)
            self.flash_t = now
        if self._once("k4_hit", prev, now, T["K4"] + 0.07):
            audio.play("concrete_impact", volume=1.0)
            audio.play("bullet_snap", volume=0.7)
            self._impact_fx((self.BIRIBEL_HOME[0] + 0.15, 0.84, SET.BARRIER_Z + 0.05))
            self.shake_t, self.shake_amp = now, 0.20
        if self._once("k4_heart", prev, now, T["K4"] + 0.5):
            audio.play("heartbeat", volume=0.6)
        for i in range(3):
            if self._once("pk_crawl%d" % i, prev, now, T["P0"] + 0.5 + i * 0.65):
                audio.play("footstep_walk", volume=0.18)
        if self._once("pk_heart", prev, now, T["P1"] + 0.2):
            audio.play("heartbeat", volume=0.75)
        if self._once("pk_grab", prev, now, T["G"]):
            audio.play("melee_hit", volume=0.22)
        if self._once("pk_heart2", prev, now, T["P3"] + 0.1):
            audio.play("heartbeat", volume=0.5)
        if self._once("pk_check", prev, now, T["P3"] + 1.0):
            audio.play("rifle_handle", volume=0.6)

    def _kill_fx(self, who, near):
        t = self.t
        self.flash_t = t
        self.shake_t, self.shake_amp = t, 0.09 if near else 0.04
        st = self._actor_state(who, t + 0.01)
        _, j, _ = self.actors[who].pose_world(st["pose"], st["pos"], st["yaw"], rifle_on=False)
        hit = j["chest"]
        self.tracers.append((t, self.muzzle_pt, hit))
        rng = self._rng
        d = v_norm(v_sub(hit, self.muzzle_pt))
        for _ in range(34):
            v = (d[0] * rng.uniform(1, 4) + rng.uniform(-1.2, 1.2), rng.uniform(-0.3, 2.2),
                 d[2] * rng.uniform(1, 4) + rng.uniform(-1.2, 1.2))
            self.parts.append(dict(p=hit, v=v, life=rng.uniform(0.35, 0.9), age=0.0,
                                   col=(rng.randint(110, 160), 10, 12), size=rng.uniform(.025, .06),
                                   g=6.0))
        for _ in range(8):
            self.parts.append(dict(p=hit, v=(d[0] * 1.5, rng.uniform(0, .5), d[2] * 1.5),
                                   life=0.5, age=0.0, col=(150, 30, 30), size=0.09, g=0.0,
                                   mist=True))

    def _impact_fx(self, p):
        rng = self._rng
        for _ in range(46):
            v = (rng.uniform(-2.5, 2.5), rng.uniform(1.0, 4.5), rng.uniform(-3.5, -0.5))
            c = rng.randint(120, 175)
            self.parts.append(dict(p=p, v=v, life=rng.uniform(0.5, 1.2), age=0.0,
                                   col=(c, c - 4, c - 12), size=rng.uniform(.02, .07), g=9.0))
        for _ in range(10):
            self.parts.append(dict(p=p, v=(rng.uniform(-.6, .6), rng.uniform(.3, 1.2), rng.uniform(-1, .2)),
                                   life=1.4, age=0.0, col=(150, 146, 136), size=0.12, g=0.0,
                                   mist=True))
        self.parts.append(dict(p=p, v=(0, 0, 0), life=0.09, age=0.0, col=(255, 240, 200),
                               size=0.5, g=0.0, spark=True))

    def _update_particles(self, dt):
        keep = []
        for q in self.parts:
            q["age"] += dt
            if q["age"] >= q["life"]:
                continue
            v = q["v"]
            p = q["p"]
            v = (v[0] * (1 - 0.8 * dt), v[1] - q["g"] * dt, v[2] * (1 - 0.8 * dt))
            p = (p[0] + v[0] * dt, max(0.01, p[1] + v[1] * dt), p[2] + v[2] * dt)
            q["v"], q["p"] = v, p
            keep.append(q)
        self.parts = keep

    # ── actors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Positions (x, z) in metres - see sniper3d_set for the layout.
    GABI_HOME = (-1.6, 10.6)
    SEBY_HOME = (2.2, 9.9)
    DARIUS_HOME = (5.2, 9.4)
    BIRIBEL_HOME = (-5.0, 5.15)
    SEBY_COVER = (3.4, 5.2)
    DARIUS_COVER = (6.6, 5.2)
    GABI_TURN = 212.0                 # he turns back toward Biribel to call it in

    PK_KNEEL = (-0.6, 4.45)               # Biribel kneels here, at the gap edge
    PK_EYE = (-0.52, 1.0, 4.42)
    PK_RIFLE = (0.42, 0.04, 4.98)         # Seby's OS-12, slid off his sling
    PK_RIFLE_YAW = 200

    def _actor_state(self, who, t):
        """-> dict(pos, yaw, pose, rifle, dead?, handset?) for one actor at t."""
        T = self.T
        if who == "gabi":
            walk = [(-2.2, -3.0), (-2.0, 3.6), self.GABI_HOME]
            if t < 5.0:
                u = seg(t, 0.2, 5.0)
                (x, z), yaw = path_at(walk, ease_out(u))
                pose = pose_walk(path_len(walk) * ease_out(u) * 4.2) if u < 0.97 else POSES["ready"]
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=True)
            x, z = self.GABI_HOME
            if t < T["L4"].start - 0.5:
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=4 + 4 * math.sin(t * .7), pose=POSES["ready"], rifle=True)
            if t < T["K1"]:
                u = smooth(seg(t, T["L4"].start - 0.5, T["L4"].start + 0.2))
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=lerp_yaw(4, self.GABI_TURN, u),
                            pose=blend("ready", "talk_turn", u), rifle=True)
            k = t - T["K1"]
            if t < T["grab"]:
                # hit from behind (north): pitched forward onto his face
                pose = keyed_pose([(0, "talk_turn"),
                                   (0.10, dict(POSES["talk_turn"], spine=-12, head_p=-30, lsh_r=80, rsh_r=60)),
                                   (0.75, dict(POSES["kneel_over"], head_p=40, lsh_p=10, rsh_p=0, lel=10, rel=10)),
                                   (1.45, "dead_front")], k)
                fwd = 0.75 * smooth(seg(k, 0.6, 1.45))
                yr = math.radians(self.GABI_TURN)
                return dict(pos=(x + math.sin(yr) * fwd, 0, z + math.cos(yr) * fwd),
                            yaw=self.GABI_TURN, pose=pose, rifle=k < 0.35, dead=True)
            # Seby has him: flipped onto his back, head toward Seby
            sb = self._actor_state("seby", t)
            sy = math.radians(sb["yaw"])
            px = sb["pos"][0] + math.sin(sy) * 1.5
            pz = sb["pos"][2] + math.cos(sy) * 1.5
            u = seg(t, T["grab"], T["grab"] + 0.45)
            pose = blend("dead_front", "carried", smooth(u))
            if t > T["K2"] + 0.25:
                pose = blend("carried", "dead_back", seg(t, T["K2"] + 0.25, T["K2"] + 1.2))
            return dict(pos=(px, 0, pz), yaw=sb["yaw"], pose=pose, rifle=False, dead=True)

        if who == "seby":
            walk = [(1.2, -4.0), (1.0, 3.6), self.SEBY_HOME]
            hx, hz = self.SEBY_HOME
            if t < 5.3:
                u = seg(t, 0.35, 5.3)
                (x, z), yaw = path_at(walk, ease_out(u))
                pose = pose_walk(path_len(walk) * ease_out(u) * 4.0) if u < 0.97 else POSES["ready"]
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=True)
            L3 = T["L3"]
            if t < T["K1"]:
                u = seg(t, L3.start - 0.6, L3.start)
                yaw = lerp_yaw(0, -72, smooth(u))
                aiming = u > 0.5 and t < L3.end + 0.3
                if t > L3.end + 0.3:
                    yaw = lerp_yaw(-72, -10, smooth(seg(t, L3.end + 0.3, L3.end + 1.0)))
                return dict(pos=(hx, 0, hz), yaw=yaw, pose=POSES["aim" if aiming else "ready"], rifle=True)
            dv = T["dive"]
            cx, cz = self.SEBY_COVER
            if t < dv:
                u = seg(t, T["K1"] + 0.3, T["K1"] + 1.0)
                return dict(pos=(hx, 0, hz), yaw=lerp_yaw(-10, -120, smooth(u)),
                            pose=blend("ready", "stand", u), rifle=True)
            if t < dv + 0.7:
                u = seg(t, dv, dv + 0.7)
                x, z = lerp(hx, cx, ease_out(u)), lerp(hz, cz, ease_out(u))
                pose = keyed_pose([(0, "ready"), (0.25, "dive"), (0.7, "cover_tight")], t - dv)
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=lerp_yaw(-120, 175, u), pose=pose, rifle=True)
            go = T["seby_go"]
            if t < go:
                peek = t > T["L6"].start - 0.3
                return dict(pos=(cx, 0, cz),
                            yaw=lerp_yaw(175, -20, smooth(seg(t, T["L6"].start - 0.3, T["L6"].start + 0.2))),
                            pose=POSES["cover" if peek else "cover_tight"], rifle=True)
            gx, gz = self._gabi_rest()
            kneel_at = (gx - 0.4, gz - 1.6)
            run = [(cx, cz), (1.6, 5.3), (1.6, 7.0), kneel_at]
            arrive = T["seby_arrive"]
            if t < arrive:
                u = seg(t, go, arrive)
                (x, z), yaw = path_at(run, u)
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose_run(path_len(run) * u * 3.2, lean=22),
                            rifle=False)
            face = math.degrees(math.atan2(gx - kneel_at[0], gz - kneel_at[1]))
            if t < T["grab"]:
                u = smooth(seg(t, arrive, T["grab"]))
                return dict(pos=(kneel_at[0], 0, kneel_at[1]), yaw=lerp_yaw(path_at(run, 1)[1], face, u),
                            pose=blend("kneel", "kneel_over", u), rifle=False)
            drag_path = [kneel_at, (1.4, 6.9), (1.6, 5.2)]
            span = T["K2"] + 1.4                     # he never makes it
            if t < T["K2"]:
                u = seg(t, T["grab"], span)
                (x, z), _ = path_at(drag_path, ease_in_out(u) * 0.95)
                yaw = lerp_yaw(face, 20, smooth(seg(t, T["grab"], T["grab"] + 1.0)))
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose_drag((t - T["grab"]) * 5.0), rifle=False)
            (x, z), _ = path_at(drag_path, ease_in_out(seg(T["K2"], T["grab"], span)) * 0.95)
            k = t - T["K2"]
            pose = keyed_pose([(0, pose_drag((T["K2"] - T["grab"]) * 5.0)),
                               (0.12, dict(POSES["drag"], spine=-20, head_p=-40, lsh_p=40, rsh_p=50)),
                               (0.9, dict(POSES["slump"], spine=-30, head_p=-40)),
                               (1.7, "dead_back")], k)
            back = 0.6 * smooth(seg(k, 0.4, 1.7))
            yr = math.radians(20)
            return dict(pos=(x - math.sin(yr) * back, 0, z - math.cos(yr) * back), yaw=20,
                        pose=pose, rifle=False, dead=True)

        if who == "darius":
            walk = [(4.4, -4.5), (3.6, 3.6), self.DARIUS_HOME]
            hx, hz = self.DARIUS_HOME
            if t < 5.6:
                u = seg(t, 0.5, 5.6)
                (x, z), yaw = path_at(walk, ease_out(u))
                pose = pose_walk(path_len(walk) * ease_out(u) * 4.0) if u < 0.97 else POSES["radio"]
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=True)
            dv = T["dive"]
            cx, cz = self.DARIUS_COVER
            if t < dv:
                yaw = 10 if t < T["K1"] else lerp_yaw(10, -140, smooth(seg(t, T["K1"] + 0.5, T["K1"] + 1.2)))
                return dict(pos=(hx, 0, hz), yaw=yaw, pose=POSES["radio" if t < T["K1"] else "stand"], rifle=True)
            if t < dv + 0.8:
                u = seg(t, dv + 0.1, dv + 0.8)
                x, z = lerp(hx, cx, ease_out(u)), lerp(hz, cz, ease_out(u))
                pose = keyed_pose([(0, "stand"), (0.35, "dive"), (0.8, "cover_tight")], t - dv)
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=lerp_yaw(-140, 185, u), pose=pose, rifle=True)
            c0, c1 = T["crawl0"], T["crawl1"]
            if t < c0:
                return dict(pos=(cx, 0, cz), yaw=185, pose=POSES["cover_tight"], rifle=True)
            crawl = [(cx, cz - 0.6), (9.3, 4.9), (9.4, 7.6), (8.4, 8.0)]
            if t < c1:
                u = seg(t, c0, c1)
                (x, z), yaw = path_at(crawl, ease_in_out(u))
                pose = blend("cover_tight", pose_crawl(u * 14), seg(t, c0, c0 + 0.35))
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=False)
            x, z = crawl[-1]
            yaw = lerp_yaw(path_at(crawl, 1)[1], -60, smooth(seg(t, c1, c1 + 0.3)))
            if t < T["K3"]:
                pose = keyed_pose([(0, pose_crawl(14)), (0.35, DARIUS_REACH), (0.6, DARIUS_MAYDAY)], t - c1)
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=False, handset=t > c1 + 0.5)
            k = t - T["K3"]
            # stays flat on the deck: propped on one elbow -> face down. (The old
            # kneel-up 'mayday' pose and an arm hanging under the body made him
            # hop up and then hover above the road.)
            pose = keyed_pose([(0, DARIUS_MAYDAY),
                               (0.08, dict(DARIUS_MAYDAY, head_p=-20, spine=-20, body_r=-8)),
                               (0.6, DARIUS_DEAD)], k)
            return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=False, dead=True, handset=k < 0.5)

        if who == "biribel":
            walk = [(-4.6, -6.0), (-5.2, 0.0), self.BIRIBEL_HOME]
            if t < 6.0:
                u = seg(t, 0.8, 6.0)
                (x, z), yaw = path_at(walk, ease_out(u))
                pose = pose_walk(path_len(walk) * ease_out(u) * 4.0, base="stand") if u < 0.97 else POSES["cover"]
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=False)
            x, z = self.BIRIBEL_HOME
            if t >= T["P0"] - 0.25:
                return self._biribel_pickup(t)
            if t < T["dive"]:
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=8, pose=POSES["cover"], rifle=False)
            s0 = T["K2"] + 0.9                   # turns and puts his back to the concrete
            if t < s0:
                u = seg(t, T["dive"], T["dive"] + 0.5)
                return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=8, pose=blend("cover", "cover_tight", u), rifle=False)
            u = smooth(seg(t, s0, s0 + 0.8))
            sit = dict(POSES["cover_tight"], spine=-6, head_p=8, lhip_p=110, rhip_p=96, lkn=140, rkn=120,
                       lsh_p=50, lel=100, rsh_p=30, rel=60)
            hit = T["K4"] + 0.07
            if t > hit:
                k = t - hit
                flinch = dict(sit, spine=30, head_p=44, spine_r=-18, lsh_p=150, lel=150, rsh_p=140, rel=150)
                sit = blend(sit, flinch, k / 0.12) if k < 0.12 else blend(flinch, sit, 0.35 * smooth(seg(k, 0.4, 2.0)))
            pose = blend("cover_tight", sit, u) if u < 1 else sit
            return dict(pos=(x, 0, z - 0.1 * u), yaw=lerp_yaw(8, 182, u), pose=pose, rifle=False)

        if who == "sniper":
            pose = dict(POSES["prone"], head_p=-10, lsh_p=160, rsh_p=150, rifle_p=2)
            return dict(pos=SET.SNIPER_POS, yaw=180, pose=pose, rifle=True)
        return None

    def _biribel_pickup(self, t):
        T = self.T
        P0 = T["P0"] - 0.25                  # lunges flat right as the shot cuts
        sit = self._actor_state("biribel", P0 - 1e-3)
        x0, z0 = sit["pos"][0], sit["pos"][2]
        path = [(x0 + 0.3, z0 - 0.15), (-2.4, 4.85), self.PK_KNEEL]
        c0, c1 = P0 + 0.15, P0 + 2.35
        if t < c1:
            u = seg(t, c0, c1)
            (x, z), yaw = path_at(path, ease_in_out(u))
            crawl = pose_crawl(u * 16)
            pose = blend(sit["pose"], crawl, smooth(seg(t, P0, P0 + 0.3)))
            yaw = lerp_yaw(sit["yaw"], yaw, smooth(seg(t, P0, P0 + 0.3)))
            return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=yaw, pose=pose, rifle=False)
        x, z = self.PK_KNEEL
        u = smooth(seg(t, c1, c1 + 0.45))
        return dict(pos=(x, 0, z), yaw=lerp_yaw(90, 70, u),
                    pose=blend(pose_crawl(16), "kneel_over", u), rifle=False)

    def _joints(self, who, t):
        st = self._actor_state(who, t)
        _, j, _ = self.actors[who].pose_world(st["pose"], st["pos"], st["yaw"], rifle_on=False)
        return j

    def _gabi_rest(self):
        if self._gabi_rest_c is None:
            T = self.T
            st = self._actor_state("gabi", T["K1"] + 1.6)
            self._gabi_rest_c = (st["pos"][0], st["pos"][2])
        return self._gabi_rest_c

    def _emit_actor(self, who, t, yoff=0.0):
        st = self._actor_state(who, t)
        if st is None:
            return None
        hum = self.actors[who]
        j = self.r.add_humanoid(hum, st["pose"], (st["pos"][0], st["pos"][1] + yoff, st["pos"][2]),
                                st["yaw"], rifle_on=st.get("rifle", False))
        st["joints"] = j
        if st.get("handset"):
            hb = box(0.06, 0.16, 0.06, (20, 20, 20))
            hv = [v_add(p, j["lhand"]) for p in hb.verts]
            self.r.add_dynamic(hv, [(i, c, l, d, None, e) for i, c, l, d, e in hb.faces])
        return st

    # ── drawing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _shot_at(self, t):
        for a, b, name in self.shots:
            if a <= t < b:
                return a, b, name
        return self.shots[-1]

    def _camera(self, name, u, t, a, b):
        """-> (pos, target, fov, roll, focus) for a shot at progress u."""
        T = self.T
        hand = (math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.03, math.sin(t * 1.9 + 1) * 0.025, 0.0)
        if name == "establish":
            k = ease_in_out(u)
            pos = v_lerp((-8.0, 12.0, -42.0), (-6.2, 2.3, -11.5), k)
            tgt = v_lerp((0.0, 4.0, 30.0), (-1.0, 1.5, 10.0), k)
            return pos, tgt, lerp(54, 46, k), lerp(-3, 0, k), None
        if name == "gabi_lane":
            gx, gz = self.GABI_HOME
            pos = v_add((gx + 1.5 - 0.3 * u, 1.3, gz + 2.7 - 0.4 * u), hand)
            return pos, (gx - 0.1, 1.55, gz), 40, 1.5, ("far", 7.0)
        if name == "seby_west":
            sx, sz = self.SEBY_HOME
            pos = v_add((sx + 1.5, 1.72, sz + 0.6 - 0.25 * u), hand)
            return pos, (-14.0, 1.0, sz + 6.0 + 2 * u), 44, -1.0, ("near", 2.2)
        if name == "gabi_radio":
            gx, gz = self.GABI_HOME
            yr = math.radians(self.GABI_TURN)
            fx, fz = math.sin(yr), math.cos(yr)
            px, pz = -fz, fx                      # perpendicular
            k = smooth(seg(t, a, T["K1"]))
            back = smooth(seg(t, T["K1"] + 0.3, T["K1"] + 1.4))
            dist = lerp(3.6, 3.0, k) + 0.9 * back
            pos = v_add((gx + fx * dist + px * 0.55, lerp(1.5, 1.25, back), gz + fz * dist + pz * 0.55), hand)
            tgt = (gx + fx * 1.2 * back, lerp(1.5, 0.35, back), gz + fz * 1.2 * back)
            return pos, tgt, lerp(36, 32, k) + 10 * back, 0.0, ("far", 7.0)
        if name == "dead_air":
            pos = v_add((-6.9, 1.3, 3.8), v_mul3(hand, 0.5))
            return pos, (-1.8, 0.35, 10.0), 50, 0.0, None
        if name == "glint":
            k = ease_in_out(u)
            tgt = v_lerp((-1.8, 0.4, 10.0), self.scope_pt, k)
            fov = lerp(50, 9.0, ease_in_out(seg(u, 0.2, 1.0)))
            return (-5.9, 1.3, 4.6), tgt, fov, 0.0, ("near", 12.0) if u > 0.35 else None
        if name == "dive":
            return v_add((-14.0, 1.6, 9.0), hand), (2.0, 0.5, 7.4), 46, 0.0, None
        if name == "seby_close":
            hd = self._joints("seby", min(t, T["seby_go"] - 0.01))["head"]
            return v_add((hd[0] - 1.25, hd[1] - 0.05, hd[2] + 0.75), hand), (hd[0], hd[1] - 0.08, hd[2]), 46, 0.0, ("far", 3.2)
        if name == "sprint":
            sb = self._actor_state("seby", t)["pos"]
            gx, gz = self._gabi_rest()
            return v_add((-1.4 + 0.5 * u, 2.3, 3.0), hand), ((sb[0] + gx) / 2, 0.5, (sb[2] + gz) / 2), 52, 0.0, None
        if name == "drag":
            sb = self._actor_state("seby", t)["pos"]
            return v_add((-6.0, 0.5, 7.4 + 0.4 * u), hand), (sb[0] - 0.2, 0.65, sb[2] + 0.5), 38, 0.0, None
        if name == "scope_seby":
            st = self._actor_state("seby", t)
            ch = (st["pos"][0], 1.0, st["pos"][2] + 0.1)
            k = smooth(seg(t, a, T["K2"] - 0.3))
            sway = (math.sin(t * 2.1) * 0.35 * (1 - k) + 0.6 * (1 - k), math.sin(t * 2.9) * 0.18 * (1 - k), 0)
            kick = max(0.0, 1 - (t - T["K2"]) / 0.12) * 1.6 if t > T["K2"] else 0.0
            return self.scope_pt, v_add(ch, (sway[0], sway[1] + kick, 0)), 4.6, 0.0, "scope"
        if name == "seby_down":
            sb = self._actor_state("seby", t)["pos"]
            return (sb[0] - 2.6, 0.62, sb[2] + 2.6), (sb[0] + 0.1, 0.35, sb[2] - 0.5), 42, 0.0, None
        if name == "biribel_cover":
            hd = self._joints("biribel", t)["head"]
            pos = v_add((hd[0] + 0.25, hd[1] - 0.12, hd[2] - 1.55 + 0.25 * u), v_mul3(hand, 0.6))
            return pos, (hd[0], hd[1] - 0.18, hd[2]), 44, 0.0, ("far", 2.6)
        if name == "darius":
            d = self._actor_state("darius", t)["pos"]
            return v_add((5.4, 0.55, 10.9), hand), (d[0] + 0.2, 0.3, d[2] - 0.2), 44, 0.0, None
        if name == "scope_biribel":
            k = ease_in_out(seg(t, a, T["K4"] - 0.5))
            dp = self._actor_state("darius", t)["pos"]
            tgt = v_lerp((dp[0], 0.3, dp[2]), (self.BIRIBEL_HOME[0] + 0.15, 0.86, SET.BARRIER_Z), k)
            sway = (math.sin(t * 2.3) * 0.12, math.sin(t * 3.1) * 0.06, 0)
            kick = max(0.0, 1 - (t - T["K4"]) / 0.1) * 1.4 if t > T["K4"] else 0.0
            return self.scope_pt, v_add(tgt, (sway[0], sway[1] + kick, 0)), lerp(7.5, 3.8, k), 0.0, "scope"
        if name == "near_miss":
            hd = self._joints("biribel", a)["head"]
            k = ease_out(seg(t, a, a + 2.0))
            pos = v_add((hd[0] + 1.6 - 0.3 * k, hd[1] - 0.15, hd[2] - 2.5 + 0.4 * k), hand)
            return pos, (hd[0] + 0.1, hd[1] - 0.1, hd[2] + 0.3), lerp(56, 44, k), lerp(4, 0, k), None
        if name == "pk_crawl":
            b_ = self._actor_state("biribel", t)["pos"]
            k = ease_in_out(u)
            pos = v_add((lerp(2.9, 2.4, k), 0.5, lerp(3.0, 2.8, k)), v_mul3(hand, 0.5))
            return pos, (b_[0] + 0.2, 0.32, b_[2] + 0.1), 44, lerp(-2, 0, k), None
        breath = (math.sin(t * 2.4) * 0.012, math.sin(t * 4.8) * 0.01, 0.0)
        ex, ey, ez = self.PK_EYE
        if name == "pk_body":
            k = ease_in_out(u)
            pos = v_add((ex + 0.12 * k, ey - 0.05 * k, ez + 0.1 * k), breath)
            tgt = v_lerp((1.0, 0.3, 4.9), (0.95, 0.28, 5.15), k)
            return pos, tgt, lerp(54, 48, k), lerp(3, 1, k), None
        if name == "pk_reach":
            k = ease_in_out(seg(u, 0.0, 0.6))
            pos = v_add((ex + 0.12 + 0.08 * k, ey - 0.05 - 0.1 * k, ez + 0.1 + 0.06 * k), breath)
            rx, _, rz = self.PK_RIFLE
            tgt = v_lerp((0.95, 0.28, 5.15), (rx + 0.25, 0.05, rz + 0.12), k)
            return pos, tgt, 52, 1.0, None
        if name == "pk_raise":
            k = ease_in_out(seg(u, 0.0, 0.35))
            pos = v_add((ex + 0.2, lerp(ey - 0.15, ey + 0.02, k), ez + 0.16), breath)
            tgt = v_lerp((self.PK_RIFLE[0] + 0.25, 0.05, self.PK_RIFLE[2] + 0.12), (1.7, 0.72, 6.3), k)
            return pos, tgt, 52, 0.0, None
        return (0, 2, -10), (0, 1, 0), 60, 0.0, None

    # ── first-person pickup (Biribel's hands + Seby's OS-12) ────────────
    def _rifle_ground_M(self):
        return m_mul(rot_y(self.PK_RIFLE_YAW), rot_z(90))

    def _cam_pt(self, lp):
        r = self.r
        return v_add(r.cam, v_add(v_add(v_mul3(r.right, lp[0]), v_mul3(r.up, lp[1])), v_mul3(r.fwd, lp[2])))

    def _rifle_inspect(self, t):
        """-> (world_fn, M_local) of the OS-12 held up in front of the camera."""
        T = self.T
        k = t - T["P3"]
        lift = ease_out(seg(k, 0.0, 0.7))
        turn = ease_in_out(seg(k, 0.5, 2.6))
        sway = math.sin(t * 1.7) * 2.0
        R = m_mul(rot_y(lerp(122, 98, turn) + sway), m_mul(rot_x(lerp(-24, -6, lift)), rot_z(lerp(70, 10, turn))))
        org = (lerp(-0.2, -0.28, turn), lerp(-0.75, -0.1, lift) + math.sin(t * 2.4) * 0.008, 1.4)
        return R, org

    def _emit_fpv(self, name, t):
        T = self.T
        r = self.r
        skin, sleeve = SPECS["biribel"]["skin"], SPECS["biribel"]["jacket"]
        mesh = self.loose_os12 if name == "pk_reach" else self.vm_os12
        if name == "pk_reach":
            M = self._rifle_ground_M()
            lift = 0.22 * ease_in_out(seg(t, T["G"] + 0.05, T["P3"])) if t > T["G"] else 0.0
            base = v_add(self.PK_RIFLE, (0, lift, 0))
            to_w = lambda v: v_add(m_apply(M, v), base)
            grip_r, grip_l = to_w(OS12_GRIP), to_w(OS12_FORE)
            if t <= T["G"]:
                kr = ease_in_out(seg(t, T["P2"] + 0.35, T["G"]))
                kl = ease_in_out(seg(t, T["P2"] + 0.5, T["G"] + 0.12))
                grip_r = v_lerp(self._cam_pt((0.16, -0.32, 0.30)), grip_r, kr)
                grip_l = v_lerp(self._cam_pt((-0.16, -0.32, 0.30)), grip_l, kl)
            verts = [to_w(v) for v in mesh.verts]
            r.add_dynamic(verts, [(i, c, 3, d, None, e) for i, c, l, d, e in mesh.faces])
        else:
            R, org = self._rifle_inspect(t)
            to_w = lambda v: self._cam_pt(v_add(m_apply(R, v), org))
            verts = [to_w(v) for v in mesh.verts]
            r.add_dynamic(verts, [(i, c, 3, d, None, e) for i, c, l, d, e in mesh.faces])
            grip_r, grip_l = to_w(OS12_GRIP), to_w(OS12_FORE)
        if name == "pk_reach":
            arms = ((grip_r, self._cam_pt((0.26, -0.5, 0.12))), (grip_l, self._cam_pt((-0.26, -0.5, 0.18))))
        else:                                # elbows hang below the frame
            arms = ((grip_r, to_w((0, -0.75, -0.25))), (grip_l, to_w((0, -0.7, 0.2))))
        for hand, el in arms:
            wrist = v_lerp(el, hand, 0.86)
            self._seg_box(el, wrist, 0.085, sleeve)
            self._seg_box(v_lerp(el, hand, 0.8), hand, 0.07, skin, h=0.045)

    def _seg_box(self, a, b, w, col, h=None):
        d = v_sub(b, a)
        L = v_len(d)
        if L < 1e-4:
            return
        f = v_mul3(d, 1.0 / L)
        ref = self.r.up if abs(f[1]) < 0.9 else self.r.fwd
        sx = v_norm((ref[1] * f[2] - ref[2] * f[1], ref[2] * f[0] - ref[0] * f[2], ref[0] * f[1] - ref[1] * f[0]))
        sy = (f[1] * sx[2] - f[2] * sx[1], f[2] * sx[0] - f[0] * sx[2], f[0] * sx[1] - f[1] * sx[0])
        m = box(w, h or w, L, col, center=(0, 0, L / 2))
        vs = [v_add(a, v_add(v_add(v_mul3(sx, x), v_mul3(sy, y)), v_mul3(f, z))) for x, y, z in m.verts]
        self.r.add_dynamic(vs, [(i, c, 3, dd, None, e) for i, c, l, dd, e in m.faces])

    def _make_vignette(self):
        s = pygame.Surface((self.w, self.h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        cx, cy = self.w / 2, self.h / 2
        for i in range(24):
            k = i / 23
            a = int(150 * k ** 2.4)
            rx, ry = self.w * (0.78 - 0.30 * k), self.h * (0.84 - 0.30 * k)
            rx, ry = self.w * (1.05 - 0.45 * (1 - k)), self.h * (1.05 - 0.45 * (1 - k))
        # cheap radial vignette by drawing concentric dark rings from outside in
        s.fill((0, 0, 0, 0))
        steps = 18
        for i in range(steps):
            k = i / steps
            a = int(10 + 7 * i)
            rect = pygame.Rect(0, 0, int(self.w * (1.5 - 0.62 * k)), int(self.h * (1.5 - 0.62 * k)))
            rect.center = (int(cx), int(cy))
        out = pygame.Surface((self.w, self.h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for y in range(0, self.h, 2):
            for x in range(0, self.w, 2):
                dx = (x - cx) / cx
                dy = (y - cy) / cy
                d = dx * dx * 0.8 + dy * dy
                a = int(clamp((d - 0.35) / 1.2) ** 1.5 * 190)
                if a:
                    out.fill((0, 0, 0, a), (x, y, 2, 2))
        return out

    def draw(self, screen):
        t = self.t
        a, b, name = self._shot_at(t)
        if name == "black" or self.done:
            screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
            return
        u = seg(t, a, b)
        pos, tgt, fov, roll, focus = self._camera(name, u, t, a, b)
        # shake
        st = t - self.shake_t
        if st < 0.6 and self.shake_amp:
            amp = self.shake_amp * (1 - st / 0.6) ** 2
            pos = v_add(pos, (math.sin(t * 61) * amp, math.sin(t * 47 + 2) * amp, 0))
        scope = focus == "scope"
        r = self.r
        r.set_camera(pos, tgt, fov, roll)
        surf = r.surface
        hy = r.horizon_y()
        surf.blit(self.sky, (0, int(hy) - self.sky_hy))
        r.begin()
        r.add_static()
        for who in ("gabi", "seby", "darius", "biribel", "sniper"):
            if who == "sniper" and scope:
                continue                     # we ARE the sniper
            if who == "biribel" and name in FPV_SHOTS:
                continue                     # we ARE Biribel
            self._emit_actor(who, t)
        self._emit_props(t)
        self._emit_fx(t)
        if name in FPV_SHOTS:
            self._emit_fpv(name, t)
        if focus in (None, "scope"):
            r.flush(surf)
        elif focus[0] == "far":
            r.flush_split(surf, focus[1], lambda s: _blur(s, 3.0))
        else:
            _flush_near_blur(r, surf, focus[1])
        self._draw_rain(surf, t, scope)
        if name == "glint":
            self._draw_glint(surf, t, u)
        if not scope:
            surf.blit(self._vign, (0, 0))
        # dead air: desaturate + darken right after the first kill
        if name in ("gabi_radio", "dead_air") and t > self.T["K1"]:
            k = clamp(1 - (t - self.T["K1"] - 2.5) / 2.0) * 0.55
            _desat(surf, k)
        if name in FPV_SHOTS:
            beat = (t * 1.25) % 1.0
            _desat(surf, 0.2 + 0.2 * max(0.0, 1 - beat / 0.18))
        if scope:
            self._draw_scope(surf, t)
        big = pygame.transform.scale(surf, (WIDTH, HEIGHT))
        screen.blit(big, (0, 0))
        ft = t - self.flash_t
        if 0 <= ft < 0.12:
            fl = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
            fl.fill((255, 250, 235))
            fl.set_alpha(int(170 * (1 - ft / 0.12)))
            screen.blit(fl, (0, 0))
        self._draw_bars(screen, t)
        if name == "pk_raise":
            try:
                from missions.m2.draw import _draw_weapon_stat_card
                _draw_weapon_stat_card(screen, t - self.T["P3"] - 0.9, weapon_name="OS-12",
                                       weapon_class="ASSAULT RIFLE", caliber="5.56 x 45 mm",
                                       magazine="25 rounds", role="Mid-range, sustained automatic fire",
                                       flavor="Lower per-shot damage than the pistol. Spray to suppress.",
                                       stamp_text="SEBY'S OS-12 - ACQUIRED")
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _emit_props(self, t):
        T = self.T
        r = self.r
        # dropped rifles
        drops = []
        if t > T["K1"] + 0.35:
            g = self._gabi_rest()
            drops.append((self.loose_rifle, (g[0] + 0.7, 0.04, g[1] + 0.2), 120))
        if T["K2"] + 0.5 < t < T["G"]:       # slid off Seby's sling as he fell
            drops.append((self.loose_os12, self.PK_RIFLE, self.PK_RIFLE_YAW))
        if t > T["crawl0"]:
            drops.append((self.loose_rifle, (self.DARIUS_COVER[0] - 0.3, 0.04, self.DARIUS_COVER[1] - 0.6), -30))
        for mesh, p, yaw in drops:
            M = m_mul(rot_y(yaw), rot_z(90))
            vs = [v_add(m_apply(M, v), p) for v in mesh.verts]
            r.add_dynamic(vs, [(i, c, l, d, None, e) for i, c, l, d, e in mesh.faces])
        # blood pools
        pools = []
        if t > T["K1"] + 1.3:
            gx, gz = self._gabi_rest()
            yr = math.radians(self.GABI_TURN)
            pools.append(((gx + math.sin(yr) * 0.5, gz + math.cos(yr) * 0.5), seg(t, T["K1"] + 1.3, T["K1"] + 8), 0.75))
        if t > T["K2"] + 1.5:
            s = self._actor_state("seby", t)["pos"]
            pools.append(((s[0], s[2] + 0.1), seg(t, T["K2"] + 1.5, T["K2"] + 7), 0.7))
        if t > T["K3"] + 0.6:
            d = self._actor_state("darius", t)["pos"]
            pools.append(((d[0] - 0.2, d[2] + 0.2), seg(t, T["K3"] + 0.6, T["K3"] + 6), 0.6))
        for (x, z), k, rad in pools:
            m = disc_xz(x, z, 0.12 + rad * k, 0.018, (70, 8, 10), n=9,
                        wobble=[1.0, .8, 1.1, .9, 1.2, .85, 1.0, .9, 1.1])
            r.add_dynamic(m.verts, [(i, c, 1, True, None, True) for i, c, l, d, e in m.faces])
        # fires on burned cars + smoke
        for i, fp in enumerate(self.handles["fire_cars"]):
            fl = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 13 + i * 2) * math.sin(t * 7.3 + i)
            r.add_sprite(fp, _fire_sprite(fl), bias=-0.5)
            for k in range(5):
                age = (t * 0.35 + k / 5 + i * 0.3) % 1.0
                sp = (fp[0] + age * 2.2, fp[1] + 0.4 + age * 9.0, fp[2] + age * 1.0)
                r.add_sprite(sp, _smoke_sprite(age))

    def _emit_fx(self, t):
        r = self.r
        for (t0, a, b) in self.tracers:
            if 0 <= t - t0 < 0.07:
                r.add_line3d(a, b, (255, 236, 170), 1)
        if any(0 <= t - k < 0.06 for k in (self.T["K1"], self.T["K2"], self.T["K3"], self.T["K4"])):
            r.add_sprite(self.muzzle_pt, _muzzle_sprite, layer=3)
        for q in self.parts:
            k = q["age"] / q["life"]
            if q.get("spark"):
                r.add_sprite(q["p"], _spark_sprite(1 - k), layer=3)
            elif q.get("mist"):
                r.add_sprite(q["p"], _mist_sprite(q["col"], q["size"] * (1 + 2 * k), 1 - k))
            else:
                r.add_sprite(q["p"], _chip_sprite(q["col"], q["size"]))

    def _draw_rain(self, surf, t, scope):
        w, h = self.w, self.h
        n = 60 if scope else len(self._rain)
        col = (128, 136, 150)
        for i in range(n):
            x0, y0, s = self._rain[i]
            y = (y0 + t * (1.4 + s)) % 1.0
            x = (x0 + t * 0.12 * s) % 1.0
            px, py = x * w, y * h
            ln = 5 + 6 * s
            pygame.draw.line(surf, mix_col(col, (70, 74, 84), 1 - s), (px, py), (px - ln * 0.22, py - ln))

    def _draw_glint(self, surf, t, u):
        if u < 0.45:
            return
        p = self.r.project(self.scope_pt)
        if not p:
            return
        sx, sy, _ = p
        pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 9.0)
        k = clamp((u - 0.45) / 0.15) * (0.55 + 0.45 * pulse)
        g = pygame.Surface((60, 60))
        g.fill((0, 0, 0))
        for rr, a in ((16, 30), (8, 70), (3, 200), (1, 255)):
            v = int(a * k)
            pygame.draw.circle(g, (v, v, int(v * .9)), (30, 30), rr)
        v = int(150 * k)
        pygame.draw.line(g, (v, v, int(v * .9)), (0, 30), (59, 30), 1)
        surf.blit(g, (sx - 30, sy - 30), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_ADD)

    def _draw_scope(self, surf, t):
        w, h = self.w, self.h
        cx, cy = w // 2, h // 2
        rad = int(h * 0.46)
        mask = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        mask.fill((0, 0, 0, 255))
        pygame.draw.circle(mask, (0, 0, 0, 0), (cx, cy), rad)
        for i in range(8):
            pygame.draw.circle(mask, (0, 0, 0, 40 + i * 18), (cx, cy), rad - i, 1)
        surf.blit(mask, (0, 0))
        col = (12, 12, 12)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx - rad, cy), (cx - 10, cy), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx + 10, cy), (cx + rad, cy), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx, cy - rad), (cx, cy - 10), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx, cy + 10), (cx, cy + rad), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx - 9, cy), (cx + 9, cy), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx, cy - 9), (cx, cy + 9), 1)
        for k in range(1, 5):
            pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx - 3, cy + k * 12), (cx + 3, cy + k * 12), 1)
            pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx - k * 12, cy - 2), (cx - k * 12, cy + 2), 1)
            pygame.draw.line(surf, col, (cx + k * 12, cy - 2), (cx + k * 12, cy + 2), 1)
        pygame.draw.circle(surf, (190, 30, 20), (cx, cy), 1)

    def _draw_bars(self, screen, t):
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (0, 0, 0), (0, 0, WIDTH, BAR_H))
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (0, 0, 0), (0, HEIGHT - BAR_H, WIDTH, BAR_H))
        # fade from black at the start
        if t < 0.9:
            f = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
            f.fill((0, 0, 0))
            f.set_alpha(int(255 * (1 - t / 0.9)))
            screen.blit(f, (0, 0))
        if t < 5.0:
            a = int(255 * clamp(min((t - 1.2) / 0.6, (5.0 - t) / 0.8)))
            if a > 0:
                for i, (txt, fnt, col) in enumerate((("ROUTE 12 - TOLL PLAZA", font_speaker, (220, 214, 196)),
                                                     ("19:42  -  RAIN", font_prompt, (160, 160, 150)))):
                    s = fnt.render(txt, True, col)
                    s.set_alpha(a)
                    screen.blit(s, (46, BAR_H + 26 + i * 32))
        # subtitles
        for l in self.lines:
            if l.start <= t < l.end + 0.45:
                col = SPEAKER_COL.get(l.speaker, (230, 230, 230))
                tag = l.speaker + (" (RADIO)" if l.radio else "")
                nm = font_prompt.render(tag, True, col)
                tx = font_dialogue.render(l.text, True, (236, 234, 226))
                y = HEIGHT - BAR_H + 10
                screen.blit(nm, ((WIDTH - nm.get_width()) // 2, y))
                screen.blit(tx, ((WIDTH - tx.get_width()) // 2, y + 22))
                break
        if self._skip_hold > 0:
            k = clamp(self._skip_hold / 0.9)
            s = font_prompt.render("SKIPPING...", True, (200, 200, 190))
            screen.blit(s, (WIDTH - s.get_width() - 24, 26))
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (200, 200, 190), (WIDTH - 124, 50, int(100 * k), 3))
        elif t < 4.0:
            s = font_prompt.render("HOLD SPACE TO SKIP", True, (110, 110, 104))
            screen.blit(s, (WIDTH - s.get_width() - 24, 26))


# ── sprites & post ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def v_mul3(a, s):
    return (a[0] * s, a[1] * s, a[2] * s)


def _fire_sprite(fl):
    def draw(surf, sx, sy, scale, z):
        r = max(2, int(0.55 * scale * (0.85 + 0.3 * fl)))
        if r > 120:
            return
        g = pygame.Surface((r * 4, r * 5))
        g.fill((0, 0, 0))
        cx, cy = r * 2, r * 3
        pygame.draw.circle(g, (34, 14, 4), (cx, cy), int(r * 1.9))
        pygame.draw.circle(g, (60, 26, 6), (cx, cy), int(r * 1.2))
        h = int(r * (2.0 + fl))
        pygame.draw.polygon(g, (190, 70, 14), [(cx - r, cy + r // 2), (cx - r // 3, cy - h // 2), (cx, cy - h), (cx + r // 2, cy - h // 2), (cx + r, cy + r // 2)])
        pygame.draw.polygon(g, (230, 150, 50), [(cx - r // 2, cy + r // 2), (cx, cy - int(h * .6)), (cx + r // 2, cy + r // 2)])
        surf.blit(g, (sx - cx, sy - cy), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_ADD)
    return draw


def _smoke_sprite(age):
    def draw(surf, sx, sy, scale, z):
        r = max(2, int((0.6 + age * 2.4) * scale))
        if r > 260:
            return
        a = int(110 * (1 - age))
        g = pygame.Surface((r * 2, r * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.circle(g, (34, 33, 34, a), (r, r), r)
        surf.blit(g, (sx - r, sy - r))
    return draw


def _muzzle_sprite(surf, sx, sy, scale, z):
    r = max(3, int(0.6 * scale))
    if r > 60:
        return
    g = pygame.Surface((r * 4, r * 4), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.circle(g, (255, 200, 120, 120), (r * 2, r * 2), r * 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(g, (255, 250, 220, 255), (r * 2, r * 2), r)
    surf.blit(g, (sx - r * 2, sy - r * 2), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)


def _spark_sprite(k):
    def draw(surf, sx, sy, scale, z):
        r = max(2, int(0.5 * scale * k))
        if r > 120:
            return
        g = pygame.Surface((r * 2 + 2, r * 2 + 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.circle(g, (255, 240, 200, int(255 * k)), (r + 1, r + 1), r)
        surf.blit(g, (sx - r, sy - r), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)
    return draw


def _mist_sprite(col, size, k):
    def draw(surf, sx, sy, scale, z):
        r = max(1, int(size * scale))
        if r > 200:
            return
        g = pygame.Surface((r * 2, r * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.circle(g, (*col, int(90 * k)), (r, r), r)
        surf.blit(g, (sx - r, sy - r))
    return draw


def _chip_sprite(col, size):
    def draw(surf, sx, sy, scale, z):
        r = max(1, min(40, int(size * scale)))
        pygame.draw.rect(surf, col, (int(sx) - r // 2, int(sy) - r // 2, r, r))
    return draw


def _blur(surf, k):
    w, h = surf.get_size()
    small = pygame.transform.smoothscale(surf, (max(1, int(w / k)), max(1, int(h / k))))
    surf.blit(pygame.transform.smoothscale(small, (w, h)), (0, 0))


def _flush_near_blur(r, surf, split):
    """Sharp background, blurred foreground (rack focus to the distance)."""
    def blur(tmp):
        w, h = tmp.get_size()
        return pygame.transform.smoothscale(pygame.transform.smoothscale(tmp, (w // 4, h // 4)), (w, h))
    r.flush_near_blur(surf, split, blur)


def _desat(surf, k):
    if k <= 0.01:
        return
    g = pygame.transform.grayscale(surf)
    g.set_alpha(int(255 * k))
    surf.blit(g, (0, 0))

"""Mission 2: Quiet on Route 12 - clean cinematic vertical slice.

This module keeps the existing game integration intact:
    - game_core.start_mission2()
    - game_core.game_update()/game_draw() routing
    - acaristan.py Mission 2 intro and ending cutscenes
    - save as MISSION_2
    - dev command: python acaristan.py --dev-mission2


"""

import math

def start_mission2(preserve_timer=False):
    """Called by game_core/acaristan to begin Mission 2 gameplay."""
    STATE.reset()
    STATE.active_mission = MISSION2_KEY
    STATE.active_mission_id = MISSION2_ID
    STATE.active_mission_title = MISSION2_TITLE
    STATE.active_mission_operation = "ROUTE 12, QUIET ON ROUTE 12"
    STATE.active_mission_outcome = "KRAP framed  ·  Evidence transmitted  ·  Comms compromised"
    STATE.active_mission_quote_attr = "Vasile, over broken static:"
    STATE.active_mission_quote = '"No. They framed you first."'
    STATE.show_minimap = True  # was False - caused players to think the minimap was broken in M2
    STATE.minimap = MiniMap(MISSION2_MAP, palette="m2")
    STATE.mission_start_time = STATE.mission_start_time if (preserve_timer and STATE.mission_start_time) else pygame.time.get_ticks()
    STATE.mission_end_time = 0
    STATE.hostiles_killed = 0
    STATE.shots_fired = 0
    STATE.shots_hit = 0
    STATE.request_mission2_ending = False
    STATE.request_death_screen = False
    STATE.player_dead = False
    STATE.death_timer = 0

    STATE.mission2_stage = STAGE_INVESTIGATE
    STATE.mission_phase = "m2_investigate"
    STATE.mission2_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_events = set()
    STATE.mission2_card = None
    STATE.mission2_comms_cut = False
    STATE.mission2_tanker_exploded = False
    STATE.mission2_countdown = 0
    STATE.mission2_upload_progress = 0.0
    STATE.mission2_upload_started = False
    STATE.mission2_evidence_uploaded = False
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus = None
    STATE.mission2_sniper_traces = []
    STATE.mission2_sniper_lasers = []
    STATE.mission2_abandoned_nest = None
    STATE.mission2_sniper_muzzle_flashes = []
    STATE.mission2_sniper_flash = 0
    STATE.mission2_near_miss_flash = 0
    STATE.mission2_tinnitus_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_tanker_blast_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_tanker_shockwave_radius = 0
    STATE.mission2_tanker_shake_decay = 0
    # Aftermath visuals - initialized empty so drawing code can safely
    # getattr them before the blast fires. Populated in _explode_tanker.
    STATE.mission2_tanker_scorch = None
    STATE.mission2_tanker_scorch_cracks = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_destroyed = False
    STATE.mission2_tanker_debris_field = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_outer_debris = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_blast_streaks = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_asphalt_cracks = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_spot_fires = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_wreckage_ribs = []
    STATE.mission2_all_clues_found = False
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_current_zone = "approach"
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_phase = ""
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_grace_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_sniper_pressure_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_sniper_pending_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_sniper_target = None
    STATE.mission2_sniper_suppressed = False
    # Cleanup-team spawn gate for the post-flank "done" phase. Reset on
    # mission restart so the squad can spawn again on a fresh playthrough.
    STATE.mission2_cleanup_team_spawned = False
    # Tanker inspection gate. The player must press [E] at the tanker to
    # discover the hidden detonator before the run-to-shelter phase begins.
    # Resets on mission restart.
    STATE.mission2_tanker_inspected = False
    STATE.mission2_sniper_lock = 0
    STATE.mission2_sniper_lock_max = SNIPER_LOCK_FRAMES
    STATE.mission2_sniper_warned = set()
    STATE.mission2_sniper_lethal_target = None
    STATE.mission2_sniper_kill_flash = 0
    STATE.mission2_sniper_close_execute_done = False
    STATE.mission2_cover_hold = 0
    STATE.mission2_reinforcement_waves = 0
    STATE.mission2_reinforcement_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_reinforcement_triggered = False
    # Evidence-phase multi-wave reinforcement state. Reset on mission start
    # so a restart doesn't carry stale wave counters from a previous run.
    STATE.mission2_evidence_wave = 0
    STATE.mission2_evidence_wave_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_evidence_wave_cleared = False
    # Sniper-cutscene removed. Minimal combat state kept below.
    STATE.mission2_input_freeze = 0
    STATE.mission2_radio_muffle_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_heartbeat_active = False
    STATE.mission2_heartbeat_timer = 0
    # One-shot radio gate - must be reset on mission start so the
    # "tanker manifest - second cargo" line can fire on a fresh playthrough.
    # Previously stayed True across restarts, silencing the line forever.
    STATE.mission2_late_reveal_played = False
    STATE.mission2_hard_black = 0
    STATE.mission2_chromatic_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_death_callout = None
    # Player try-to-save-Gabi state. Both default False so the
    # acknowledgment line in _m1_regroup_wrong_scan only fires if the

    STATE.mission2_tried_to_save_acknowledged = False
    # Sniper cutscene phase state. These were previously only initialized
    # inside _start_sniper_sequence, which meant stale state could leak
    # between cutscene runs and silently change the next opening beat.
    STATE.mission2_sniper_phase = "regroup"
    STATE.mission2_sniper_phase_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_sniper_events_fired = set()
    STATE.mission2_sniper_origin_revealed = False
    STATE.mission2_sniper_silhouette_flash = 0
    STATE.mission2_camera_snap = None
    STATE.mission2_sniper3d = None          # 3D film object (missions/m2/sniper3d.py)

    STATE._m3_pickup_done = False
    STATE._seby_os12_granted = False
    STATE._m3_killbox_started = False

    STATE.os12_unlocked = False
    STATE.os12_ammo_in_mag = 25
    STATE.os12_spare_mags = 2
    STATE.os12_shot_cooldown = 0
    STATE.current_weapon = "pistol"

    STATE.mag_size = 12
    STATE.spare_mags = 4
    STATE.player_bottles = 2
    STATE.shot_cooldown = 0
    STATE.is_reloading = False
    STATE.reload_timer = 0
    STATE.melee_active = False
    STATE.melee_timer = 0

    _build_world()
    _init_scripted_props()

    _snap_camera_to(_player_pos())
    STATE.screen_shake = 0  # fresh start must not inherit a previous run's shake
    STATE.mission2_camera_initialized = True  # legacy flag, kept for save compatibility
    STATE.camera_initialized = True  # shared flag: camera is already snapped, don't re-snap in update_camera

    _m2_world._objective = f"Inspect staged evidence markers with [E] (0/{REQUIRED_INVESTIGATION_CLUES})"
    _m2_world._radio_marks = set()
    _m2_world._last_keys = None
    # Skip the investigation-phase intro radio line when starting from a
    # checkpoint or dev jump - it's wrong context for those entry points.
    if not getattr(STATE, "_skip_mission2_intro_radio", False):
        _radio('VASILE: "Start with the obvious lie. Inspect the staged evidence."', mark="start")
    else:
        STATE._skip_mission2_intro_radio = False  # reset the flag
    return STATE.player


def _mark_squad_dead():
    """Mark all KRAP squad actors as dead at their kill-box final positions.

    Used by all post-kill-box skip shortcuts (flank, truck, checkpoint,
    evidence-debug) to ensure the squad renders as corpses after the sniper
    kill-box has killed them. Without this, the squad would visibly be
    standing and alive at the regroup point despite the narrative having
    moved past their deaths.

    Positions match REGROUP_TARGET_POSITIONS (where they died during
    movement_one / movement_two) and the state matches what _kill_actor()
    sets: alive=False, activity="down".

    Note: start_mission2_sniper and start_mission2_after_sniper do NOT call
    this - those shortcuts land BEFORE/DURING the kill-box, so the squad
    is still alive at that point in the narrative.
    """
    STATE.mission2_squad = [
        {"name": "GABI",   "pos": list(REGROUP_TARGET_POSITIONS[0]), "alive": False, "activity": "down", "reaction": "down"},
        {"name": "SEBY",   "pos": list(REGROUP_TARGET_POSITIONS[1]), "alive": False, "activity": "down", "reaction": "down"},
        {"name": "DARIUS", "pos": list(REGROUP_TARGET_POSITIONS[2]), "alive": False, "activity": "down", "reaction": "down"},
    ]
    print(f"[SQUAD] Marked dead at kill-box positions: {[(a['name'], a['alive'], a['activity']) for a in STATE.mission2_squad]}")


def start_mission2_sniper(preserve_timer=False):
    """Start Mission 2 and immediately jump to the sniper cutscene.

    Useful for testing the sniper sequence without the investigation phase.
    Usage: python acaristan.py --m2-sniper
    """
    player = start_mission2(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    # Mark all clues as found so the sniper phase triggers on approach.
    for clue in getattr(STATE, "mission2_clues", []):
        clue["done"] = True
        if clue.get("id"):
            STATE.mission2_clues_found.add(clue["id"])
    # Also mark the truck manifest as inspected so the tanker stage is available.
    if getattr(STATE, "mission2_truck_manifest", None):
        STATE.mission2_truck_manifest["done"] = True
    # Set the state as if the flank cutscene has finished: sniper suppressed,
    # cleanup team ready to spawn, stage advanced to combat.
    _cleanup_sniper_state()
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_phase = "done"
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_flank_cutscene_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_flank_cutscene_max = 0
    STATE.player_locked = False
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus = None
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus_timer = 0
    # Move the player near the flank route so they can immediately see the
    # cleanup team and truck without having to walk the whole gantry.
    if player:
        px, py = SNIPER_FLANK_POS
        player.rect.center = (px, py - 20)
        _snap_camera_to((px, py - 20))
    return player


def start_mission2_after_sniper(preserve_timer=False):
    """Start Mission 2 and jump directly to the post-sniper cutscene combat.

    Skips the investigation phase AND the sniper cutscene. The player has
    Seby's OS-12 rifle, is in STAGE_COMBAT / get_cover phase, standing at
    the nearest killbox cover position. The initial IPA team (including
    the sniper) is spawned, so the full kill-box flow plays out from the
    moment you press a movement key.

    Usage: python acaristan.py --m2-after-sniper
    """
    player = start_mission2(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    for clue in getattr(STATE, "mission2_clues", []):
        clue["done"] = True
        if clue.get("id"):
            STATE.mission2_clues_found.add(clue["id"])
    grant_seby_os12()
    if player:
        px, py = KILLBOX_COVER_POSITIONS[0]
        player.rect.center = (px, py)
        _snap_camera_to((px, py))
    print("[SKIP] --m2-after-sniper: landed at STAGE_COMBAT / get_cover")
    return player


def start_mission2_flank(preserve_timer=False):
    """Start Mission 2 and jump directly to the flank phase.

    Skips investigation, sniper cutscene, and the entire kill-box fight
    (get_cover → survive → clear). The player has the OS-12, the sniper
    is still alive on the gantry, and the post_sniper_phase is "flank".
    The player is placed right next to the south flank marker so the
    flank cutscene triggers within a second of walking.

    Usage: python acaristan.py --m2-flank
    """
    player = start_mission2(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    _mark_squad_dead()  # post-kill-box: squad is dead at regroup positions
    for clue in getattr(STATE, "mission2_clues", []):
        clue["done"] = True
        if clue.get("id"):
            STATE.mission2_clues_found.add(clue["id"])
    grant_seby_os12()
    _spawn_initial_ipa_team()
    STATE.enemies[:] = [
        e for e in STATE.enemies if getattr(e, "is_mission2_sniper", False)
    ]
    STATE.mission2_reinforcement_triggered = True
    STATE.mission2_reinforcement_waves = 3
    STATE.mission2_reinforcement_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_late_reveal_played = True
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_phase = "flank"
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_timer = 0
    STATE.mission_phase = "m2_flank_sniper"
    _set_objective("SNIPER STILL ACTIVE - flank to the orange circle")
    if player:
        fx, fy = KILLBOX_FLANK_POSITIONS[0]
        player.rect.center = (fx, fy + 300)
        _snap_camera_to((fx, fy + 300))
    print("[SKIP] --m2-flank: landed at STAGE_COMBAT / flank phase")
    return player


def start_mission2_truck(preserve_timer=False):
    """Start Mission 2 and jump directly to the truck inspection phase.

    Skips everything up to and including the flank cutscene + cleanup team
    fight. The player has the OS-12 with 2 spare mags (the cleanup-team
    reward), the sniper is suppressed/removed, and the stage is STAGE_TRUCK.
    The player is placed right next to the IPA truck so the manifest
    inspection triggers immediately.

    Usage: python acaristan.py --m2-truck
    """
    player = start_mission2(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    _mark_squad_dead()  # post-kill-box: squad is dead at regroup positions
    for clue in getattr(STATE, "mission2_clues", []):
        clue["done"] = True
        if clue.get("id"):
            STATE.mission2_clues_found.add(clue["id"])
    grant_seby_os12()
    _spawn_initial_ipa_team()
    _cleanup_sniper_state()
    STATE.mission2_cleanup_team_spawned = True
    STATE.enemies[:] = []
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_phase = ""
    STATE.mission2_stage = STAGE_TRUCK
    STATE.mission_phase = "m2_truck"
    _set_objective("Inspect the IPA truck manifest with [E]")
    # OS-12 spare mags are now granted at pickup (exactly 2) - no mid-mission
    # resupply. Scarcity is the design tension that makes the rifle feel earned.
    STATE.mission2_flank_cutscene_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus = None
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus_timer = 0
    STATE.player_locked = False
    if player:
        tx, ty = IPA_TRUCK_POS
        player.rect.center = (tx, ty + 80)
        _snap_camera_to((tx, ty + 80))
    print("[SKIP] --m2-truck: landed at STAGE_TRUCK (+2 OS 12 mags granted)")
    return player


def start_mission2_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False):
    """Start Mission 2 at the evidence-phase checkpoint (post-tanker explosion).

    Called by restart_current_mission() when STATE.mission2_checkpoint_reached
    is True - i.e. the player survived the tanker blast, reached STAGE_EVIDENCE,
    and then died during the cleanup team fight. Instead of restarting the
    entire mission from the intro cutscene, this drops the player back at
    the shelter (SAFE_ZONE) with the evidence phase already active.

    State setup mirrors what the "blast_done" card close does in _close_card():
      - Stage = STAGE_EVIDENCE
      - Player at SAFE_ZONE (the concrete shelter)
      - OS-12 granted with 2 spare mags
      - Sniper suppressed/removed
      - All clues marked as found
      - Cleanup team spawned (wave 1)
      - Persistent fire zones created (via _explode_tanker)
      - Player HP restored to 80 (survived the blast with debris scrape)
      - Checkpoint flag re-set (so subsequent deaths also respawn here)
    """
    player = start_mission2(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    # â”€â”€ CRITICAL: Re-set the checkpoint flag IMMEDIATELY after start_mission2() â”€â”€
    # start_mission2() calls STATE.reset(), which clears mission2_checkpoint_reached
    # to False. If we only re-set it at the end of this function (as the original
    # code did) and any intermediate call (grant_seby_os12, _explode_tanker,
    # _spawn_control_cleanup, etc.) throws an exception, the flag is left False.
    # The death-screen fallback handler then calls start_mission2() (NOT the
    # checkpoint variant), which also clears the flag - so the next death
    # restart does a full mission restart instead of a checkpoint respawn, or
    # worse, boots to main menu if the fallback also fails. Setting it here
    # ensures the flag survives any exception in the setup code below.
    STATE.mission2_checkpoint_reached = True
    # Suppress the investigation-phase intro radio line - wrong context for
    # the evidence phase checkpoint. We play a checkpoint-specific line instead.
    STATE._skip_mission2_intro_radio = True
    _mark_squad_dead()  # post-kill-box: squad is dead at regroup positions
    for clue in getattr(STATE, "mission2_clues", []):
        clue["done"] = True
        if clue.get("id"):
            STATE.mission2_clues_found.add(clue["id"])
    grant_seby_os12()
    _spawn_initial_ipa_team()
    _cleanup_sniper_state()
    STATE.enemies[:] = []
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_phase = ""
    STATE.mission2_stage = STAGE_EVIDENCE
    STATE.mission_phase = "m2_evidence"
    _set_objective("Enter the control building and inspect green evidence terminals")
    # Checkpoint-specific Vasile line - replaces the wrong-context
    # "inspect the staged evidence" intro that start_mission2() would play.
    _radio('VASILE: "You made it. Control building - move. The evidence is inside."',
           color=C_VASILE, mark="checkpoint_respawn")
    # Re-create the persistent fire zones from the tanker explosion so the
    # evidence phase has the same environmental pressure as the first time.
    # _explode_tanker handles the fire zones + scorch + wreckage creation.
    # We call it here to recreate the post-blast state. The player is at the
    # shelter so they survive the "blast" damage check.
    if player:
        player.rect.center = SAFE_ZONE
        player.hp = 80  # post-blast debris scrape HP
    # Re-create the persistent fire zones from the tanker explosion so the
    # evidence phase has the same environmental pressure as the first time.
    # Wrapped in try/except: _explode_tanker() is the most complex call in
    # this function (audio scheduling, particle spawning, fire zone creation,
    # vehicle charring, debris field generation) and is the most likely throw
    # point. If it fails, the checkpoint respawn still works - the player just
    # won't have the persistent fire zones, which is an acceptable degradation
    # compared to losing the checkpoint entirely or booting to main menu.
    try:
        _explode_tanker()
    except Exception as _blast_err:
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        print(f"[CHECKPOINT] _explode_tanker() failed during checkpoint respawn: {_blast_err}")
        # Still mark the tanker as exploded so downstream code (draw routines,
        # stage updates) treats it as destroyed even if the blast setup was
        # only partially applied.
        STATE.mission2_tanker_exploded = True
        STATE.mission2_tanker_destroyed = True
    # _explode_tanker sets stage to STAGE_BLACKOUT; override back to EVIDENCE.
    STATE.mission2_stage = STAGE_EVIDENCE
    STATE.mission_phase = "m2_evidence"
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus = None
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_input_freeze = 0
    # Restore HP AFTER _explode_tanker (which deals 20-40 debris damage even
    # at the shelter). The player should start the evidence phase at 80 HP.
    if player:
        player.hp = 80
    # Spawn the cleanup team (wave 1).
    STATE.mission2_events.discard("control_cleanup")  # allow re-spawn
    _spawn_control_cleanup()
    # Belt-and-suspenders re-set of the checkpoint flag. The canonical set
    # is at the top of this function (immediately after start_mission2()),
    # but we re-set here too in case any code path above unexpectedly cleared
    # it - this is the original location of the flag re-set.
    STATE.mission2_checkpoint_reached = True
    STATE.player_locked = False
    if player:
        player.rect.center = SAFE_ZONE
        _snap_camera_to(SAFE_ZONE)
        STATE.screen_shake = 0  # respawn must not inherit the killing blow's shake
    # ── Kill the _explode_tanker() aftermath so the respawn doesn't replay
    # the BLEVE symphony. _explode_tanker() (called above at line 1582)
    # sets a 130-frame white-out flash (gc_flash_timer), screenshake
    # (cleared explicitly above), and ~12 scheduled audio events
    # plus a 480-loop rig_fire_burst. Without this cleanup, the player
    # respawns into a flashbang + 8+ minutes of fire roar.
    # Surgical variant (preserves the checkpoint radio line just queued
    # by _radio() at line 1572): stop only the fire roar loop and clear
    # the scheduled-events list.
    STATE.gc_flash_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_chromatic_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_tanker_ripple_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_tanker_subflash_queue = []
    STATE.mission2_tanker_shake_decay = 0
    try:
        audio.stop("rig_fire_burst")
        audio.scheduled.clear()
    except Exception:
        pass
    print("[CHECKPOINT] Respawned at shelter - evidence phase active")
    return player


def start_mission2_evidence_debug(preserve_timer=False):
    """Start Mission 2 already past the tanker explosion, with all 3 IPA
    cleanup waves pre-cleared. Player can immediately walk around the
    control building picking up the 3 evidence files and upload them.

    Sets up the post-blast narrative state (tanker exploded, comms cut,
    OS-12 granted, all clues found) but DOES NOT call _explode_tanker -
    the burning wreckage + persistent fire zones would clutter the map
    for evidence testing. The tanker is marked "destroyed" so the
    draw routine doesn't render the intact tanker either.

    All 3 evidence waves are marked as spent (wave = 3, cleared = True)
    AND the "control_cleanup" event is added to STATE.mission2_events
    so _spawn_control_cleanup() early-outs even if something else
    triggers it.

    Usage: python acaristan.py --m2-evidence
    """
    player = start_mission2(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    # Suppress the investigation-phase intro radio line - wrong context.
    STATE._skip_mission2_intro_radio = True
    _mark_squad_dead()  # post-kill-box: squad is dead at regroup positions
    # Mark all investigation clues as found (investigation phase is over).
    for clue in getattr(STATE, "mission2_clues", []):
        clue["done"] = True
        if clue.get("id"):
            STATE.mission2_clues_found.add(clue["id"])
    # Grant Seby's OS-12 (player survived the killbox + flank + cleanup).
    grant_seby_os12()
    # Initialize IPA team state, then immediately clear it - the player
    # is past all combat.
    _spawn_initial_ipa_team()
    _cleanup_sniper_state()
    STATE.enemies[:] = []
    STATE.mission2_post_sniper_phase = ""
    STATE.mission2_cleanup_team_spawned = True
    # Post-blast narrative state. We mark the tanker as destroyed + comms
    # cut so radio dialogue + draw routines know we're past the explosion,
    # but we DON'T call _explode_tanker - the fire zones + scorch would
    # clutter the map for evidence testing.
    STATE.mission2_tanker_exploded = True
    STATE.mission2_tanker_destroyed = True
    STATE.mission2_comms_cut = True
    STATE.mission2_tanker_inspected = True
    # Skip ALL 3 evidence waves - set wave counter to max + mark cleared.
    # _update_evidence_waves() early-outs when wave >= 3.
    STATE.mission2_evidence_wave = 3
    STATE.mission2_evidence_wave_cleared = True
    STATE.mission2_evidence_wave_timer = 0
    # Mark the cleanup event as fired so _spawn_control_cleanup won't run
    # even if something else triggers it.
    STATE.mission2_events.add("control_cleanup")
    # Activate the evidence stage.
    STATE.mission2_stage = STAGE_EVIDENCE
    STATE.mission_phase = "m2_evidence"
    _set_objective("Inspect green evidence terminals with [E] (0/3)")
    # Brief Vasile line - replaces the wrong-context intro.
    _radio('VASILE: "Cleanup team\'s down. Grab the evidence - three terminals, then upload."',
           color=C_VASILE, mark="debug_evidence_start")
    # Restore player HP - player survived prior combat at full strength.
    if player:
        player.hp = 100
        # Place the player just south of the first evidence marker
        # (DECREE at _tc(55, 23)) so they can immediately walk up and
        # press [E]. The control building entrance is south of the
        # evidence cluster, so this is also the natural approach path.
        first_ev = STATE.mission2_evidence[0] if STATE.mission2_evidence else None
        if first_ev:
            fx, fy = first_ev["pos"]
            player.rect.center = (fx, fy + 80)
            _snap_camera_to((fx, fy + 80))
        else:
            player.rect.center = CONTROL_ROOM
            _snap_camera_to(CONTROL_ROOM)
    # Set checkpoint so subsequent deaths respawn at the evidence phase
    # (via start_mission2_checkpoint). This is the canonical "you
    # reached the evidence phase" respawn point.
    STATE.mission2_checkpoint_reached = True
    STATE.player_locked = False
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus = None
    STATE.mission2_camera_focus_timer = 0
    STATE.mission2_input_freeze = 0
    print("[SKIP] --m2-evidence: landed at STAGE_EVIDENCE (all 3 waves cleared)")
    return player


# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# Story scripting / interactions

def _clue_count():
    return sum(1 for c in STATE.mission2_clues if c.get("done"))


def _evidence_count():
    return sum(1 for e in STATE.mission2_evidence if e.get("done"))
