============================== FILE: ui\radio.py ==============================
"""Radio transmission widget (polish pass T6, field-radio restyle T6b).

One widget for every mission's radio traffic. The radio director in
``core.interactions`` decides WHAT is on air and WHEN (``live_line()``,
``radio_allowed()``, a pause-aware ``radio_clock()``); this module only
draws it:

* fixed bottom anchor in the free band right of the HP / weapon / molotov
  column (x >= 332) and left of the bottom-right edge markers, clear of
  the crosshair, minimap (top-right) and objective panel (top-left);
* drawn as a field radio set in the game's pixel-art style: gunmetal case
  with bevels and screws, a caller-ID screen with the speaker's pixel
  portrait (``assets/art/spr_portraits``, generated by
  ``tools/sprites/portraits.py``; integer nearest-neighbour scale only),
  speaker grille, recessed display glass with the callsign plate in the
  speaker's ``SPEAKER_COLORS`` accent, an LED signal ladder, RX lamp and an
  amber frequency readout (``mission_meta`` channel ``"NET // 141.20"``);
* bitmap pixel fonts (``ui.pixfont``, no TTF): word-wrapped body, at most
  3 rows visible (older rows scroll up and fade), typewriter paced to the VO
  clip (fixed readable rate without VO), block caret;
* slide + fade in (180 ms ease-out) with a short burst of static while the
  set "tunes in", fade out (250 ms), squelch in/out;
* signal LEDs only move while the VO channel is busy, faint scan band on
  the glass, queued-transmission LEDs, critical lines pulse the case edge
  and blink a red lamp;
* hidden instantly when the radio is blocked (cutscene / menu), frozen with
  the pause menu (all motion runs on the radio clock).

Settings (``PREFS``): radio text size (small / medium / large) and a
speaker-name toggle, persisted through ``core.settings_store``.
"""
import math
import os
import random

import pygame

from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT, SPEAKER_COLORS
from ui import pixfont

IN_MS = 180
OUT_MS = 250
STATIC_MS = 220            # static burst while the set tunes in
MAX_ROWS = 3
HISTORY_MS = 4200          # how long a finished line lingers above the live one
TYPE_MS_PER_CHAR = 30      # typewriter rate when the line has no recording
PULSE_MS = 650
# HUD anchor (logical 1000x700 px): the left HUD column (weapon panel,
# M1 molotov panel, HP strip) ends near x=300; bottom-right holds edge
# waypoint markers / M2 COMMS OFFLINE from x~830.
HUD_ANCHOR_X = 332
HUD_ANCHOR_BOTTOM = 16
SIZE_LABELS = ("SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE")
# body font per text size: (pixfont name, multiple of the pixel unit)
_BODY_FONTS = (("R5", 2), ("R7", 2), ("R7", 3))
PORTRAIT_PX = 24           # portrait source size (spr_portraits frames)

BODY_RGB = (226, 238, 214)     # phosphor white on the display glass
HIST_RGB = (196, 204, 192)
CASE = (50, 54, 46)            # olive gunmetal
CASE_HI = (82, 88, 72)
CASE_LO = (28, 30, 26)
CASE_INK = (12, 13, 11)
GLASS = (10, 15, 12)
GLASS_HI = (24, 32, 26)
AMBER = (255, 178, 64)
AMBER_BG = (44, 26, 8)
LED_OFF = (36, 42, 36)
LED_GREEN = (110, 236, 120)
LED_RED = (240, 64, 52)

PREFS = {
    "radio_text_size": 1,
    "radio_speaker_names": True,
    "subtitles": True,
}

# speaker (upper, base name) -> spr_portraits frame key
PORTRAIT_KEYS = {
    "BIRIBEL": "biribel", "VASILE": "vasile", "CAPTAIN VASILE": "vasile",
    "VOLKOV": "volkov", "COMMANDER": "commander", "FISHERMAN": "fisherman",
    "OLD FISHERMAN": "fisherman", "BALACEANU": "balaceanu",
    "PRESIDENT RETARDOVICI": "president", "RETARDOVICI": "president",
    "PRESIDENTIAL PA": "president", "PA": "president", "MARU": "maru",
    "COMMAND": "krap_command", "KRAP COMMAND": "krap_command", "KRAP CMD": "krap_command",
    "KRAP": "krap_command", "IPA DISPATCH": "ipa_dispatch", "IPA": "ipa_dispatch",
    "OLD SQUADMATE": "old_squadmate", "GABI": "gabi", "SEBY": "seby", "DARIUS": "darius",
    "OLD WOMAN": "old_woman", "HUNGRY KID": "hungry_kid", "NARRATOR": "narrator",
    "PA SYSTEM": "pa_system", "INTERCEPT": "intercept", "RADIO": "radio",
    "RADIO VOICE": "radio", "SYSTEM": "system", "LOYALIST COMMS": "loyalist_comms",
}


def apply_settings(values):
    """Copy the radio prefs out of a settings dict (settings_store profile)."""
    for k in PREFS:
        if k in values:
            PREFS[k] = values[k]
    if PREFS["radio_text_size"] not in (0, 1, 2):
        PREFS["radio_text_size"] = 1


def unit_for(surface_or_scale):
    """Pixel-art unit in screen px: 2 at the 1000x700 logical size."""
    if isinstance(surface_or_scale, (int, float)):
        scale = surface_or_scale
    else:
        sw, sh = surface_or_scale.get_size()
        scale = max(0.75, min(sw / WIDTH, sh / HEIGHT))
    return max(1, int(round(2 * scale)))


def body_font(size=None, u=2):
    """Pixel font used for the transmission body at text size ``size``."""
    if size not in (0, 1, 2):
        size = PREFS.get("radio_text_size", 1)
        size = size if size in (0, 1, 2) else 1
    name, mult = _BODY_FONTS[size]
    return pixfont.font(name, max(1, int(round(mult * u / 2.0))))


def _label_font(u):
    return pixfont.font("R5", u)


def _base(speaker):
    s = (speaker or "").upper().strip()
    cut = s.find("(")
    return s[:cut].strip() if cut > 0 else s


def accent_for(speaker, fallback=(150, 170, 190)):
    s = (speaker or "").upper().strip()
    for key in (s, _base(s), s.split(" ")[0] if s else ""):
        if key and key in SPEAKER_COLORS:
            return SPEAKER_COLORS[key]
    return tuple(fallback[:3]) if fallback else (150, 170, 190)


def portrait_key(speaker):
    s = (speaker or "").upper().strip()
    for key in (s, _base(s), s.split(" ")[0] if s else ""):
        if key in PORTRAIT_KEYS:
            return PORTRAIT_KEYS[key]
    if "INTERCEPT" in s:
        return "intercept"
    return "unknown"


def _channel_label():
    try:
        from core.mission_meta import radio_channel
        from core.state import STATE
        return radio_channel(STATE)
    except Exception:
        return "OPEN CHANNEL"


def _split_channel(label):
    """"KRAP CMD // 141.20" -> ("KRAP CMD", "141.20")."""
    label = (label or "").strip()
    if "//" in label:
        net, freq = label.split("//", 1)
        return net.strip(), freq.strip()
    return label, ""


def _wrap(text, font, width):
    rows = []
    for para in (text or "").replace(" / ", "\n").split("\n"):
        words, cur = para.split(" "), ""
        for w in words:
            t = (cur + " " + w) if cur else w
            if font.size(t)[0] > width and cur:
                rows.append(cur)
                cur = w
            else:
                cur = t
        if cur:
            rows.append(cur)
    return rows or [""]


def _mix(a, b, t):
    return tuple(int(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


# -- portraits ------------------------------------------------------------
_portraits = {}
_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def _portrait_source(speaker, accent):
    """24x24 source portrait: hand-made PNG override > generated sheet > fallback."""
    name = _base(speaker).lower().replace(" ", "_")
    path = os.path.join(_ROOT, "assets", "sprites", "portraits", name + ".png")
    if name and os.path.exists(path):
        try:
            img = pygame.image.load(path)
            if pygame.display.get_surface() is not None:
                img = img.convert_alpha()
            return img
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        from core import artpack
        img = artpack.frame("spr_portraits", portrait_key(speaker))
        if img is None and portrait_key(speaker) != "unknown":
            img = artpack.frame("spr_portraits", "unknown")
        if img is not None:
            return img
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _fallback_portrait(accent):
    """Procedural caller in the same 24 px grid: shadowed head + headset."""
    s = pygame.Surface((PORTRAIT_PX, PORTRAIT_PX), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    body = _mix(accent, (40, 44, 48), 0.6)
    lit = _mix(accent, (90, 96, 100), 0.5)
    for y, (x0, x1) in {18: (6, 17), 19: (4, 19)}.items():
        s.fill(body, (x0, y, x1 - x0 + 1, 1))
    s.fill(body, (2, 20, 20, 4))
    s.fill(body, (10, 15, 4, 4))
    s.fill(lit, (7, 5, 10, 10))
    s.fill(lit, (8, 4, 8, 12))
    s.fill(lit, (9, 15, 6, 1))
    s.fill((40, 42, 46), (9, 10, 2, 1))
    s.fill((40, 42, 46), (13, 10, 2, 1))
    s.fill((58, 62, 66), (7, 2, 10, 1))
    s.fill((58, 62, 66), (4, 8, 3, 4))
    return s


def _portrait(speaker, size, accent):
    """Portrait at an integer multiple of the 24 px source (nearest only)."""
    key = (_base(speaker), size, tuple(accent))
    hit = _portraits.get(key)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    src = _portrait_source(speaker, accent)
    cache = src is not None or os.environ.get("ACA_ART", "") in ("legacy", "off")
    if src is None:      # sheet missing / no display yet: don't pin the fallback
        src = _fallback_portrait(accent)
    w, h = src.get_size()
    k = max(1, size // max(1, w))
    surf = pygame.transform.scale(src, (w * k, h * k)) if k != 1 else src.copy()
    if surf.get_size() != (size, size):
        out = pygame.Surface((size, size), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        out.blit(surf, ((size - surf.get_width()) // 2, size - surf.get_height()))
        surf = out
    if cache:
        _portraits[key] = surf
    return surf


def _ease_out(x):
    x = max(0.0, min(1.0, x))
    return 1.0 - (1.0 - x) ** 3


def _vo_busy():
    try:
        from audio import voice
        return voice.busy()
    except Exception:
        return False


def _sfx(name, volume):
    try:
        from core.config import audio
        audio.play(name, volume=volume)
    except Exception:
        pass


# -- static chassis (cached per size / accent) ------------------------------
_chassis = {}


def _screw(s, x, y, u):
    s.fill((112, 114, 104), (x, y, 2 * u, 2 * u))
    s.fill((150, 152, 140), (x, y, u, u))
    s.fill((40, 42, 38), (x + u, y + u, u, u))
    s.fill((60, 62, 56), (x, y + u, 2 * u, max(1, u // 2)))


def _bevel_box(s, rect, fill, hi, lo, u, inset=False):
    r = pygame.Rect(rect)
    s.fill(fill, r)
    a, b = (lo, hi) if inset else (hi, lo)
    s.fill(a, (r.x, r.y, r.w, u))
    s.fill(a, (r.x, r.y, u, r.h))
    s.fill(b, (r.x, r.bottom - u, r.w, u))
    s.fill(b, (r.right - u, r.y, u, r.h))


def _build_chassis(w, h, u, layout):
    s = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    # case: ink outline, olive gunmetal body, lit top-left / dark bottom-right
    s.fill((*CASE_INK, 255), (u, 0, w - 2 * u, h))
    s.fill((*CASE_INK, 255), (0, u, w, h - 2 * u))
    body = pygame.Rect(u, u, w - 2 * u, h - 2 * u)
    _bevel_box(s, body, CASE, CASE_HI, CASE_LO, u)
    # subtle brushed texture: a darker line every 3 units
    for y in range(body.y + 3 * u, body.bottom - 2 * u, 3 * u):
        s.fill(_mix(CASE, CASE_LO, 0.25), (body.x + u, y, body.w - 2 * u, max(1, u // 2)))
    for x, y in ((2 * u, 2 * u), (w - 4 * u, 2 * u), (2 * u, h - 4 * u), (w - 4 * u, h - 4 * u)):
        _screw(s, x, y, u)
    # caller-ID screen bezel
    scr = layout["screen"]
    _bevel_box(s, scr.inflate(2 * u, 2 * u), (8, 10, 9), CASE_LO, CASE_HI, u, inset=False)
    # speaker grille under the screen (when the set is tall enough)
    g = layout.get("grille")
    if g is not None:
        _bevel_box(s, g, _mix(CASE, CASE_LO, 0.4), CASE_LO, CASE_HI, u, inset=True)
        for yy in range(g.y + 2 * u, g.bottom - 2 * u + 1, 2 * u):
            for xx in range(g.x + 2 * u + ((yy - g.y) // (2 * u)) % 2 * u, g.right - 2 * u, 2 * u):
                s.fill(CASE_INK, (xx, yy, u, u))
    # recessed display glass
    win = layout["window"]
    _bevel_box(s, win.inflate(2 * u, 2 * u), GLASS, CASE_LO, CASE_HI, u, inset=False)
    s.fill(GLASS, win)
    s.fill(GLASS_HI, (win.x, win.y, win.w, u))
    for y in range(win.y + u, win.bottom, 2 * u):
        s.fill((14, 20, 16), (win.x, y, win.w, max(1, u // 2)))
    return s


def _screen_overlay(chip, u):
    """Scanlines + glass glint over the caller-ID screen (cached)."""
    key = ("scr", chip, u)
    hit = _chassis.get(key)
    if hit is None:
        hit = pygame.Surface((chip, chip), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for y in range(u, chip, 2 * u):
            hit.fill((0, 0, 0, 46), (0, y, chip, max(1, u // 2)))
        hit.fill((255, 255, 255, 60), (u, u, u, 3 * u))
        hit.fill((255, 255, 255, 34), (2 * u, u, 2 * u, u))
        _chassis[key] = hit
    return hit


def _chassis_for(w, h, u, layout):
    key = (w, h, u, layout["screen"].topleft, layout.get("grille") is not None)
    hit = _chassis.get(key)
    if hit is None:
        if len(_chassis) > 32:
            _chassis.clear()
        hit = _chassis[key] = _build_chassis(w, h, u, layout)
    return hit


class RadioTransmission:
    """Stateful widget; one shared instance (``TRANSMISSION``)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.cur = None          # dict copied from interactions.live_line()
        self.cur_key = None
        self.out_at = None       # radio-clock ms when the fade-out started
        self.history = []        # finished lines: dicts with 'done_at'
        self.log = []            # last 10 (speaker, body, color) for other UIs
        self.last_clock = 0

    # -- state ------------------------------------------------------------
    def reset(self):
        self.cur = None
        self.cur_key = None
        self.out_at = None
        self.history.clear()

    def _sync(self, live, allowed, clock):
        if not allowed:
            if self.cur is not None or self.history:
                self.reset()     # hard cut; the director already squelched
            return
        key = None if live is None else (live["start"], live["text"])
        if key != self.cur_key:
            if self.cur is not None:
                old = dict(self.cur)
                old["done_at"] = clock
                self.history.append(old)
                self.history = self.history[-2:]
            if live is not None:
                self.cur = dict(live)
                self.out_at = None
                self.log.append((live["speaker"], live["body"], live["color"]))
                self.log = self.log[-10:]
                if not live.get("vo_ms"):   # voiced clips carry their own squelch
                    _sfx("squelch_head", 0.22)
            else:
                self.cur = None
            self.cur_key = key
        if self.cur is not None and self.out_at is None and clock >= self.cur["end"]:
            self.out_at = clock
            if not self.cur.get("vo_ms"):
                _sfx("squelch_tail", 0.2)
        if self.cur is not None and self.out_at is not None and clock - self.out_at > OUT_MS:
            old = dict(self.cur)
            old["done_at"] = clock
            self.history.append(old)
            self.history = self.history[-2:]
            self.cur = None
        self.history = [h for h in self.history if clock - h["done_at"] < HISTORY_MS]

    # -- layout -----------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def metrics(surface):
        """Geometry shared by draw() and the smoke test."""
        sw, sh = surface.get_size()
        scale = max(0.75, min(sw / WIDTH, sh / HEIGHT))
        u = unit_for(scale)
        f_body = body_font(PREFS.get("radio_text_size", 1), u)
        f_lab = _label_font(u)
        chip = PORTRAIT_PX * u
        pad = 4 * u
        panel_w = int(min(sw * 0.49, 490 * scale))
        win_x = pad + u + chip + u + 4 * u + u
        win_w = panel_w - win_x - pad - u
        text_w = win_w - 6 * u
        plate_h = (f_lab.cap + 2) * u
        head_h = plate_h + 2 * u
        return {"scale": scale, "u": u, "f_body": f_body, "f_lab": f_lab, "chip": chip,
                "pad": pad, "panel_w": panel_w, "win_x": win_x, "win_w": win_w,
                "text_w": text_w, "plate_h": plate_h, "head_h": head_h,
                "row_h": f_body.get_linesize()}

    @staticmethod
    def panel_height(m, n_rows):
        u = m["u"]
        win_h = 2 * u + m["head_h"] + n_rows * m["row_h"]
        return max(m["chip"] + 2 * u + 2 * m["pad"], win_h + 2 * u + 2 * m["pad"])

    # -- drawing ----------------------------------------------------------
    def draw(self, surface, live=None, allowed=True, clock=None, queued=0,
             channel=None, anchor="hud", bar_h=0, force_text=False):
        if clock is None:
            clock = self.last_clock
        self.last_clock = clock
        self._sync(live, allowed, clock)
        if self.cur is None and not self.history:
            return None
        sw, sh = surface.get_size()
        m = self.metrics(surface)
        scale = m["scale"]
        if anchor == "letterbox":
            x0 = (sw - m["panel_w"]) // 2
            one = self.panel_height(m, 1)
            bottom = sh - max(4, (bar_h - one) // 2)
        else:
            x0 = int(HUD_ANCHOR_X * scale)
            bottom = sh - int(HUD_ANCHOR_BOTTOM * scale)
        drawn = None
        # history rows (compact, one line each) stacked above the live panel
        stack_y = bottom
        if self.cur is not None:
            rect = self._draw_live(surface, self.cur, clock, x0, bottom, m, queued,
                                   channel, force_text)
            drawn = rect
            stack_y = rect.top - int(4 * scale)
        # letterbox: one line only, history would stack into the picture
        for h in (() if anchor == "letterbox" else reversed(self.history)):
            age = clock - h["done_at"]
            a = int(150 * max(0.0, 1.0 - age / HISTORY_MS))
            if a <= 6:
                continue
            stack_y = self._draw_history(surface, h, x0, stack_y, m, a)
        return drawn

    def _draw_history(self, surface, h, x0, bottom, m, alpha):
        u, font, panel_w = m["u"], m["f_lab"], m["panel_w"]
        acc = accent_for(h["speaker"], h["color"])
        name = _base(h["speaker"]) if PREFS.get("radio_speaker_names", True) else ""
        body = (h["body"] or "").replace("\n", " ")
        name_w = font.size(name)[0] + 3 * u if name else 0
        room = panel_w - 8 * u - name_w
        while font.size(body)[0] > room and len(body) > 4:
            body = body[:-5] + "\u2026"
        hgt = (font.rows + 2) * u
        s = pygame.Surface((panel_w, hgt), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        s.fill((14, 16, 13, int(alpha * 0.85)))
        s.fill((*CASE_LO, alpha), (0, hgt - u, panel_w, u))
        s.fill((*acc, alpha), (0, 0, u, hgt))
        x = 3 * u
        if name:
            t = font.render(name, False, acc)
            t.set_alpha(alpha)
            s.blit(t, (x, u))
            x += name_w
        t = font.render(body, False, HIST_RGB)
        t.set_alpha(alpha)
        s.blit(t, (x, u))
        surface.blit(s, (x0, bottom - hgt))
        return bottom - hgt - u

    def _draw_live(self, surface, cur, clock, x0, bottom, m, queued, channel, force_text):
        u, chip, pad = m["u"], m["chip"], m["pad"]
        f_body, f_lab = m["f_body"], m["f_lab"]
        panel_w, row_h = m["panel_w"], m["row_h"]
        acc = accent_for(cur["speaker"], cur["color"])
        age = clock - cur["start"]
        a_in = _ease_out(age / IN_MS)
        a_out = 1.0
        slide = (1.0 - a_in) * -26
        if self.out_at is not None:
            k = min(1.0, (clock - self.out_at) / OUT_MS)
            a_out = 1.0 - k
            slide += -10 * k
        alpha = max(0.0, min(1.0, a_in * a_out))
        show_text = force_text or PREFS.get("subtitles", True) or not cur.get("vo_ms")
        body = cur["body"] or ""
        rows = _wrap(body, f_body, m["text_w"]) if show_text else []
        # typewriter, paced to the clip when there is one
        vo = cur.get("vo_ms") or 0
        type_ms = vo * 0.92 if vo else max(1, len(body)) * TYPE_MS_PER_CHAR
        n_vis = len(body) if type_ms <= 0 else int(len(body) * min(1.0, age / type_ms))
        vis_rows, left = [], n_vis
        for r in rows:
            if left <= 0:
                break
            vis_rows.append(r[:left])
            left -= len(r) + 1
        scrolled = max(0, len(vis_rows) - MAX_ROWS)
        vis_rows = vis_rows[scrolled:]
        n_rows = max(1, min(MAX_ROWS, len(rows))) if show_text else 0
        panel_h = self.panel_height(m, n_rows)

        # layout (panel-local px)
        screen = pygame.Rect(pad + u, pad + u, chip, chip)
        grille = None
        g_top = screen.bottom + 3 * u
        if panel_h - pad - g_top >= 7 * u:
            grille = pygame.Rect(screen.x - u, g_top, chip + 2 * u, panel_h - pad - g_top)
        win = pygame.Rect(m["win_x"], pad + u, m["win_w"], panel_h - 2 * pad - 2 * u)
        layout = {"screen": screen, "window": win, "grille": grille}
        s = _chassis_for(panel_w, panel_h, u, layout).copy()

        crit = (cur.get("priority") or 0) >= 1
        busy = _vo_busy() and vo > 0 and self.out_at is None
        tuning = age < STATIC_MS
        # critical: the case edge flashes in the accent, once
        if crit and age < PULSE_MS:
            p = math.sin(math.pi * age / PULSE_MS)
            ring = pygame.Surface((panel_w, panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            pygame.draw.rect(ring, (*acc, int(90 + 160 * p)), ring.get_rect(), max(u, int(u * (1 + 2 * p))))
            s.blit(ring, (0, 0))

        # caller-ID screen: accent-tinted CRT, portrait, scanlines, glass glint
        s.fill(_mix(acc, (6, 8, 8), 0.82), screen)
        if not tuning or age > STATIC_MS * 0.55:
            s.blit(_portrait(cur["speaker"], chip, acc), screen.topleft)
        s.blit(_screen_overlay(chip, u), screen.topleft)

        # header inside the glass: callsign plate, LED ladder, RX lamp,
        # amber frequency readout with queue LEDs
        hx, hy = win.x + 3 * u, win.y + 2 * u
        plate_h = m["plate_h"]
        if PREFS.get("radio_speaker_names", True) and cur["speaker"]:
            name = _base(cur["speaker"])
            nw = f_lab.size(name)[0]
            plate = pygame.Rect(hx, hy, nw + 4 * u, plate_h)
            s.fill(acc, plate)
            s.fill(_mix(acc, (255, 255, 255), 0.35), (plate.x, plate.y, plate.w, u))
            s.fill(_mix(acc, (0, 0, 0), 0.35), (plate.x, plate.bottom - u, plate.w, u))
            f_lab.draw(s, name, (plate.x + 2 * u, plate.y + u), (14, 14, 16))
            hx = plate.right + 3 * u
        seg_rows = max(3, (plate_h // u - 1) // 2)
        for i in range(6):
            if busy:
                lv = 0.25 + 0.75 * abs(math.sin(clock * (0.011 + i * 0.0037) + i * 1.7)
                                      * math.sin(clock * 0.0047 + i))
            else:
                lv = 0.0
            lit = int(round(lv * seg_rows))
            for j in range(seg_rows):
                on = j < lit
                col = (LED_RED if j == seg_rows - 1 else acc) if on else LED_OFF
                s.fill(col, (hx + i * 2 * u, hy + plate_h - (j + 1) * 2 * u + u, u, u))
        hx += 12 * u + u
        # RX lamp: green while receiving, red blink for critical traffic
        on_air = self.out_at is None
        lamp = LED_OFF
        if on_air:
            lamp = LED_RED if (crit and (clock // 180) % 2 == 0) else LED_GREEN
        rx = f_lab.render("RX", False, (120, 130, 118))
        ly = hy + (plate_h - rx.get_height()) // 2 + u
        s.blit(rx, (hx, ly))
        s.fill(lamp, (hx + rx.get_width() + u, hy + plate_h // 2 - u, 2 * u, 2 * u))
        if on_air:
            s.fill(_mix(lamp, (255, 255, 255), 0.5), (hx + rx.get_width() + u, hy + plate_h // 2 - u, u, u))
        hx += rx.get_width() + 4 * u
        net, freq = _split_channel(channel or _channel_label())
        qn = min(3, queued)
        right = win.right - 3 * u
        for i in range(qn):
            s.fill(AMBER, (right - 2 * u - i * 3 * u, hy + plate_h // 2 - u, 2 * u, 2 * u))
        if qn:
            right -= qn * 3 * u + 2 * u
        if freq:
            ft = f_lab.render(freq, False, AMBER)
            box = pygame.Rect(right - ft.get_width() - 4 * u, hy, ft.get_width() + 4 * u, plate_h)
            if box.x > hx:
                s.fill(AMBER_BG, box)
                s.fill(_mix(AMBER_BG, (0, 0, 0), 0.5), (box.x, box.y, box.w, u))
                s.blit(ft, (box.x + 2 * u, box.y + u))
                right = box.x - 2 * u
        if net:
            nt = f_lab.render(net, False, (118, 128, 118))
            if right - nt.get_width() > hx:
                s.blit(nt, (right - nt.get_width(), hy + u))

        # body rows: phosphor text with a 1-unit drop shadow; first row fades
        tx, by = win.x + 3 * u, hy + m["head_h"]
        for i, r in enumerate(vis_rows):
            ra = 120 if (scrolled and i == 0) else 255
            t = f_body.render(r, False, BODY_RGB)
            sh_ = f_body.render(r, False, (0, 0, 0))
            if ra != 255:
                t = t.copy()
                t.set_alpha(ra)
                sh_ = sh_.copy()
                sh_.set_alpha(ra)
            s.blit(sh_, (tx + u // 2 or 1, by + i * row_h + (u // 2 or 1)))
            s.blit(t, (tx, by + i * row_h))
        if show_text and n_vis < len(body) and (clock // 220) % 2 == 0 and vis_rows:
            last = vis_rows[-1]
            cxp = tx + f_body.size(last)[0] + f_body.scale
            s.fill(acc, (cxp, by + (len(vis_rows) - 1) * row_h,
                         f_body.scale * 3, f_body.get_ascent()))

        # scan band drifting down the glass
        band_h = 4 * u
        band_y = win.y + int((clock * 0.05) % (win.h + band_h * 2)) - band_h
        bt, bb = max(win.y, band_y), min(win.bottom, band_y + band_h)
        if bb > bt:
            band = pygame.Surface((win.w, bb - bt), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            band.fill((180, 255, 200, 10))
            s.blit(band, (win.x, bt))

        # static burst while the set tunes in (screen + glass)
        if tuning:
            k = 1.0 - age / STATIC_MS
            rng = random.Random(int(clock // 40) * 7919 + len(body))
            noise = pygame.Surface((panel_w, panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            for area, dens in ((screen, 0.55), (win, 0.22)):
                n = int(area.w * area.h / (u * u) * dens * k)
                for _ in range(n):
                    nx = area.x + rng.randrange(0, max(1, area.w // u)) * u
                    ny = area.y + rng.randrange(0, max(1, area.h // u)) * u
                    v = rng.randrange(60, 230)
                    noise.fill((v, v, v, int(200 * k)), (nx, ny, u, u))
            s.blit(noise, (0, 0))

        s.set_alpha(int(255 * alpha))
        surface.blit(s, (x0 + int(slide), bottom - panel_h))
        return pygame.Rect(x0, bottom - panel_h, panel_w, panel_h)


TRANSMISSION = RadioTransmission()


def draw_radio(surface, anchor="hud", bar_h=0, force_text=False):
    """Per-frame entry point for mission HUDs (via ui.hud.draw_pinned_radio)."""
    try:
        from core import interactions as I
    except Exception:
        return None
    return TRANSMISSION.draw(surface, live=I.live_line(), allowed=I.radio_allowed(),
                             clock=I.radio_clock(), queued=I.queue_depth(),
                             anchor=anchor, bar_h=bar_h, force_text=force_text)


def recent_lines(n=10):
    """Last transmissions as (speaker, body, color), oldest first."""
    return list(TRANSMISSION.log[-n:])

# CRT terminal drawing helpers

def _draw_arrow_btn(rect, sym):

    """Arrow button with CRT phosphor glow on hover."""

    hover = rect.collidepoint(get_scaled_mouse())

    bg = (55, 61, 40) if hover else (23, 29, 22)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, bg, rect)

    border_col = (231, 181, 94) if hover else (79, 89, 69)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, border_col, rect, 1)

    c = font_btn.render(sym, True, (231, 181, 94) if hover else (185, 192, 167))

    screen.blit(c, (rect.centerx - c.get_width() // 2, rect.centery - c.get_height() // 2))





def _draw_volume_slider(label, bar_rect, left_rect, right_rect, value, row_y):

    """Volume/brightness slider with CRT phosphor fill."""

    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (215, 220, 199)), (LABEL_X, row_y + 3))

    _draw_arrow_btn(left_rect, "<")

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (12, 17, 13), bar_rect)

    value = max(0, min(100, int(value)))
    fill_w = int(bar_rect.width * value / 100)

    if fill_w > 0:

        screen.blit(_VOL_GRADIENT, bar_rect.topleft, (0, 0, fill_w, bar_rect.height))

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (79, 89, 69), bar_rect, 1)
    thumb_x = bar_rect.x + int((bar_rect.width - 4) * value / 100)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (237, 213, 158), (thumb_x, bar_rect.y - 3, 4, bar_rect.height + 6))

    _draw_arrow_btn(right_rect, ">")

    pct = font_terminal.render(f"{value:>3}%", True, (231, 181, 94))

    screen.blit(pct, (right_rect.right + 12, row_y))





def _draw_toggle(label, rect, value, row_y):

    """CRT toggle switch - green when ON, dim when OFF."""

    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (215, 220, 199)), (LABEL_X, row_y + 3))

    hover = rect.collidepoint(get_scaled_mouse())

    on_col = (93, 110, 62) if value else (23, 29, 22)

    border_col = (231, 181, 94) if (hover or value) else (79, 89, 69)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, on_col, rect)

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, border_col, rect, 1)

    # Knob

    knob_x = rect.right - 22 if value else rect.x + 4

    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (230, 220, 177) if value else (135, 145, 124),

                     (knob_x, rect.y + 4, 18, rect.height - 8))

    state_label = "ON" if value else "OFF"

    s = font_terminal_small.render(state_label, True, (231, 181, 94) if value else (175, 182, 160))

    screen.blit(s, (rect.right + 12, row_y + 3))





def _draw_stepper(label, left_rect, right_rect, value_str, row_y):

    """Stepper control: < VALUE >  for enumerated settings (resolution, mode, etc.)."""

    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (215, 220, 199)), (LABEL_X, row_y + 3))

    _draw_arrow_btn(left_rect, "<")

    val_surf = font_terminal.render(value_str, True, (231, 181, 94))

    val_cx = (left_rect.right + right_rect.left) // 2

    screen.blit(val_surf, (val_cx - val_surf.get_width() // 2, row_y))

    _draw_arrow_btn(right_rect, ">")





def _draw_section_header(text, y):

    """Small green section divider with a label - groups related settings."""

    header = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, (231, 181, 94))

    screen.blit(header, (LABEL_X, y))

    line_y = y + header.get_height() + 2

    pygame.draw.line(screen, (67, 78, 60), (LABEL_X, line_y),

                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 48, line_y), 1)





def _draw_hint(text, y):

    """Dim helper text under a setting."""

    hint = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, (157, 170, 143))

    screen.blit(hint, (LABEL_X, y))





def draw_settings(active_tab, display_mode, res_idx,

                  master_volume, music_volume, sfx_volume, mute_on_focus_loss,

                  crosshair, crosshair_size, auto_reload, aim_assist, subtitles,

                  brightness, scanlines, grain, particle_density,

                  mouse_sensitivity, invert_mouse,

                  reduced_motion, colorblind_mode, save_status="CONFIG SYNCED", save_failed=False):

    """Render the local tactical configuration console without changing other menus."""
    global screen
    # Display switches rebind config.screen; do not retain a stale import snapshot.
    from core import config as _config
    screen = _config.screen

    screen.blit(_settings_overlay, (0, 0))

    screen.blit(_settings_panel, (SETTINGS_PANEL_X, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y))



    # Field-console hierarchy: equipment label, title, restrained serial mark.
    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render("ACARISTAN / FIELD EQUIPMENT", True, (157, 170, 143)),
                (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + 32, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 14))
    screen.blit(font_speaker.render("SYSTEM CONFIGURATION", True, (230, 220, 177)),
                (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + 32, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 36))
    serial = font_terminal_small.render("LOCAL PROFILE / 01", True, (231, 181, 94))
    screen.blit(serial, (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - serial.get_width() - 32,
                         SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 20))
    pygame.draw.line(screen, (115, 129, 91),
                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + 32, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 66),
                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 32, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + 66))
    # Inner content plate and hardware corner marks.
    plate = pygame.Rect(SETTINGS_PANEL_X + 24, CONTENT_Y - 6,
                        SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 48, 426)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (12, 17, 13), plate)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (49, 61, 43), plate, 1)
    for x, y, dx, dy in [(SETTINGS_PANEL_X, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y, 1, 1),
                         (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 1, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y, -1, 1),
                         (SETTINGS_PANEL_X, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + SETTINGS_PANEL_H - 1, 1, -1),
                         (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 1, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + SETTINGS_PANEL_H - 1, -1, -1)]:
        pygame.draw.line(screen, (231, 181, 94), (x, y), (x + dx * 15, y), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(screen, (231, 181, 94), (x, y), (x, y + dy * 15), 2)

    # ── Tab bar ──

    mouse = get_scaled_mouse()

    for i, (rect, label) in enumerate(zip(settings_tab_rects, SETTINGS_TABS)):

        is_active = (i == active_tab)

        hover = rect.collidepoint(mouse)

        bg = (50, 55, 36) if is_active else ((30, 37, 26) if hover else (12, 17, 13))

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, bg, rect)

        if is_active:

            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (231, 181, 94), (rect.x, rect.bottom - 3, rect.width, 3))

        else:

            pygame.draw.line(screen, (67, 78, 60), (rect.x, rect.bottom), (rect.right, rect.bottom), 1)

        col = (231, 181, 94) if is_active else ((212, 215, 190) if hover else (162, 174, 144))

        ts = font_terminal_small.render(f"{i + 1:02} {label}", True, col)

        screen.blit(ts, (rect.centerx - ts.get_width() // 2, rect.centery - ts.get_height() // 2))



    # ── Tab content ──

    if active_tab == 0:

        # DISPLAY

        _draw_section_header("MONITOR", CONTENT_Y)

        screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render("Logical Canvas", True, (215, 220, 199)), (LABEL_X, ROW_RES_Y + 3))
        screen.blit(font_terminal.render("1000 x 700", True, (185, 192, 167)), (CONTROL_X, ROW_RES_Y))
        _draw_hint("Fixed render canvas; the window scales without changing gameplay.", ROW_RES_Y + 30)
        _draw_stepper("Display Mode", settings_display_left_rect, settings_display_right_rect,
                      DISPLAY_MODES[max(0, min(display_mode, len(DISPLAY_MODES) - 1))], ROW_DISPLAY_Y)
        _draw_hint("Fullscreen uses your desktop. Windowed mode is freely resizable.", ROW_DISPLAY_Y + 36)
        _draw_section_header("DISPLAY PROCEDURE", ROW_DISPLAY_Y + 94)
        _draw_hint("F11 switches modes. Image effects are in 04 IMAGE.", ROW_DISPLAY_Y + 126)
        _draw_hint("Changes preview immediately; APPLY writes the local profile.", ROW_DISPLAY_Y + 150)



    elif active_tab == 1:

        # AUDIO

        _draw_section_header("LEVELS", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("Master Volume", settings_master_bar_rect,

                            settings_master_left_rect, settings_master_right_rect,

                            master_volume, ROW_MASTER_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("Music Volume", settings_music_bar_rect,

                            settings_music_left_rect, settings_music_right_rect,

                            music_volume, ROW_MUSIC_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("SFX Volume", settings_sfx_bar_rect,

                            settings_sfx_left_rect, settings_sfx_right_rect,

                            sfx_volume, ROW_SFX_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Mute on Focus Loss", settings_mute_rect,

                     mute_on_focus_loss, ROW_MUTE_Y)

        _draw_hint("Silences all audio when the window loses focus.", ROW_MUTE_Y + 36)



    elif active_tab == 2:

        # GAMEPLAY

        _draw_section_header("COMBAT", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Crosshair", settings_crosshair_rect, crosshair, ROW_CROSSHAIR_Y)


        _draw_stepper("Crosshair Size", settings_crosshair_size_left, settings_crosshair_size_right,

                      CROSSHAIR_SIZE_LABELS[CROSSHAIR_SIZES.index(crosshair_size)] if crosshair_size in CROSSHAIR_SIZES else "MEDIUM",

                      ROW_CROSSHAIR_SIZE_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Auto-Reload", settings_auto_reload_rect, auto_reload, ROW_AUTO_RELOAD_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Aim Assist", settings_aim_assist_rect, aim_assist, ROW_AIM_ASSIST_Y)

        _draw_hint("Subtly pulls the aim toward nearby enemies.", ROW_AIM_ASSIST_Y + 30)

        _draw_section_header("PRESENTATION", ROW_SUBTITLES_Y - 30)

        _draw_toggle("Subtitles", settings_subtitles_rect, subtitles, ROW_SUBTITLES_Y)

        _draw_hint("Shows spoken dialogue as on-screen text.", ROW_SUBTITLES_Y + 36)



    elif active_tab == 3:

        # GRAPHICS

        _draw_section_header("IMAGE", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_volume_slider("Brightness", settings_brightness_bar,

                            settings_brightness_left, settings_brightness_right,

                            brightness, ROW_BRIGHTNESS_Y)

        _draw_hint("Adjusts the overall image brightness. 50 = default.", ROW_BRIGHTNESS_Y + 36)

        _draw_section_header("POST-PROCESSING", ROW_SCANLINES_Y - 30)

        _draw_toggle("Scanlines", settings_scanlines_rect, scanlines, ROW_SCANLINES_Y)

        _draw_hint("CRT horizontal scanline overlay.", ROW_SCANLINES_Y + 36)

        _draw_toggle("Film Grain", settings_grain_rect, grain, ROW_GRAIN_Y)

        _draw_hint("Animated grain texture over the screen.", ROW_GRAIN_Y + 36)

        _draw_volume_slider("Particle Density", settings_particles_bar,

                            settings_particles_left, settings_particles_right,

                            particle_density, ROW_PARTICLES_Y)

        _draw_hint("Scales the number of particles (explosions, smoke, blood).", ROW_PARTICLES_Y + 36)



    elif active_tab == 4:

        # CONTROLS: real binding reference, not non-functional input sliders.
        _draw_section_header("INPUT / CURSOR AIM", CONTENT_Y)
        _draw_hint("Aim follows your mouse pointer directly; no look sensitivity or inversion.", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y)
        _draw_hint("Bindings are fixed in this build. Key remapping is not available.", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 24)
        _draw_section_header("OPERATOR REFERENCE", ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 66)
        bindings = [("W A S D", "MOVE"), ("LMB", "FIRE"), ("R", "RELOAD"),
                    ("G", "MOLOTOV"), ("E", "INTERACT"), ("Q", "SWAP WEAPON"),
                    ("V", "MELEE"), ("ESC", "PAUSE")]
        for i, (key, action) in enumerate(bindings):
            col, row = i // 4, i % 4
            x = LABEL_X + col * 376
            y = ROW_MOUSE_SENS_Y + 103 + row * 43
            badge = pygame.Rect(x, y, 94, 31)
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (28, 35, 25), badge)
            pygame.draw.rect(screen, (79, 89, 69), badge, 1)
            text = font_terminal_small.render(key, True, (231, 181, 94))
            screen.blit(text, (badge.centerx - text.get_width() // 2, badge.centery - text.get_height() // 2))
            screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(action, True, (215, 220, 199)), (x + 110, y + 8))



    else:

        # ACCESSIBILITY

        _draw_section_header("MOTION", CONTENT_Y)

        _draw_toggle("Reduced Motion", settings_reduced_motion_rect,

                     reduced_motion, ROW_REDUCED_MOTION_Y)

        _draw_hint("Disables screen shake and bright full-screen flashes.", ROW_REDUCED_MOTION_Y + 36)

        _draw_stepper("Colorblind Mode", settings_colorblind_left, settings_colorblind_right,

                      ROW_COLORBLIND_Y)

        _draw_hint("Adjusts UI colors for color vision deficiency.", ROW_COLORBLIND_Y + 38)
        _draw_section_header("RADIO", ROW_RADIO_SIZE_Y - 30)
        from ui import radio as _radio_ui
        _draw_stepper("Radio Text Size", settings_radio_size_left, settings_radio_size_right,
                      _radio_ui.SIZE_LABELS[_radio_ui.PREFS.get("radio_text_size", 1)],
                      ROW_RADIO_SIZE_Y)
        _draw_hint("Size of radio transmission text in missions.", ROW_RADIO_SIZE_Y + 38)
        _draw_toggle("Radio Speaker Names", settings_radio_names_rect,
                     _radio_ui.PREFS.get("radio_speaker_names", True), ROW_RADIO_NAMES_Y)
        _draw_hint("Callsign plate on radio transmissions.", ROW_RADIO_NAMES_Y + 36)



    # Texture stays off labels and controls; no flickering/glitch effects here.
    if scanlines and not reduced_motion:
        screen.blit(_CRT_SCANLINES, (SETTINGS_PANEL_X, SETTINGS_PANEL_Y),

    line_y = SETTINGS_PANEL_Y + SETTINGS_PANEL_H - 100
    pygame.draw.line(screen, (67, 78, 60), (LABEL_X, line_y),
                     (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 48, line_y))
    status_col = (240, 142, 115) if save_failed else (231, 181, 94)
    screen.blit(font_terminal_small.render(save_status, True, status_col), (LABEL_X, line_y + 10))
    shortcuts = font_terminal_small.render("TAB / 1-6: SECTIONS   CTRL+S: APPLY   ESC: SAVE & BACK", True, (157, 170, 143))
    screen.blit(shortcuts, (SETTINGS_PANEL_X + SETTINGS_PANEL_W - 48 - shortcuts.get_width(), line_y + 30))

    # Explicit, consistent command bar. Rectangles also work before first draw.
    for button, primary in ((settings_back_btn, False), (settings_apply_btn, True)):
        button.check_hover(mouse)

        pygame.draw.rect(screen, bg, button.rect)
        pygame.draw.rect(screen, (231, 181, 94) if primary or button.is_hovered else (79, 89, 69), button.rect, 1)
        label = font_prompt.render("APPLY / SAVE" if primary else "SAVE & BACK", True,
                                   (231, 181, 94) if primary else (215, 220, 199))
        screen.blit(label, (button.rect.centerx - label.get_width() // 2,
                            button.rect.centery - label.get_height() // 2))

# PAUSE / DEATH

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

# Pause buttons moved down to make room for a proper title + mission status
# block. The original positions (280/340/400) left the pause menu as just a
# flat overlay with "PAUSED" text + 3 naked buttons - visually jarring next
# to the polished main menu and death screen.
#
# Layout (screen Y coordinates):
#   Panel:     y=70 to y=630 (560 tall)
#   Banner:    y=92
#   Title:     y=135 (Impact 80, bottom ~215)
#   Accent:    y=220
#   Op name:   y=235
#   Header:    y=265
#   Divider:   y=283
#   Status:    y=298, 324, 350, 376 (4 rows, bottom ~394)
#   Buttons:   y=410, 460, 510, 560 (4 buttons, 50px apart, bottom ~600)
#   Footer:    y=608
#
# 4 buttons: RESUME, SETTINGS, RESTART MISSION, QUIT TO MENU.
# SETTINGS was added so the user can adjust options mid-mission without
# quitting. The SETTINGS state returns to PAUSED (not MENU) when entered
# from the pause menu - see _settings_return_to in acaristan.py.

pause_buttons = [

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 410, "RESUME"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 460, "SETTINGS"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 510, "RESTART MISSION"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 560, "QUIT TO MENU"),

]

death_buttons = [

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 330, "RESTART MISSION"),

    ModernButton(WIDTH // 2 - 150, 390, "QUIT TO MENU"),

]

# Darker overlay for the pause screen - 200 alpha makes the frozen gameplay
# recede more than the old 180, giving the panel better contrast.
#
# The custom arrow cursor is drawn AFTER this overlay (see acaristan.py's main
# loop). It carries its own drop shadow and black outline, so it stays legible
# over a 200 dim - no need to lighten the overlay for it.
_PAUSE_DIM_ALPHA = 200
_pause_overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

_pause_overlay.fill((0, 0, 0, _PAUSE_DIM_ALPHA))

# Cached panel frame: border + corner ticks + classification banner + title +
# accent bar + footer. These never change during a pause session, so we build
# them once. Dynamic content (operation name, status block, buttons) is drawn
# on top each frame.
_pause_panel_w, _pause_panel_h = 560, 560

_pause_panel_x = (WIDTH - _pause_panel_w) // 2

_pause_panel_y = 70

_pause_panel_frame = pygame.Surface((_pause_panel_w, _pause_panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

# Panel background - slightly lighter than the full-screen overlay so the
# panel reads as a distinct surface.
_pause_panel_frame.fill((8, 10, 14, 210))

# Orange border (2px) + inner dim border (1px) - matches the settings panel
# treatment in draw_settings().
pygame.draw.rect(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, _pause_panel_frame.get_rect(), 2)

pygame.draw.rect(_pause_panel_frame, (90, 50, 20), _pause_panel_frame.get_rect().inflate(-4, -4), 1)

# Corner ticks - matching the main menu _menu_overlay corner accent style.
for cx, cy in [(10, 10), (_pause_panel_w - 10, 10), (10, _pause_panel_h - 10), (_pause_panel_w - 10, _pause_panel_h - 10)]:

    dx = 1 if cx < _pause_panel_w // 2 else -1

    dy = 1 if cy < _pause_panel_h // 2 else -1

    pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (cx, cy), (cx + dx * 16, cy), 2)

    pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (cx, cy), (cx, cy + dy * 16), 2)

# Classification banner at top of panel - matches the main menu's banner.
_banner_y = 22

pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (30, _banner_y), (_pause_panel_w - 30, _banner_y), 1)

pygame.draw.line(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, (30, _banner_y + 24), (_pause_panel_w - 30, _banner_y + 24), 1)

_banner_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 11, bold=True)

_banner_text = _banner_font.render("// KRAPNET TERMINAL - OPERATION SUSPENDED //", True, C_ORANGE)

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_banner_text, ((_pause_panel_w - _banner_text.get_width()) // 2, _banner_y + 5))

# "PAUSED" title - Impact 80 with drop shadow, matching the main menu title.
# Panel-relative Y=65 → screen Y = _pause_panel_y + 65 = 135.
_title_y = 65

_title_shadow = font_title.render("PAUSED", True, (0, 0, 0))

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_title_shadow, ((_pause_panel_w - _title_shadow.get_width()) // 2 + 4, _title_y + 4))

_title_main = font_title.render("PAUSED", True, C_WHITE)

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_title_main, ((_pause_panel_w - _title_main.get_width()) // 2, _title_y))

# Orange accent bar under title - matches the main menu's accent bar.
_bar_y = _title_y + 88

pygame.draw.rect(_pause_panel_frame, C_ORANGE, ((_pause_panel_w - 200) // 2, _bar_y, 200, 3))

# Footer hint at bottom of panel.
_footer_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 12)

_footer_text = _footer_font.render("ESC - RESUME    ·    F11 - TOGGLE FULLSCREEN", True, (100, 100, 100))

_pause_panel_frame.blit(_footer_text, ((_pause_panel_w - _footer_text.get_width()) // 2, _pause_panel_h - 22))

# Small status-block font (reused for the dynamic rows).
_pause_stat_label_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 13, bold=True)

_pause_stat_value_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 18, bold=True)


def _format_elapsed(seconds):
    """mm:ss for the elapsed-time stat."""
    m = int(seconds) // 60
    s = int(seconds) % 60
    return f"{m:02d}:{s:02d}"


def draw_pause_menu():
    """Draw the pause overlay + framed panel + mission status + buttons.

    Redesigned from the original 3-line placeholder (flat overlay + "PAUSED"
    text + naked buttons) to match the main menu's visual language: framed
    panel with corner ticks, classification banner, Impact title with drop
    shadow + orange accent bar, operation subtitle, live mission status
    block (elapsed time / hostiles / accuracy / ammo), and the same
    ModernButton style used everywhere else.
    """

    screen.blit(_pause_overlay, (0, 0))

    screen.blit(_pause_panel_frame, (_pause_panel_x, _pause_panel_y))

    # ── Operation subtitle (dynamic - depends on current mission) ──
    op_name = _mission_meta.operation_name(STATE)

    op_surf = font_terminal.render(op_name, True, C_TERMINAL)

    screen.blit(op_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - op_surf.get_width() // 2, _pause_panel_y + 165))

    # ── Mission status header ──
    header_surf = _pause_stat_label_font.render("MISSION STATUS", True, C_ORANGE)

    screen.blit(header_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - header_surf.get_width() // 2, _pause_panel_y + 195))

    # Thin divider under the header.
    pygame.draw.line(screen, (90, 50, 20),

                     (WIDTH // 2 - 120, _pause_panel_y + 213),

                     (WIDTH // 2 + 120, _pause_panel_y + 213), 1)

    # ── Status rows ──
    # Compute live values from STATE. Everything degrades gracefully to
    # "-" if the mission hasn't started yet or STATE doesn't have the field.
    try:

        start_t = getattr(STATE, "mission_start_time", 0) or pygame.time.get_ticks()

        elapsed = max(0, (pygame.time.get_ticks() - start_t) // 1000)

        elapsed_str = _format_elapsed(elapsed)

    except Exception:

        elapsed_str = "--:--"

    hostiles = getattr(STATE, "hostiles_killed", 0)

    shots_fired = getattr(STATE, "shots_fired", 0)

    shots_hit = getattr(STATE, "shots_hit", 0)

    accuracy = int((shots_hit / shots_fired) * 100) if shots_fired > 0 else 0

    ammo_in_mag = getattr(STATE, "ammo_in_mag", 0)

    mag_size = getattr(STATE, "mag_size", 0)

    spare_mags = getattr(STATE, "spare_mags", 0)

    # Two columns: labels on the left, values on the right, centered as a block.
    col_label_x = WIDTH // 2 - 140

    col_value_x = WIDTH // 2 + 140

    rows = [

        ("ELAPSED", elapsed_str),

        ("HOSTILES NEUTRALIZED", str(hostiles)),

        ("ACCURACY", f"{accuracy}%  ({shots_hit}/{shots_fired})"),

        ("AMMO", f"{ammo_in_mag}/{mag_size}  +{spare_mags} mags"),

    ]

    row_y = _pause_panel_y + 228

    for label, value in rows:

        lbl_surf = _pause_stat_label_font.render(label, True, C_GREY)

        val_surf = _pause_stat_value_font.render(value, True, C_WHITE)

        screen.blit(lbl_surf, (col_label_x - lbl_surf.get_width(), row_y))

        screen.blit(val_surf, (col_value_x, row_y))

        row_y += 26

    # ── Buttons ──
    for btn in pause_buttons:

        btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

        btn.draw(screen)

_death_animation_start = 0

_death_particles = []

_death_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 70)

_death_sub_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 22, bold=True)

_death_flavor_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 16)

_server_title_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Impact", 46)

def reset_death_animation():

    global _death_animation_start, _death_particles

    _death_animation_start = 0

    _death_particles = []

    # The Black Ledger custom screen temporarily lays these shared buttons out
    # side-by-side. Always restore the generic death-screen layout on reset so
    # Mission 1 / Mission 2 death screens cannot inherit M3-specific positions.
    for i, btn in enumerate(death_buttons):
        btn.x = WIDTH // 2 - 150
        btn.y = 330 + i * 60
        btn.rect.x = btn.x
        btn.rect.y = btn.y

def draw_death_screen():

    global _death_animation_start, _death_particles

    if _death_animation_start == 0:

        _death_animation_start = pygame.time.get_ticks()

        for _ in range(150):

            _death_particles.append({

                'x': _rng_legacy.randint(0, WIDTH),

                'y': _rng_legacy.randint(0, HEIGHT),

                'r': _rng_legacy.randint(2, 7),

                'a': _rng_legacy.randint(60, 160),

                'vy': _rng_legacy.uniform(0.1, 0.4)

            })

    elapsed = pygame.time.get_ticks() - _death_animation_start

    dark_alpha = min(180, int(elapsed * 0.15))

    overlay = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    overlay.fill((10, 5, 5, dark_alpha))

    screen.blit(overlay, (0, 0))

    beat_cycle = elapsed % 1200

    if beat_cycle < 200:

        beat_intensity = 1.0 - (beat_cycle / 200.0)

    else:

        beat_intensity = 0.0

    vig_alpha = int(100 * beat_intensity) + 30

    vig = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    for i in range(0, WIDTH, 3):

        a = max(0, vig_alpha - int(vig_alpha * i / WIDTH * 1.2))

        if a > 0:

            pygame.draw.rect(vig, (120, 0, 0, a), (i, i, WIDTH - i * 2, HEIGHT - i * 2), 3)

    screen.blit(vig, (0, 0))

    for p in _death_particles:

        p['y'] += p['vy']

        pygame.draw.circle(screen, (80, 5, 5, p['a']), (int(p['x']), int(p['y'])), p['r'])

    if elapsed < 400:

        flash_alpha = max(0, 255 - int(elapsed * 1.2))

        flash = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        if elapsed < 100:

            flash_color = (255, 220, 220, flash_alpha)

        else:

            flash_color = (150, 10, 10, flash_alpha)

        flash.fill(flash_color)

        screen.blit(flash, (0, 0))

    if elapsed > 600:

        text_alpha = min(255, (elapsed - 600) * 2)

        offset_x, offset_y = 0, 0

        if elapsed < 700:

            offset_x = _rng_legacy.randint(-8, 8)

            offset_y = _rng_legacy.randint(-4, 4)

        shadow_surf = _death_font.render("MISSION FAILED", True, (0, 0, 0))

        shadow_surf.set_alpha(text_alpha)

        title_y = HEIGHT // 2 - 140

        screen.blit(shadow_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - shadow_surf.get_width() // 2 + 4 + offset_x, title_y + 4 + offset_y))

        text_surf = _death_font.render("MISSION FAILED", True, (210, 30, 30))

        text_surf.set_alpha(text_alpha)

        screen.blit(text_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - text_surf.get_width() // 2 + offset_x, title_y + offset_y))

    if elapsed > 1000:

        sub_alpha = min(255, (elapsed - 1000) * 2)

        # Per-mission copy lives in core/mission_meta.py (neutral fallback
        # for unknown modes - never Mission 1's BLACK NOTEBOOK by default).
        sub_text, flavor_text = _mission_meta.fail_text(STATE)

        sub = _death_sub_font.render(sub_text, True, (180, 180, 180))

        sub.set_alpha(sub_alpha)

        screen.blit(sub, (WIDTH // 2 - sub.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 60))

        flavor = _death_flavor_font.render(flavor_text, True, (120, 120, 120))

        flavor.set_alpha(sub_alpha)

        screen.blit(flavor, (WIDTH // 2 - flavor.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT // 2 - 30))

    if elapsed > 1150:

        panel_alpha = min(230, int((elapsed - 1150) * 0.35))

        try:

            from missions import walking_sim

            civilians_helped = sum(1 for n in walking_sim.walk_npcs if n.get("has_given"))

            rations_used = max(0, 2 - int(walking_sim.player_rations))

        except Exception:

            civilians_helped = 0

            rations_used = 0

        end_t = STATE.mission_end_time or pygame.time.get_ticks()

        start_t = STATE.mission_start_time or end_t

        elapsed_sec = max(0, (end_t - start_t) // 1000)

        accuracy = int((STATE.shots_hit / STATE.shots_fired) * 100) if STATE.shots_fired > 0 else 0

        if getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION2":

            evidence_found = 0

            try:

                evidence_found = sum(1 for item in getattr(STATE, "mission2_evidence", []) if item.get("done"))

            except Exception:

                evidence_found = 0

            stats = [

                ("KILLS", str(STATE.hostiles_killed)),

                ("SHOTS FIRED", str(STATE.shots_fired)),

                ("ACCURACY", f"{accuracy}%"),

                ("TOTAL TIME", f"{elapsed_sec // 60:02d}:{elapsed_sec % 60:02d}"),

                ("EVIDENCE FOUND", f"{evidence_found}/3"),

                ("COMMS", "OFFLINE" if getattr(STATE, "mission2_comms_cut", False) else "VASILE"),

            ]

        else:

            stats = [

                ("KILLS", str(STATE.hostiles_killed)),

                ("SHOTS FIRED", str(STATE.shots_fired)),

                ("ACCURACY", f"{accuracy}%"),

                ("TOTAL TIME", f"{elapsed_sec // 60:02d}:{elapsed_sec % 60:02d}"),

                ("CIVILIANS HELPED", str(civilians_helped)),

                ("RATIONS USED", str(rations_used)),

            ]

        panel_w, panel_h = 520, 104

        panel_x = WIDTH // 2 - panel_w // 2

        panel_y = HEIGHT // 2 + 16

        panel = pygame.Surface((panel_w, panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        panel.fill((8, 8, 12, panel_alpha))

        pygame.draw.rect(panel, (120, 35, 35, min(160, panel_alpha)), panel.get_rect(), 1)

        pygame.draw.rect(panel, (170, 35, 35, min(200, panel_alpha)), (0, 0, 4, panel_h))

        screen.blit(panel, (panel_x, panel_y))

        for i, (label, value) in enumerate(stats):

            col = i % 3

            row = i // 3

            sx = panel_x + 24 + col * 165

            sy = panel_y + 16 + row * 42

            lbl = font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (135, 80, 80))

            val = _death_sub_font.render(value, True, (220, 210, 205))

            lbl.set_alpha(panel_alpha)

            val.set_alpha(panel_alpha)

            screen.blit(lbl, (sx, sy))

            screen.blit(val, (sx, sy + 15))

    if elapsed > 600 and _rng_legacy.random() > 0.92:

        glitch_y = _rng_legacy.randint(0, HEIGHT)

        glitch_h = _rng_legacy.randint(2, 8)

        glitch_surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, glitch_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)

        glitch_surf.fill((255, 255, 255, 40))

        screen.blit(glitch_surf, (_rng_legacy.randint(-10, 10), glitch_y))

    if elapsed > 1500:

        btn_progress = min(1.0, (elapsed - 1500) / 600.0)

        ease = 1 - (1 - btn_progress) ** 3

        for i, btn in enumerate(death_buttons):

            # Generic death screen is always centered. Black Ledger uses the
            # same button objects with a different layout, so reset X here too.
            btn.x = WIDTH // 2 - 150
            btn.rect.x = btn.x

            target_y = HEIGHT // 2 + 150 + i * 60

            start_y = target_y + 40

            current_y = start_y + (target_y - start_y) * ease

            btn.y = int(current_y)

            btn.rect.y = btn.y

            btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())

            btn.draw(screen)

def draw_black_ledger_death_screen():
    """Persistent custom death screen for Mission 3's Black Ledger easter egg.

    Unlike the generic death screen, this is intentionally static/readable:
    a sealed black-site dossier with the normal Restart Mission / Quit to Menu
    buttons below it.
    """
    global _death_animation_start

    if _death_animation_start == 0:
        _death_animation_start = pygame.time.get_ticks()

    elapsed = pygame.time.get_ticks() - _death_animation_start

    # Full black-site background.
    screen.fill((5, 4, 4))

    # Very subtle red surveillance wash.
    wash = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pulse = int(18 + 8 * math.sin(pygame.time.get_ticks() * 0.0025))
    wash.fill((70, 0, 0, pulse))
    screen.blit(wash, (0, 0))

    # Slow, sparse scanlines/noise - static screen, not chaos.
    for y in range(0, HEIGHT, 4):
        pygame.draw.line(screen, (18, 12, 12), (0, y), (WIDTH, y), 1)
    rng = random.Random(91414 + pygame.time.get_ticks() // 250)
    for _ in range(70):
        x = rng.randint(0, WIDTH - 1)
        y = rng.randint(0, HEIGHT - 1)
        a = rng.randint(12, 38)
        screen.set_at((x, y), (min(255, 30 + a), min(255, 22 + a // 2), min(255, 20 + a // 2)))

    # Main dossier card.
    card_w, card_h = 720, 455
    card_x = WIDTH // 2 - card_w // 2
    card_y = 54
    shadow = pygame.Surface((card_w + 24, card_h + 24), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    shadow.fill((0, 0, 0, 160))
    screen.blit(shadow, (card_x + 10, card_y + 12))

    card = pygame.Rect(card_x, card_y, card_w, card_h)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (174, 149, 108), card, border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (38, 12, 10), card, 4, border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (110, 30, 24), card.inflate(-10, -10), 1, border_radius=2)

    # Header.
    title = font_title.render("BLACK LEDGER", True, (36, 10, 8))
    screen.blit(title, (card.centerx - title.get_width() // 2, card_y + 18))
    sub = font_terminal.render("INCIDENT SEALED // ENTRY 014", True, (96, 22, 18))
    screen.blit(sub, (card.centerx - sub.get_width() // 2, card_y + 96))

    pygame.draw.line(screen, (70, 28, 22), (card_x + 36, card_y + 130), (card.right - 36, card_y + 130), 2)

    # Left side: entry data.
    rows = [
        ("SUBJECT", "BIRIBEL"),
        ("STATUS", "COUNTED"),
        ("CAUSE", "INMATE 000 CONTACT"),
        ("REGISTER", "NONCOMBATANT LEDGER"),
        ("CAMERA", "CAM-13 / SIGNAL LOST"),
        ("RESPONSE", "AUTOMATED RECORD SEAL"),
    ]
    row_x = card_x + 54
    row_y = card_y + 158
    for i, (label, value) in enumerate(rows):
        y = row_y + i * 38
        lbl = font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (82, 48, 36))
        val_col = (132, 12, 12) if value in ("COUNTED", "BIRIBEL") else (38, 20, 15)
        val = font_terminal.render(value, True, val_col)
        screen.blit(lbl, (row_x, y))
        screen.blit(val, (row_x + 142, y - 4))

    # Right side: mugshot/silhouette block.
    mug = pygame.Rect(card.right - 250, card_y + 155, 190, 205)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (28, 22, 19), mug)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (84, 54, 40), mug, 2)
    for yy in range(mug.top + 18, mug.bottom - 12, 26):
        pygame.draw.line(screen, (52, 42, 36), (mug.left + 12, yy), (mug.right - 12, yy), 1)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(screen, (4, 4, 4), (mug.centerx - 58, mug.bottom - 66, 116, 38))
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (6, 6, 6), (mug.centerx - 38, mug.top + 86, 76, 88), border_radius=18)
    pygame.draw.circle(screen, (7, 7, 7), (mug.centerx, mug.top + 74), 30)
    pygame.draw.rect(screen, (152, 84, 34), (mug.centerx - 38, mug.top + 136, 76, 25), border_radius=3)
    zero = font_terminal.render("000", True, (236, 172, 82))
    screen.blit(zero, (mug.centerx - zero.get_width() // 2, mug.top + 134))
    cap = font_terminal_small.render("INMATE 000", True, (154, 124, 88))
    screen.blit(cap, (mug.centerx - cap.get_width() // 2, mug.bottom + 8))

    # Large red stamp.
    stamp = pygame.Surface((310, 96), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.rect(stamp, (125, 0, 0, 38), (0, 0, 310, 96), border_radius=5)
    pygame.draw.rect(stamp, (146, 10, 10, 220), (10, 10, 290, 76), 6, border_radius=5)
    stxt = font_title.render("COUNTED", True, (150, 8, 8))
    stxt = pygame.transform.scale(stxt, (264, 62))
    stamp.blit(stxt, (24, 18))
    stamp = pygame.transform.rotate(stamp, -7)
    screen.blit(stamp, (card_x + 380, card_y + 334))

    # Warning footer on the card.
    warn = font_terminal_small.render("THE LEDGER DOES NOT FORGET WHO FILLED IT.", True, (84, 20, 16))
    screen.blit(warn, (card.centerx - warn.get_width() // 2, card.bottom - 34))

    # Screen title/footer outside the card.
    footer = font_terminal_small.render("MISSION 3 // THE VOSTRAL // BLACK LEDGER EASTER EGG", True, (100, 60, 54))
    screen.blit(footer, (WIDTH // 2 - footer.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT - 36))

    # Buttons fade in quickly and then remain static.
    btn_alpha_ready = elapsed > 350
    for i, btn in enumerate(death_buttons):
        btn.y = HEIGHT - 150 + i * 58
        btn.rect.y = btn.y
        btn.check_hover(get_scaled_mouse())
        if btn_alpha_ready:
            btn.draw(screen)
        else:
            ghost = font_terminal.render(btn.text, True, (80, 45, 45))
            screen.blit(ghost, (btn.x + btn.width // 2 - ghost.get_width() // 2, btn.y + 13))

def _black_ledger_death_button_progress():
    """0..1 reveal progress for Black Ledger death controls."""
    global _death_animation_start
    if _death_animation_start == 0:
        _death_animation_start = pygame.time.get_ticks()
    elapsed = pygame.time.get_ticks() - _death_animation_start
    # Let the Ledger verdict breathe before controls appear.
    delay = 850
    duration = 900
    p = max(0.0, min(1.0, (elapsed - delay) / duration))
    # Smoothstep easing.
    return p * p * (3.0 - 2.0 * p)


def black_ledger_death_buttons_ready():
    """True once the Black Ledger death controls are visually usable."""
    return _black_ledger_death_button_progress() >= 0.92


def draw_black_ledger_death_buttons():
    """Draw only the interactive controls for the Black Ledger death screen.

    They now fade/slide in after the verdict instead of popping into existence.
    This keeps the final Ledger frame feeling like a death screen first and an
    options menu second.
    """
    progress = _black_ledger_death_button_progress()
    if progress <= 0.01:
        # Keep button rects away from the mouse while invisible.
        for btn in death_buttons:
            btn.rect.y = HEIGHT + 200
            btn.is_hovered = False
        return

    alpha = int(225 * progress)
    slide = int((1.0 - progress) * 34)

    controls = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, 112), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # Bottom shelf fades in softly from black, not as a hard new UI panel.
    shelf_h = 92
    shelf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, shelf_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    shelf.fill((0, 0, 0, int(142 * progress)))
    pygame.draw.line(shelf, (105, 34, 28, int(130 * progress)), (0, 0), (WIDTH, 0), 1)
    controls.blit(shelf, (0, 18 + slide // 2))

    prompt_alpha = int(160 * progress)
    prompt = font_terminal_small.render(
        "death record complete", True, (135, 82, 74)
    )
    prompt.set_alpha(prompt_alpha)
    controls.blit(prompt, (WIDTH // 2 - prompt.get_width() // 2, 10 + slide // 2))

    # Place the two existing death buttons side-by-side under the death verdict.
    positions = [
        (WIDTH // 2 - 320, 54 + slide),
        (WIDTH // 2 + 20, 54 + slide),
    ]

    ready_for_hover = progress >= 0.84
    mp = get_scaled_mouse()
    # Convert mouse into the local controls surface coordinate.
    local_mp = (mp[0], mp[1] - (HEIGHT - controls.get_height()))

    for btn, (x, y) in zip(death_buttons, positions):
        btn.x = int(x)
        btn.y = int(y)
        btn.rect.x = btn.x
        # Actual screen-space rect must include the controls surface offset.
        btn.rect.y = int(HEIGHT - controls.get_height() + btn.y)

        if ready_for_hover:
            # Temporarily test hover against local surface coordinates.
            old_rect_y = btn.rect.y
            btn.rect.y = btn.y
            btn.check_hover(local_mp)
            btn.rect.y = old_rect_y
        else:
            btn.is_hovered = False

        # Draw to local surface with local y, then restore screen-space rect.
        old_rect_y = btn.rect.y
        btn.rect.y = btn.y
        btn.draw(controls)
        btn.rect.y = old_rect_y

    controls.set_alpha(alpha)
    screen.blit(controls, (0, HEIGHT - controls.get_height()))

"""Split from menu.py - see menu.py (shim) for the map."""
from core.config import *

from core.state import STATE


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Shared hover bookkeeping (for the custom arrow cursor)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ui.main.draw_menu_cursor() wants to know "is the pointer over something
# clickable?" so it can switch from white to orange. Every interactive widget
# already calls check_hover() once per frame, so a single module-level flag
# covers every menu screen without each screen knowing the cursor exists.
#
# The cursor CONSUMES the flag (reads + clears) when it draws, which is the
# last thing to happen each frame. Any screen that draws no cursor simply
# leaves it clear for the next one.
_hover_hot = False


def note_hover(hot=True):
    """Mark that the pointer is over an interactive widget this frame."""
    global _hover_hot
    if hot:
        _hover_hot = True


def consume_hover():
    """Return (and clear) whether anything was hovered since the last frame."""
    global _hover_hot
    hot = _hover_hot
    _hover_hot = False
    return hot


def clipboard_text(max_len=512):
    """Best-effort clipboard read, for Ctrl+V paste in text fields.

    Every text box in the game types via ``KEYDOWN.unicode``, but a paste
    is not a keypress - SDL delivers it as a ``TEXTINPUT`` event that no
    field reads, so Ctrl+V silently did nothing. Paste must therefore pull
    the clipboard explicitly. Returns "" on any platform/init failure, and
    strips non-printable characters (clipboards often carry a trailing NUL,
    and a single-line field must not gain newlines/tabs).
    """
    try:
        if not (pygame.scrap.get_init() or pygame.scrap.init()):
            return ""
        data = pygame.scrap.get(pygame.SCRAP_TEXT)
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if not data:
        return ""
    if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
        try:
            data = bytes(data).decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            data = bytes(data).decode("latin-1", "ignore")
    return "".join(ch for ch in str(data) if ch.isprintable())[:max_len]


class ModernButton:
    """Menu button with dt-based scale, glow, and click feedback.

    Polish layers (applied on top of the existing slide-on-hover behavior):
      - Hover:   text scales up to 1.04x, left accent bar gets a soft orange
                 glow halo, chevron brightens.
      - Click:   button visually dips +2px on Y and emits a brief 180ms white
                 flash overlay.
      - Keyboard selection (arrow keys): same visual as hover, plus a brighter
        left bar so the user can always see which item is focused.

    All animation state is updated with delta time so the feel is identical at
    60Hz, 144Hz, or under frame drops. The lerp constants below are tuned for
    a 60Hz frame; the per-frame coefficient is recomputed from dt so motion
    stays frame-rate independent.
    """

    # Lerp speeds in "fraction of remaining distance per second".
    # Higher = snappier. Tune here, used by _lerp_dt.
    _SLIDE_SPEED = 12.0      # hover slide-in
    _SCALE_SPEED = 14.0      # hover scale-up
    _GLOW_SPEED = 10.0       # left-bar glow ramp
    _PRESS_SPEED = 18.0      # click Y-dip recover
    _FLASH_DECAY = 5.5       # post-click white flash fade

    def __init__(self, x, y, text):

        self.x, self.y, self.text = x, y, text

        self.width, self.height = 300, 40

        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, self.width, self.height)

        self.is_hovered = False
        self.is_selected = False   # keyboard focus (arrow keys)
        self._prev_hover = False

        # Animated state - all updated via dt-based lerp.
        self.anim_offset = 0.0     # horizontal slide on hover
        self.scale = 1.0           # text scale, 1.0 idle → 1.04 hover
        self.glow_alpha = 0.0      # 0..255, left accent bar glow
        self.press_dip = 0.0       # 0..2px Y dip on click
        self.flash_timer = 0.0     # seconds remaining of click flash

        # Pre-rendered glow surface for the left accent bar (regenerated only
        # if the bar geometry changes - currently fixed at 9px wide).
        self._glow_surf = pygame.Surface((24, self.height + 20), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # ---- public API -------------------------------------------------------

    def update(self, dt):
        """Advance animation state by dt seconds.

        Called once per frame by draw_menu() for every visible button. Idempotent
        when called with dt=0 - safe to skip if the frame is paused.
        """
        active = self.is_hovered or self.is_selected
        # Hover/selected drive the slide + scale + glow in unison so the
        # keyboard-focus and mouse-focus feel identical.
        self.anim_offset = _lerp_dt(self.anim_offset, 20.0 if active else 0.0,
                                    self._SLIDE_SPEED, dt)
        self.scale = _lerp_dt(self.scale, 1.04 if active else 1.0,
                              self._SCALE_SPEED, dt)
        self.glow_alpha = _lerp_dt(self.glow_alpha, 220.0 if active else 0.0,
                                   self._GLOW_SPEED, dt)

        # Click dip recovers on its own.
        if self.press_dip > 0.0:
            self.press_dip = _lerp_dt(self.press_dip, 0.0,
                                      self._PRESS_SPEED, dt)
            if self.press_dip < 0.05:
                self.press_dip = 0.0

        # Flash decays linearly with time.
        if self.flash_timer > 0.0:
            self.flash_timer = max(0.0, self.flash_timer - dt)

    def press(self):
        """Trigger click feedback: 2px Y dip + 180ms white flash."""
        self.press_dip = 2.0
        self.flash_timer = 0.18

    def draw(self, surface):

        text_color = C_WHITE if (self.is_hovered or self.is_selected) else C_GREY

        actual_x = self.x + int(self.anim_offset)
        actual_y = self.y + int(self.press_dip)

        # Always-visible tick mark (orange accent bar on the left)
        tick_col = C_ORANGE if (self.is_hovered or self.is_selected) else (90, 55, 20)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, tick_col,
                         (self.x - 25, self.y + 6, 3, self.height - 12))

        # Soft glow halo around the left bar - only when active.
        if self.glow_alpha > 4.0:
            self._glow_surf.fill((0, 0, 0, 0))
            for r, a_mult in [(12, 0.25), (8, 0.45), (5, 0.75)]:
                a = int(self.glow_alpha * a_mult)
                if a <= 0:
                    continue
                pygame.draw.rect(
                    self._glow_surf, (255, 120, 0, a),
                    (12 - r, 10 - r + 2, r * 2, self.height + r * 2 - 4),
                    border_radius=r,
                )
            surface.blit(self._glow_surf, (self.x - 36, self.y - 10))

        # Always-visible chevron prefix
        chevron_col = C_ORANGE if (self.is_hovered or self.is_selected) else (110, 110, 110)
        chevron = font_btn.render(">", True, chevron_col)
        surface.blit(chevron, (self.x - 15, actual_y + 4))

        # Solid orange left bar + hover background - only when active.
        if self.is_hovered or self.is_selected:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_ORANGE,
                             (actual_x - 15, actual_y, 5, self.height))
            surface.blit(_btn_hover_bg, (actual_x - 5, actual_y))

        # Scaled text. Pygame doesn't do sub-pixel scale cleanly on SysFont,
        # so we round to the nearest int. The 1.04x gain is small but reads
        # clearly in motion.
        text_surf = font_btn.render(self.text, True, text_color)
        if self.scale > 1.01:
            new_w = max(1, int(text_surf.get_width() * self.scale))
            new_h = max(1, int(text_surf.get_height() * self.scale))
            text_surf = pygame.transform.smoothscale(text_surf, (new_w, new_h))
        surface.blit(text_surf, (actual_x, actual_y + 4))

        # Click flash overlay - white tint that fades over 180ms.
        if self.flash_timer > 0.0:
            flash_alpha = int(140 * (self.flash_timer / 0.18))
            flash = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            flash.fill((255, 240, 200, flash_alpha))
            surface.blit(flash, (actual_x - 5, actual_y))

    def check_hover(self, mp):

        self._prev_hover = self.is_hovered

        self.is_hovered = self.rect.collidepoint(mp)

        if self.is_hovered and not self._prev_hover:

            audio.play("menu_hover", volume=0.3)

        # Report to the shared cursor so the custom arrow can switch to its
        # orange "hot" state on ANY menu screen, not just the main menu.
        if self.is_hovered:
            note_hover()

    def is_clicked(self, event, mp):

        if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button == 1 and self.is_hovered:

            audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.5)
            self.press()
            return True

        return False

    ModernButton(135, 570, "EXIT"),

]

# Soft gradient fade on the right edge of the dark panel for smoother transition

for fx in range(40):

    a = int(230 * (1 - fx / 40))

    pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (5, 5, 8, a), (500 - fx, 0), (500 - fx, HEIGHT))

# Faint horizontal scanlines baked into the panel for a CRT terminal feel

for sy in range(0, HEIGHT, 3):

    pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (255, 255, 255, 6), (0, sy), (500, sy))

# Vertical accent bar on the right edge of the panel

pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (255, 120, 0, 70), (498, 0), (498, HEIGHT), 1)

pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (255, 120, 0, 30), (495, 0), (495, HEIGHT), 1)

pygame.draw.rect(_btn_hover_bg, (0, 0, 0, 180), _btn_hover_bg.get_rect())

# Diagonal hatched pattern at very top-right corner of panel

for hx in range(0, 60, 4):

    pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (255, 120, 0, 25), (440 + hx, 0), (500, 60 - hx), 1)

# Subtitle / accent fonts

# Decorative corner ticks - drawn directly to the overlay so they're free at runtime

for cx, cy in [(8, 8), (488, 8), (8, HEIGHT - 8), (488, HEIGHT - 8)]:

    pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (255, 120, 0, 180), (cx, cy), (cx + 12 if cx < 200 else cx - 12, cy), 1)

    pygame.draw.line(_menu_overlay, (255, 120, 0, 180), (cx, cy), (cx, cy + 12 if cy < 200 else cy - 12), 1)

def _lerp_dt(current, target, speed_per_sec, dt):
    """Frame-rate-independent exponential lerp.

    `speed_per_sec` is the approximate "fraction of remaining distance closed
    per second". At 60fps with speed=12, this behaves like the old `* 0.2`
    per-frame lerp but stays correct at any frame rate.
    """
    if dt <= 0:
        return current
    # Equivalent to applying `* k` per-frame where k = 1 - exp(-speed * dt).
    k = 1.0 - math.exp(-speed_per_sec * dt)
    return current + (target - current) * k

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\assemble_final_trailer.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""assemble_final_trailer.py - Post-production assembler for CALL OF ACARISTAN.

Takes the three clean combat acts captured by Terminal 8
(``trailers/fresh_action/act{1,2,3}.mp4``), splices the game's own title /
divider / stamp / end cards between them, and mixes a trailer audio bed
against the in-repo SFX + radio bank.

Design notes
------------
* Title cards are NOT re-implemented. They are rendered headless through the
  game's existing card renderer (``tools/render_trailer_v2.card`` for the
  PLAN_2 title/divider/stamp finish, ``tools/render_trailer.end_card`` for the
  AI-4 CTA lockup), so the cards match the in-game look (Oswald / IBM Plex
  Mono, 255,120,0 accent, vignette, fade finish) instead of being an ffmpeg
  re-creation that drifts.
* The picture is assembled with ffmpeg's ``concat`` *filter* (not the demuxer)
  so a timebase mismatch in the acts cannot silently desync A/V. Every row is
  normalised to 1000x700 @ 30 fps CFR yuv420p and trimmed to its EDL duration
  before the join.
* Final grade follows ``docs/PLAN_3_AUDIO.md`` §5: 1000x700 blur-padded into
  1920x1080 over a darkened blurred background, audio loudnorm'd to
  -14 LUFS / -2 dBTP.
* Audio arrangement follows ``docs/PLAN_3_AUDIO.md`` §1 (arrangement),
  §2.2 (radio filters), §3 (hit stacks) and §4 (beat-sync map), retimed onto
  this assembly's EDL. 100 BPM grid = 0.6 s; every cut lands on the grid.
* **Gunshots are foley-driven, never hand-placed.** The acts are silent -
  ``tools/record_fresh_action.py`` captures with ``SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy`` and
  ``set_master_volume(0)``, so it logs every live shot to an
  ``act<N>.foley.json`` sidecar instead of an audio track. Guessing shot times
  here (the old ``4.2 + i*1.4`` loops) put reports on empty picture and left
  real muzzle flashes dry. ``tools/build_sfx_stem.py`` re-renders the real
  ``sfx_wav/`` stacks at the logged ticks; this script calls it with this EDL's
  act offsets and mixes the result as the diegetic stem.

Usage
-----
    python assemble_final_trailer.py
    python assemble_final_trailer.py --probe          # print the EDL only
    python assemble_final_trailer.py --keep-stems     # keep intermediate wavs

Output
------
    trailer_final_master.mp4
"""
